class HostGameController extends ChangeNotifier {
  HostGameController({
    required this.transport,
    required Player hostPlayer,
  })  : _players = <Player>[hostPlayer],
        _sessions = <String, GameSession>{},
        _modeIds = <String>[],
        _multiGame = false,
        _currentModeId = 'lobby',
        _random = math.Random(),
        _snapshot = _emptySnapshot('lobby', <Player>[hostPlayer]) {
    _peerToPlayer[transport.selfId] = hostPlayer.id;
    _wireTransport();
    _broadcast();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  final GameTransport transport;
  final List<Player> _players;
  Map<String, GameSession> _sessions;
  List<String> _modeIds;
  bool _multiGame;

  final math.Random _random;

  String _currentModeId;

  GameSession get session => _sessions[_currentModeId]!;
  String get modeId => _currentModeId;
  bool get isMultiGame => _multiGame;

  bool get isInLobby => _currentModeId == 'lobby';
  List<Player> get players => List<Player>.unmodifiable(_players);

  Set<String> get connectedPlayerIds => _peerToPlayer.values.toSet();

  final Map<String, String> _peerToPlayer = <String, String>{};

  int _voterIndex = 0;
  final Map<String, String> _votes = <String, String>{};

  MultiplayerCard? _privateCard;
  String? _activePlayerId;

  late MultiplayerSnapshot _snapshot;
  MultiplayerSnapshot get snapshot => _snapshot;

  final ValueNotifier<int> connectedCount = ValueNotifier<int>(0);
  final ValueNotifier<Map<String, String>?> lastReaction = ValueNotifier(null);

  bool _disposed = false;

  bool isPlayerRemote(String playerId) =>
      _peerToPlayer.containsValue(playerId) &&
      !_peerToPlayer.entries.any(
        (MapEntry<String, String> e) =>
            e.value == playerId && e.key == transport.selfId,
      );

  bool get currentVoterIsLocal {
    if (_voterIndex >= _players.length) return false;
    return !isPlayerRemote(_players[_voterIndex].id);
  }

  int get currentVoterIndex =>
      _voterIndex >= _players.length ? -1 : _voterIndex;

  bool get activePlayerIsLocal =>
      _activePlayerId != null &&
      _players.isNotEmpty &&
      _activePlayerId == _players.first.id;

  MultiplayerCard? get localPrivateCard => _privateCard;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _disposed = true;
    for (final GameSession s in _sessions.values) {
      s.removeListener(_onSessionChanged);
    }
    connectedCount.dispose();
    lastReaction.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _wireTransport() {
    transport.events.listen((TransportEvent event) {
      if (_disposed) return;
      switch (event.type) {
        case TransportEventType.joined:
          break;
        case TransportEventType.left:
        case TransportEventType.connectionLost:
          final String? playerId = _peerToPlayer[event.peerId];
          if (playerId != null) {
            _peerToPlayer.remove(event.peerId);
            connectedCount.value = _peerToPlayer.length;
            
            if (!isInLobby) {
              _players.removeWhere((p) => p.id == playerId);
              _votes.remove(playerId);
              if (_voterIndex >= _players.length) {
                _voterIndex = 0;
              }
            } else {
              _players.removeWhere((p) => p.id == playerId);
            }
            
            _rebuildSnapshot();
            _broadcast();
          }
      }
    });
    transport.messages.listen(_onMessage);
  }

  void _wireSession(GameSession session) {
    session.addListener(_onSessionChanged);
  }

  void _onSessionChanged() {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _rebuildSnapshot();
    _broadcast();
  }

  void _onMessage(GameMessage message) {
    if (_disposed) return;
    switch (message.type) {
      case 'join_request':
        _handleJoinRequest(message.senderId, message.payload);
      case 'vote_cast':
        _handleVoteCast(message.senderId, message.payload);
      case 'mark_jnim':
        _handleMarkJnim(message.senderId);
      case 'av_choose':
        _handleAvChoose(message.senderId, message.payload);
      case 'av_refuse':
        _handleAvRefuse(message.senderId);
      case 'av_redraw':
        _handleAvRedraw(message.senderId);
      case 'av_done':
        _handleAvDone(message.senderId);
      case 'reaction':
        lastReaction.value = {
          'emoji': message.payload['emoji']?.toString() ?? '😂',
          'name': message.payload['name']?.toString() ?? 'Quelqu\'un',
        };
        notifyListeners();
      default:
        break;
    }
  }

  void _handleJoinRequest(String peerId, Map<String, dynamic> payload) {
    if (_peerToPlayer.containsKey(peerId)) return;

    final String? requestedPlayerId = payload['playerId']?.toString();
    if (requestedPlayerId != null) {
      final Player? existing = _players
          .where((Player p) => p.id == requestedPlayerId)
          .firstOrNull;
      final bool isConnected = _peerToPlayer.containsValue(requestedPlayerId);
      if (existing != null && !isConnected) {
        _peerToPlayer[peerId] = existing.id;
        transport.sendTo(
          peerId,
          GameMessage(
            type: 'assigned',
            senderId: transport.selfId,
            payload: <String, dynamic>{
              'playerId': existing.id,
              'name': existing.name,
              'emoji': existing.emoji,
              'colorIndex': existing.colorIndex,
              if (existing.photoBase64 != null)
                'photoBase64': existing.photoBase64,
            },
          ),
        );
        connectedCount.value = _peerToPlayer.length;
        _rebuildSnapshot();
        _broadcast();
        return;
      }
    }

    String name = payload['name']?.toString().trim() ?? 'Joueur';
    if (name.length < 3) {
      name = 'Joueur ${_players.length + 1}';
    }

    String emoji = payload['emoji']?.toString() ?? '🎉';
    final String? photoBase64 = payload['photoBase64']?.toString();

    if (photoBase64 == null || photoBase64.isEmpty) {
      final Set<String> takenAvatars = _players
          .where((p) => !p.hasPhoto)
          .map((p) => p.emoji)
          .toSet();
      
      if (takenAvatars.contains(emoji)) {
        emoji = AvatarCatalog.randomMascot(taken: takenAvatars);
      }
    }

    final Player newPlayer = Player(
      id: 'p_${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}_${_players.length}',
      name: name,
      emoji: emoji,
      photoBase64: photoBase64,
      colorIndex: _players.length,
    );

    _players.add(newPlayer);
    _peerToPlayer[peerId] = newPlayer.id;

    transport.sendTo(
      peerId,
      GameMessage(
        type: 'assigned',
        senderId: transport.selfId,
        payload: <String, dynamic>{
          'playerId': newPlayer.id,
          'name': newPlayer.name,
          'emoji': newPlayer.emoji,
          'colorIndex': newPlayer.colorIndex,
          if (newPlayer.photoBase64 != null) 'photoBase64': newPlayer.photoBase64,
        },
      ),
    );

    connectedCount.value = _peerToPlayer.length;
    _rebuildSnapshot();
    _broadcast();
  }

  void _handleVoteCast(String peerId, Map<String, dynamic> payload) {
    if (isInLobby) return;
    final String? voterPlayerId = _peerToPlayer[peerId];
    if (voterPlayerId == null) return;
    if (_voterIndex >= _players.length) return;
    if (_players[_voterIndex].id != voterPlayerId) return;

    final String choice = payload['choice']?.toString() ?? '';
    if (choice.isEmpty) return;

    _votes[voterPlayerId] = choice;
    _advanceVoter();
  }

  void _handleMarkJnim(String peerId) {
    if (isInLobby) return;
    final String? playerId = _peerToPlayer[peerId];
    if (playerId == null) return;
    _votes[playerId] = 'marked';
    _rebuildSnapshot();
    _broadcast();
  }

  void _handleAvChoose(String peerId, Map<String, dynamic> payload) {
    if (isInLobby || _currentModeId != 'action_ou_verite') return;
    final String? playerId = _peerToPlayer[peerId];
    if (playerId == null || playerId != _activePlayerId) return;
    final String kind = payload['kind']?.toString() ?? 'action';
    _drawPrivateCard(kind);
  }

  void _handleAvRefuse(String peerId) {
    if (isInLobby || _currentModeId != 'action_ou_verite') return;
    final String? playerId = _peerToPlayer[peerId];
    if (playerId == null || playerId != _activePlayerId) return;
    _resolveAv(refused: true);
  }

  void _handleAvRedraw(String peerId) {
    if (isInLobby || _currentModeId != 'action_ou_verite') return;
    final String? playerId = _peerToPlayer[peerId];
    if (playerId == null || playerId != _activePlayerId) return;

    final Player? player = _playerById(_activePlayerId!);
    if (player == null) return;
    session.recordSips(player, session.cappedSips(session.rules.actionRedraw));

    final String kind = _snapshot.activeKind ?? 'action';
    _drawPrivateCard(kind);
  }

  void _handleAvDone(String peerId) {
    if (isInLobby || _currentModeId != 'action_ou_verite') return;
    final String? playerId = _peerToPlayer[peerId];
    if (playerId == null || playerId != _activePlayerId) return;
    _resolveAv(refused: false);
  }

  void chooseAvLocally(String kind) {
    if (!activePlayerIsLocal) return;
    _drawPrivateCard(kind);
  }

  void refuseAvLocally() {
    if (!activePlayerIsLocal) return;
    _resolveAv(refused: true);
  }

  void redrawAvLocally() {
    if (!activePlayerIsLocal) return;
    final Player? player = _playerById(_activePlayerId!);
    if (player == null) return;
    session.recordSips(player, session.cappedSips(session.rules.actionRedraw));
    final String kind = _snapshot.activeKind ?? 'action';
    _drawPrivateCard(kind);
  }

  void doneAvLocally() {
    if (!activePlayerIsLocal) return;
    _resolveAv(refused: false);
  }

  void _drawPrivateCard(String kind) {
    final prompt = session.drawWhere((p) => p.kind.name == kind);
    if (prompt == null) return;

    _privateCard = MultiplayerCard(
      id: prompt.id,
      text: prompt.text,
      kind: prompt.kind.name,
      categoryName: prompt.category.name,
    );

    _snapshot = _snapshot.copyWith(
      phase: MultiplayerPhase.voting,
      clearCurrentCard: true,
      activeKind: kind,
      verdict: null,
    );

    final String? peerId = _peerForPlayer(_activePlayerId!);
    if (peerId != null && peerId != transport.selfId) {
      transport.sendTo(
        peerId,
        GameMessage(
          type: 'card_private',
          senderId: transport.selfId,
          payload: <String, dynamic>{
            'card': _privateCard!.toJson(),
            'kind': kind,
          },
        ),
      );
    }

    notifyListeners();
    _broadcast();
  }

  void _resolveAv({required bool refused}) {
    final Player? player = _playerById(_activePlayerId!);
    if (player == null) return;

    if (refused) {
      session.recordSips(
        player,
        session.cappedSips(session.rules.actionRefusal),
      );
      _snapshot = _snapshot.copyWith(
        phase: MultiplayerPhase.revealed,
        verdict: MultiplayerVerdict(
          loserIds: <String>[_activePlayerId!],
          summary: '${player.name} s’est dégonflé·e',
        ),
      );
    } else {
      _snapshot = _snapshot.copyWith(
        phase: MultiplayerPhase.revealed,
        verdict: MultiplayerVerdict(
          loserIds: const <String>[],
          summary: '${player.name} a relevé le défi !',
        ),
      );
    }

    _privateCard = null;
    notifyListeners();
    _broadcast();
  }

  String? _peerForPlayer(String playerId) {
    for (final MapEntry<String, String> e in _peerToPlayer.entries) {
      if (e.value == playerId) return e.key;
    }
    return null;
  }

  void castVoteLocally(String choice) {
    if (isInLobby) return;
    if (_voterIndex >= _players.length) return;
    final Player voter = _players[_voterIndex];
    if (isPlayerRemote(voter.id)) return;
    _votes[voter.id] = choice;
    _advanceVoter();
  }

  void markJnimLocally() {
    if (isInLobby) return;
    _votes[_players.first.id] = 'marked';
    _rebuildSnapshot();
    _broadcast();
  }

  void unmarkJnimLocally() {
    if (isInLobby) return;
    _votes.remove(_players.first.id);
    _rebuildSnapshot();
    _broadcast();
  }

  void _advanceVoter() {
    _voterIndex++;
    if (_voterIndex >= _players.length) {
      _computeVerdict();
    } else {
      _rebuildSnapshot();
      _broadcast();
    }
  }

  void _computeVerdict() {
    final MultiplayerVerdict verdict = _buildVerdict();
    _snapshot = _snapshot.copyWith(
      phase: MultiplayerPhase.revealed,
      votes: Map<String, String>.from(_votes),
      verdict: verdict,
    );
    _applyVerdict(verdict);
    notifyListeners();
    _broadcast();
  }

  void endJnimRound() {
    final MultiplayerVerdict verdict = _buildVerdictJnim();
    _snapshot = _snapshot.copyWith(
      phase: MultiplayerPhase.revealed,
      votes: Map<String, String>.from(_votes),
      verdict: verdict,
    );
    _applyVerdict(verdict);
    notifyListeners();
    _broadcast();
  }

  MultiplayerVerdict _buildVerdict() {
    switch (_currentModeId) {
      case 'tu_preferes':
        return _buildVerdictPreferes();
      case 'qui_pourrait':
        return _buildVerdictQuiPourrait();
      case 'je_nai_jamais':
        return _buildVerdictJnim();
      default:
        return const MultiplayerVerdict(loserIds: <String>[], summary: '');
    }
  }

  MultiplayerVerdict _buildVerdictPreferes() {
    int votesA = 0;
    int votesB = 0;
    for (final String choice in _votes.values) {
      if (choice == '0') {
        votesA++;
      } else if (choice == '1') {
        votesB++;
      }
    }
    final bool tie = votesA == votesB;
    final int losingSide = tie ? -1 : (votesA < votesB ? 0 : 1);
    final List<String> loserIds = <String>[
      for (final MapEntry<String, String> e in _votes.entries)
        if (tie || e.value == '$losingSide') e.key,
    ];
    final int sanction = session.cappedSips(session.rules.prefereMinority);
    final String summary = tie
        ? 'Égalité parfaite · tout le monde boit'
        : 'La minorité boit ${session.sanctionLabel(sanction)}';
    return MultiplayerVerdict(
      loserIds: loserIds,
      summary: summary,
      extraJson: <String, dynamic>{
        'votesA': votesA,
        'votesB': votesB,
        'losingSide': losingSide,
      },
    );
  }

  MultiplayerVerdict _buildVerdictQuiPourrait() {
    final Map<String, int> tally = <String, int>{};
    for (final String targetId in _votes.values) {
      tally[targetId] = (tally[targetId] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    int best = 0;
    for (final int v in tally.values) {
      if (v > best) best = v;
    }
    final List<String> designated = best == 0
        ? const <String>[]
        : <String>[
            for (final MapEntry<String, int> e in tally.entries)
              if (e.value == best) e.key,
          ];
    final int sanction = session.cappedSips(session.rules.quiDesigne);
    final String summary = designated.isEmpty
        ? 'Personne n’a été désigné'
        : designated.length > 1
            ? 'Ex æquo · $sanction chacun'
            : session.sanctionLabel(sanction);
    return MultiplayerVerdict(
      loserIds: designated,
      summary: summary,
      extraJson: <String, dynamic>{'tally': tally},
    );
  }

  MultiplayerVerdict _buildVerdictJnim() {
    final List<String> concerned = <String>[
      for (final MapEntry<String, String> e in _votes.entries)
        if (e.value == 'marked') e.key,
    ];
    final int sanction = session.cappedSips(session.rules.jamaisConcerned);
    final String summary = concerned.isEmpty
        ? 'Personne n’est concerné'
        : concerned.length == 1
            ? '1 personne sur ${_players.length} est concernée'
            : '${concerned.length} sur ${_players.length} sont concernés';
    return MultiplayerVerdict(
      loserIds: concerned,
      summary: summary,
      extraJson: <String, dynamic>{
        'total': _players.length,
        'sanction': sanction,
      },
    );
  }

  void _applyVerdict(MultiplayerVerdict verdict) {
    if (verdict.loserIds.isEmpty) return;
    final int sips = switch (_currentModeId) {
      'qui_pourrait' => session.rules.quiDesigne,
      'je_nai_jamais' => session.rules.jamaisConcerned,
      _ => session.rules.prefereMinority,
    };
    for (final String id in verdict.loserIds) {
      final Player? player = _playerById(id);
      if (player == null) continue;
      session.recordSips(player, sips);
    }
  }

  void startGame({
    required Map<String, GameSession> sessions,
    required String modeId,
    required bool multiGame,
  }) {
    _sessions = sessions;
    _modeIds = sessions.keys.toList();
    _multiGame = multiGame;
    _currentModeId = modeId;

    for (final GameSession s in _sessions.values) {
      _wireSession(s);
    }

    _voterIndex = 0;
    _votes.clear();
    _privateCard = null;

    if (_currentModeId == 'action_ou_verite') {
      _activePlayerId = _players.isEmpty ? null : _players.first.id;
      _snapshot = MultiplayerSnapshot(
        modeId: _currentModeId,
        turn: session.turn,
        players: _snapshot.players,
        phase: MultiplayerPhase.waiting,
        currentCard: null,
        voterIndex: 0,
        votes: const <String, String>{},
        activePlayerId: _activePlayerId,
        activeKind: null,
        verdict: null,
      );
      notifyListeners();
      _broadcast(extra: <String, dynamic>{'event': 'game_started'});
      return;
    }

    _activePlayerId = null;
    session.next();
    _rebuildSnapshot();
    _broadcast(extra: <String, dynamic>{'event': 'game_started'});
  }

  void nextRound() {
    _voterIndex = 0;
    _votes.clear();
    _privateCard = null;

    if (_multiGame) {
      _currentModeId = _modeIds[_random.nextInt(_modeIds.length)];
    }

    if (_currentModeId == 'action_ou_verite') {
      final int currentIndex = _players.indexWhere(
        (Player p) => p.id == _activePlayerId,
      );
      final int nextIndex = currentIndex < 0
          ? 0
          : (currentIndex + 1) % _players.length;
      _activePlayerId = _players[nextIndex].id;

      _snapshot = MultiplayerSnapshot(
        modeId: _currentModeId,
        turn: session.turn,
        players: _snapshot.players,
        phase: MultiplayerPhase.waiting,
        currentCard: null,
        voterIndex: 0,
        votes: const <String, String>{},
        activePlayerId: _activePlayerId,
        activeKind: null,
        verdict: null,
      );
      notifyListeners();
      _broadcast();
      return;
    }

    _activePlayerId = null;
    session.next();
    _rebuildSnapshot();
    _broadcast();
  }

  void removePlayer(String playerId) {
    if (playerId == _players.first.id) return;
    final String? peerToRemove = _peerForPlayer(playerId);

    _players.removeWhere((p) => p.id == playerId);
    if (peerToRemove != null) _peerToPlayer.remove(peerToRemove);

    _votes.remove(playerId);
    if (_voterIndex >= _players.length) _voterIndex = 0;

    _rebuildSnapshot();
    _broadcast();
  }

  void endGame() {
    if (isInLobby) return;

    final List<Player> ranked = List<Player>.from(_players)
      ..sort((a, b) => session.sipsOf(b).compareTo(session.sipsOf(a)));

    final List<EveningBadge> rawBadges = computeBadges(session);
    final List<MultiplayerBadgeData> netBadges = rawBadges.map((b) => MultiplayerBadgeData(
      emoji: b.emoji,
      title: b.title,
      detail: b.detail,
      playerId: b.player.id,
      playerName: b.player.name,
      colorValue: b.color.toARGB32(),
    ),).toList();

    final MultiplayerEndData endData = MultiplayerEndData(
      ranking: ranked.map((p) => MultiplayerPlayer(id: p.id, name: p.name, emoji: p.emoji, colorIndex: p.colorIndex, photoBase64: p.photoBase64)).toList(),
      sips: Map<String, int>.from(session.sips),
      badges: netBadges,
    );

    _snapshot = _snapshot.copyWith(
      phase: MultiplayerPhase.finished,
      endGameData: endData,
    );

    notifyListeners();
    _broadcast();
  }

  void resetForReplay() {
    _currentModeId = 'lobby';
    _sessions.clear();
    _modeIds.clear();
    _votes.clear();
    _voterIndex = 0;
    _privateCard = null;
    _activePlayerId = null;
    
    _snapshot = _emptySnapshot('lobby', _players);
    
    notifyListeners();
    _broadcast();
  }

  void _rebuildSnapshot() {
    _snapshot = MultiplayerSnapshot(
      modeId: _currentModeId,
      turn: isInLobby ? 0 : session.turn,
      players: <MultiplayerPlayer>[
        for (final p in _players)
          MultiplayerPlayer(
            id: p.id,
            name: p.name,
            emoji: p.emoji,
            colorIndex: p.colorIndex,
            photoBase64: p.photoBase64,
          ),
      ],
      phase: isInLobby ? MultiplayerPhase.waiting : _phaseFromSession(),
      currentCard: isInLobby ? null : _cardFromSession(),
      voterIndex: _voterIndex,
      votes: Map<String, String>.from(_votes),
      activePlayerId: _activePlayerId,
      activeKind: _snapshot.activeKind,
      verdict: _snapshot.verdict,
      endGameData: _snapshot.endGameData,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  MultiplayerPhase _phaseFromSession() {
    if (_currentModeId == 'je_nai_jamais' ||
        _currentModeId == 'action_ou_verite') {
      return _snapshot.phase;
    }
    if (_voterIndex >= _players.length) {
      return MultiplayerPhase.revealed;
    }
    if (session.current == null) {
      return MultiplayerPhase.waiting;
    }
    return MultiplayerPhase.voting;
  }

  MultiplayerCard? _cardFromSession() {
    if (_currentModeId == 'action_ou_verite') return null;
    final prompt = session.current;
    if (prompt == null) return null;
    return MultiplayerCard(
      id: prompt.id,
      text: prompt.text,
      kind: prompt.kind.name,
      categoryName: prompt.category.name,
      options: prompt.options,
    );
  }

  void _broadcast({Map<String, dynamic>? extra}) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> payload = <String, dynamic>{
      'snapshot': _snapshot.toJson(),
      if (extra != null) ...extra,
    };
    transport.broadcast(
      GameMessage(
        type: 'snapshot',
        senderId: transport.selfId,
        payload: payload,
      ),
    );
  }

  Player? _playerById(String id) {
    for (final Player p in _players) {
      if (p.id == id) {
        return p;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
}

class _Selection {
  const _Selection({this.modeId, this.multiGame = false});
  final GameModeId? modeId;
  final bool multiGame;
}

class HostScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const HostScreen({super.key, required this.hostPlayer});

  final Player hostPlayer;

  @override
  State<HostScreen> createState() => _HostScreenState();
}

class _HostScreenState extends State<HostScreen> {
  static const int _preferredPort = 40404;

  String? _roomCode;
  String? _localIp;
  int? _port;
  LocalTransport? _transport;
  nsd.Registration? _mdnsRegistration;
  String? _error;
  bool _waiting = true;

  HostGameController? _lobbyController;

  _Selection _selection = const _Selection(modeId: GameModeId.tuPreferes);
  bool _launching = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(_start());
  }

  Future<void> _start() async {
    if (kIsWeb) {
      setState(() {
        _waiting = false;
        _error = 'Le mode hôte n’est pas disponible sur le web.';
      });
      return;
    }
    try {
      final String code = RoomCode.generate();
      final ({LocalTransport transport, int port}) host =
          await LocalTransport.startHost(roomCode: code, port: _preferredPort);

      final String? ip = await NetworkInfo().getWifiIP();

      nsd.Registration? registration;
      try {
        registration = await MdnsHelper.register(
          roomCode: code,
          port: host.port,
        );
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('[mDNS] La recherche auto sera indisponible : $e');
      }

      if (!mounted) return;

      setState(() {
        _roomCode = code;
        _port = host.port;
        _localIp = ip;
        _transport = host.transport;
        _mdnsRegistration = registration;
        _waiting = false;
        _error = ip == null ? 'Aucune adresse Wi-Fi détectée.' : null;

        _lobbyController = HostGameController(
          transport: host.transport,
          hostPlayer: widget.hostPlayer,
        );
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _waiting = false;
          _error = '$e';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    final nsd.Registration? reg = _mdnsRegistration;
    if (reg != null) unawaited(MdnsHelper.unregister(reg));
    _lobbyController?.dispose();
    unawaited(_transport?.close());
    super.dispose();
  }

  String get _inviteLink =>
      'culsec://join?ip=$_localIp&port=$_port&code=$_roomCode';

  Widget _gameScreenFor(HostGameController controller) {
    if (_selection.multiGame) {
      return MultiJeuMultiplayerScreen(
        hostController: controller,
        onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
      );
    }
    final GameMode mode = gameModeById(_selection.modeId!);
    return switch (_selection.modeId!) {
      GameModeId.tuPreferes => TuPreferesMultiplayerScreen(
          mode: mode,
          hostController: controller,
          onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
      GameModeId.quiPourrait => QuiPourraitMultiplayerScreen(
          mode: mode,
          hostController: controller,
          onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
      GameModeId.jeNaiJamais => JeNaiJamaisMultiplayerScreen(
          mode: mode,
          hostController: controller,
          onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
      GameModeId.actionOuVerite => ActionVeriteMultiplayerScreen(
          mode: mode,
          hostController: controller,
          onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
    };
  }

  Future<void> _launch() async {
    if (_launching || _transport == null || _lobbyController == null) return;

    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
    setState(() => _launching = true);

    try {
      final Map<String, GameSession> sessions = <String, GameSession>{};
      final List<Player> players = _lobbyController!.players;

      if (_selection.multiGame) {
        for (final GameMode m in kGameModes) {
          sessions[m.slug] = await buildGameSession(
            state,
            m,
            players: players,
          );
        }
        _lobbyController!.startGame(
          sessions: sessions,
          modeId: sessions.keys.first,
          multiGame: true,
        );
      } else {
        final GameMode mode = gameModeById(_selection.modeId!);
        sessions[mode.slug] = await buildGameSession(
          state,
          mode,
          players: players,
        );
        _lobbyController!.startGame(
          sessions: sessions,
          modeId: mode.slug,
          multiGame: false,
        );
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      await Navigator.of(context).push(
        MaterialPageRoute<void>(
          builder: (_) => _gameScreenFor(_lobbyController!),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _launching = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_lobbyController == null && _error == null) {
      return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    }

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Héberger · multijoueur local')),
      body: Center(
        child: _waiting
            ? const CircularProgressIndicator()
            : _error != null
                ? _ErrorView(message: _error!, onRetry: _start)
                : _HostContent(
                    roomCode: _roomCode!,
                    localIp: _localIp,
                    port: _port!,
                    qrData: _inviteLink,
                    lobbyController: _lobbyController!,
                    selection: _selection,
                    launching: _launching,
                    onSelect: (_Selection s) {
                      Haptics.tick();
                      setState(() => _selection = s);
                    },
                    onLaunch: _launch,
                  ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _HostContent extends StatelessWidget {

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:mobile_scanner/mobile_scanner.dart';
import 'package:nsd/nsd.dart' as nsd;
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../models/player.dart';
import '../screens/games/multi_jeu_multiplayer_screen.dart';
import '../services/app_state.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../widgets/avatar_view.dart';
import '../widgets/common.dart';
import 'client_game_controller.dart';
import 'mdns_helper.dart';
import 'room_code.dart';
import 'web_client_transport.dart';
import '../multiplayer/multiplayer_session.dart';

class JoinScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const JoinScreen({super.key, required this.player});

  final Player player;

  @override
  State<JoinScreen> createState() => _JoinScreenState();
}

class _JoinScreenState extends State<JoinScreen> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  final MobileScannerController _scanner = MobileScannerController(
    autoStart: false,
    detectionSpeed: DetectionSpeed.noDuplicates,
    formats: const <BarcodeFormat>[BarcodeFormat.qrCode],
  );

  final TextEditingController _manual = TextEditingController();
  final FocusNode _manualFocus = FocusNode();

  bool _scanning = true;
  bool _torchOn = false;
  bool _cameraReady = false;
  String? _cameraError;
  bool _starting = false;
  bool _returningFromSettings = false;

  ClientGameController? _controller;
  bool _connected = false;
  bool _navigatedToGame = false;
  bool _hostLeft = false;

  nsd.Discovery? _discovery;
  bool _discovering = false;
  List<nsd.Service> _foundServices = <nsd.Service>[];

  String? _savedUri;
  Uri? _lastConnectedUri;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);

    _savedUri = context.read<AppState>().lastGameUri;

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) {
        unawaited(_startCamera());
        unawaited(_startDiscovery());
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _scanner.dispose();
    _manual.dispose();
    _manualFocus.dispose();
    _controller?.dispose();
    final nsd.Discovery? d = _discovery;
    if (d != null) unawaited(MdnsHelper.stopDiscovery(d));
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    switch (state) {
      case AppLifecycleState.resumed:
        if (!_scanning || _connected) return;
        if (_returningFromSettings) {
          _returningFromSettings = false;
          _cameraReady = false;
          unawaited(_startCamera());
        } else if (!_cameraReady) {
          unawaited(_startCamera());
        } else {
          unawaited(_resumeCamera());
        }
      case AppLifecycleState.inactive:
      case AppLifecycleState.paused:
      case AppLifecycleState.detached:
      case AppLifecycleState.hidden:
        break;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _startDiscovery() async {
    if (_discovering) return;
    try {
      final nsd.Discovery discovery = await MdnsHelper.discover();
      discovery.addListener(_onDiscoveryUpdate);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _discovery = discovery;
        _discovering = true;
        _foundServices = List<nsd.Service>.from(discovery.services);
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _onDiscoveryUpdate() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _foundServices = List<nsd.Service>.from(
        _discovery?.services ?? const <nsd.Service>[],
      );
    });
  }

  Future<void> _stopDiscovery() async {
    final nsd.Discovery? discovery = _discovery;
    _discovery = null;
    if (discovery != null) {
      discovery.removeListener(_onDiscoveryUpdate);
      await MdnsHelper.stopDiscovery(discovery);
    }
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _discovering = false;
        _foundServices = <nsd.Service>[];
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _connectToService(nsd.Service service) async {
    final String? ip = MdnsHelper.ipv4Of(service);
    final String code = MdnsHelper.roomCodeOf(service);
    if (ip == null || code.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Ce service n’est pas encore prêt. Réessayez.'),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    await _stopDiscovery();
    unawaited(_scanner.stop().catchError((_) {}));
    final Uri uri = Uri(
      scheme: 'ws',
      host: ip,
      port: service.port,
      path: '/',
      queryParameters: <String, String>{'code': code},
    );
    await _connectWith(uri);
  }

  Future<void> _resumeCamera() async {
    if (_starting) return;
    _starting = true;
    try {
      if (!_scanner.value.isRunning) await _scanner.start();
    } catch (_) {
    } finally {
      _starting = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _startCamera() async {
    if (_starting) return;
    _starting = true;
    try {
      if (_scanner.value.isRunning) await _scanner.stop();
      await _scanner.start();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _cameraReady = true;
        _cameraError = null;
      });
    } on MobileScannerException catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _cameraReady = false;
        _cameraError = _humanReadableError(e);
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _cameraReady = false;
        _cameraError = 'Impossible d’ouvrir la caméra. Réessayez.';
      });
    } finally {
      _starting = false;
    }
  }

  String _humanReadableError(MobileScannerException e) {
    switch (e.errorCode) {
      case MobileScannerErrorCode.permissionDenied:
        return 'L’accès à la caméra a été refusé. Autorisez-le dans les réglages.';
      case MobileScannerErrorCode.unsupported:
        return 'Cet appareil ne supporte pas le scan de QR codes.';
      default:
        return 'Caméra indisponible. Vérifiez qu’aucune autre application ne l’utilise.';
    }
  }

  Future<void> _forceRestart() async {
    setState(() {
      _cameraReady = false;
      _cameraError = null;
    });
    try {
      await _scanner.stop();
    } catch (_) {}
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300));
    await _startCamera();
  }

  Future<void> _connectWith(Uri uri, {String? forcePlayerId}) async {
    try {
      final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
      final String? lastPlayerId = forcePlayerId ?? state.lastPlayerId;

      final WebClientTransport transport = await WebClientTransport.connect(
        uri: uri,
        displayName: widget.player.name,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;

      final ClientGameController controller =
          ClientGameController(transport: transport);
      controller.start(player: widget.player, reconnectPlayerId: lastPlayerId);
      controller.addListener(_onControllerChanged);

      setState(() {
        _controller = controller;
        _connected = true;
        _scanning = false;
        _cameraReady = false;
        _hostLeft = false;
        _savedUri = null;
      });
      unawaited(_scanner.stop().catchError((_) {}));
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Échec de connexion : $e')),
      );
      setState(() {
        _scanning = true;
      });
      unawaited(_startCamera());
      unawaited(_startDiscovery());
    }
  }

  void _onControllerChanged() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final ClientGameController? controller = _controller;
    if (controller == null) return;

    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();

    if (controller.assignedPlayerId != null &&
        state.lastPlayerId != controller.assignedPlayerId) {
      unawaited(
        state.saveMultiplayerSession(
          _lastConnectedUri!.toString(),
          controller.assignedPlayerId!,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (controller.disconnected.value && !_hostLeft) {
      setState(() => _hostLeft = true);
      return;
    }

    final snapshot = controller.snapshot;
    final bool isInLobby = snapshot == null || snapshot.modeId == 'lobby';

    if (!_navigatedToGame && !isInLobby) {
      _navigatedToGame = true;
      Navigator.of(context)
          .push(
        MaterialPageRoute<void>(
          builder: (_) => MultiJeuMultiplayerScreen(
            clientController: controller,
            onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          ),
        ),
      )
          .then((_) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        setState(() {
          _navigatedToGame = false;
          _connected = false;
          _scanning = true;
          _controller?.dispose();
          _controller = null;
        });
        unawaited(_startCamera());
        unawaited(_startDiscovery());
      });
    }
  }

  void _onQrDetected(BarcodeCapture capture) {
    if (!_scanning || _connected) return;
    final List<Barcode> codes = capture.barcodes;
    if (codes.isEmpty) return;
    final String? raw = codes.first.rawValue;
    if (raw == null) return;

    final Uri? parsed = Uri.tryParse(raw);
    if (parsed == null || parsed.scheme != 'culsec') return;

    final String ip = parsed.queryParameters['ip'] ?? '';
    final int? port = int.tryParse(parsed.queryParameters['port'] ?? '');
    final String code = parsed.queryParameters['code'] ?? '';
    if (ip.isEmpty || port == null || code.isEmpty) return;

    _scanning = false;
    unawaited(_scanner.stop().catchError((_) {}));
    unawaited(_stopDiscovery());

    final Uri uri = Uri(
      scheme: 'ws',
      host: ip,
      port: port,
      path: '/',
      queryParameters: <String, String>{'code': code},
    );
    _lastConnectedUri = uri;
    unawaited(_connectWith(uri));
  }

  Future<void> _connectManual() async {
    final String raw = _manual.text.trim();
    if (raw.isEmpty) return;

    final Uri? parsed = Uri.tryParse(raw);
    if (parsed != null && parsed.scheme == 'culsec') {
      final String ip = parsed.queryParameters['ip'] ?? '';
      final int? port = int.tryParse(parsed.queryParameters['port'] ?? '');
      final String code = parsed.queryParameters['code'] ?? '';
      if (ip.isEmpty || port == null || code.isEmpty) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Lien d’invitation incomplet.')),
        );
        return;
      }
      await _stopDiscovery();
      final Uri uri = Uri(
        scheme: 'ws',
        host: ip,
        port: port,
        path: '/',
        queryParameters: <String, String>{'code': code},
      );
      _lastConnectedUri = uri;
      await _connectWith(uri);
      return;
    }

    final String code = RoomCode.normalize(raw);
    if (!RoomCode.isValid(code)) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Code invalide (6 caractères requis).')),
      );
      return;
    }
    await _promptManualIp(code);
  }

  Future<void> _promptManualIp(String code) async {
    final TextEditingController ipController = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController portController =
        TextEditingController(text: '40404');
    final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Adresse de l’hôte'),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            TextField(
              controller: ipController,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.url,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Adresse IP',
                hintText: '192.168.1.42',
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: portController,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[
                FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly,
              ],
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Port'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Connecter'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true || !mounted) return;
    final int? port = int.tryParse(portController.text);
    if (port == null) return;
    await _stopDiscovery();
    final Uri uri = Uri(
      scheme: 'ws',
      host: ipController.text.trim(),
      port: port,
      path: '/',
      queryParameters: <String, String>{'code': code},
    );
    _lastConnectedUri = uri;
    await _connectWith(uri);
  }

  Future<void> _toggleTorch() async {
    try {
      await _scanner.toggleTorch();
      if (mounted) setState(() => _torchOn = !_torchOn);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _pasteFromClipboard() async {
    final ClipboardData? data = await Clipboard.getData('text/plain');
    if (data?.text == null) return;
    _manual.text = data!.text!;
    _manualFocus.requestFocus();
  }

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:shelf/shelf.dart';
import 'package:shelf/shelf_io.dart' as shelf_io;
import 'package:shelf_web_socket/shelf_web_socket.dart';
import 'package:web_socket_channel/web_socket_channel.dart';

import 'game_message.dart';
import 'game_transport.dart';

class LocalTransport implements GameTransport {
  LocalTransport._({
    required this.selfId,
    required this.isHost,
    HttpServer? server,
    WebSocketChannel? client,
  })  : _server = server,
        _client = client;

  @override
  final String selfId;

  @override
  final bool isHost;

  final HttpServer? _server;
  final WebSocketChannel? _client;

  final Map<String, WebSocketChannel> _clients = <String, WebSocketChannel>{};

  final StreamController<GameMessage> _incoming =
      StreamController<GameMessage>.broadcast();

  final StreamController<TransportEvent> _events =
      StreamController<TransportEvent>.broadcast();

  @override
  Stream<GameMessage> get messages => _incoming.stream;

  @override
  Stream<TransportEvent> get events => _events.stream;

  Iterable<String> get connectedPeerIds => _clients.keys;

  static Future<({LocalTransport transport, int port})> startHost({
    required String roomCode,
    int port = 0,
  }) async {
    final String selfId = 'host-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}';

    late final LocalTransport transport;

    final Handler wsHandler = webSocketHandler(
      (WebSocketChannel channel) {
        final String peerId =
            'peer-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}';
        transport.registerClient(peerId, channel);
      },
    );

    HttpServer? server;
    int effectivePort = port;

    if (port != 0) {
      try {
        server = await shelf_io.serve(
          (Request req) {
            if (req.url.queryParameters['code'] != roomCode) {
              return Response.forbidden('Code invalide');
            }
            return wsHandler(req);
          },
          InternetAddress.anyIPv4,
          port,
        );
      } on SocketException {
        effectivePort = 0;
      }
    }

    server ??= await shelf_io.serve(
      (Request req) {
        if (req.url.queryParameters['code'] != roomCode) {
          return Response.forbidden('Code invalide');
        }
        return wsHandler(req);
      },
      InternetAddress.anyIPv4,
      effectivePort,
    );

    transport = LocalTransport._(
      selfId: selfId,
      isHost: true,
      server: server,
    );

    return (transport: transport, port: server.port);
  }

  static Future<LocalTransport> connectToHost({
    required String host,
    required int port,
    required String roomCode,
    String? displayName,
  }) async {
    final Uri uri = Uri(
      scheme: 'ws',
      host: host,
      port: port,
      path: '/',
      queryParameters: <String, String>{'code': roomCode},
    );

    final WebSocketChannel channel = WebSocketChannel.connect(uri);
    await channel.ready;

    final String selfId = 'peer-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}';
    final LocalTransport transport = LocalTransport._(
      selfId: selfId,
      isHost: false,
      client: channel,
    );

    transport._wireClient(channel);

    return transport;
  }

  void _wireClient(WebSocketChannel channel) {
    // Le hello est supprimé ici. C'est le contrôleur qui fait le join_request.
    channel.stream.listen(
      (Object? raw) {
        final GameMessage? msg = GameMessage.tryDecode(raw.toString());
        if (msg != null) _incoming.add(msg);
      },
      onDone: () => _events.add(
        const TransportEvent(
          type: TransportEventType.connectionLost,
          peerId: 'host',
        ),
      ),
      onError: (_) => _events.add(
        const TransportEvent(
          type: TransportEventType.connectionLost,
          peerId: 'host',
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void registerClient(String peerId, WebSocketChannel channel) {
    _clients[peerId] = channel;

    channel.stream.listen(
      (Object? raw) {
        final GameMessage? msg = GameMessage.tryDecode(raw.toString());
        if (msg != null) _incoming.add(msg);
      },
      onDone: () {
        _clients.remove(peerId);
        _events.add(
          TransportEvent(type: TransportEventType.left, peerId: peerId),
        );
      },
      onError: (_) {
        _clients.remove(peerId);
        _events.add(
          TransportEvent(
            type: TransportEventType.connectionLost,
            peerId: peerId,
          ),
        );
      },
    );

    _events.add(
      TransportEvent(type: TransportEventType.joined, peerId: peerId),
    );
  }

  @override
  void broadcast(GameMessage message) {
    final String encoded = message.encode();
    if (isHost) {
      for (final WebSocketChannel c in _clients.values) {
        c.sink.add(encoded);
      }
    } else {
      _client?.sink.add(encoded);
    }
  }

  @override
  void sendTo(String peerId, GameMessage message) {
    final String encoded = message.encode();
    if (isHost) {
      _clients[peerId]?.sink.add(encoded);
    } else if (peerId == 'host') {
      _client?.sink.add(encoded);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    await _incoming.close();
    await _events.close();
    for (final WebSocketChannel c in _clients.values) {
      await c.sink.close();
    }
    _clients.clear();
    await _client?.sink.close();
    await _server?.close(force: true);
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:nsd/nsd.dart' as nsd;

/// Petit helper autour du package `nsd` pour la découverte des parties
/// Cul Sec sur le réseau local.
class MdnsHelper {
  MdnsHelper._();

  static const String serviceType = '_culsec._tcp';
  static const String _defaultName = 'Cul Sec';

  // --- Hôte -----------------------------------------------------------

  static Future<nsd.Registration> register({
    required String roomCode,
    required int port,
    String name = _defaultName,
  }) async {
    // On rend le nom unique en y ajoutant le code de la room
    final String uniqueName = '$name - $roomCode';

    final nsd.Service service = nsd.Service(
      name: uniqueName,
      type: serviceType,
      port: port,
      txt: <String, Uint8List>{
        'room': Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(roomCode)),
      },
    );
    
    try {
      return await nsd.register(service);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[mDNS] Échec de l’enregistrement : $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  static Future<void> unregister(nsd.Registration registration) async {
    try {
      await nsd.unregister(registration);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // --- Client ---------------------------------------------------------

  static Future<nsd.Discovery> discover() async {
    return nsd.startDiscovery(
      serviceType,
      autoResolve: true,
      ipLookupType: nsd.IpLookupType.any,
    );
  }

  static Future<void> stopDiscovery(nsd.Discovery discovery) async {
    try {
      await nsd.stopDiscovery(discovery);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Extrait l'adresse IPv4 d'un service découvert.
  static String? ipv4Of(nsd.Service service) {
    final List<InternetAddress>? addresses = service.addresses;
    if (addresses == null || addresses.isEmpty) return null;
    for (final InternetAddress a in addresses) {
      if (a.type == InternetAddressType.IPv4) return a.address;
    }
    return addresses.first.address;
  }

  /// Extrait le code de partie des TXT records.
  static String roomCodeOf(nsd.Service service) {
    final Object? raw = service.txt?['room'];
    if (raw is String) return raw;
    if (raw is Uint8List) return utf8.decode(raw, allowMalformed: true);
    if (raw is List<int>) return utf8.decode(raw, allowMalformed: true);
    return '';
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class MultiplayerEndScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const MultiplayerEndScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.data,
    required this.isHost,
    required this.onReplay,
    required this.onQuit,
  });

  final MultiplayerEndData data;
  final bool isHost;
  final VoidCallback onReplay;
  final VoidCallback onQuit;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final List<MultiplayerPlayer> podium = data.ranking.take(3).toList();
    final int maxSips = data.sips[data.ranking.first.id] ?? 1;

    return Scaffold(
      body: AmbientBackground(
        primary: AppColors.warning,
        secondary: AppColors.accent,
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: ListView(
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(top: 32, bottom: 16),
                  children: [
                    Center(
                      child: Column(
                        children: [
                          const Icon(Icons.emoji_events_rounded, size: 56, color: AppColors.warning),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          Text('FIN DE LA PARTIE', style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(letterSpacing: 3)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text('Podium', style: context.text.displaySmall),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ).animate().fadeIn().scaleXY(begin: 0.9),

                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),

                    for (int i = 0; i < podium.length; i++)
                      _PodiumRow(rank: i + 1, player: podium[i], sips: data.sips[podium[i].id] ?? 0)
                          .animate().fadeIn(delay: (200 + i * 100).ms).slideY(begin: 0.1),

                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
                    
                    if (data.badges.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      const SectionTitle('BADGES DE LA SOIRÉE'),
                      Wrap(
                        spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                        runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                        children: [
                          for (final b in data.badges)
                            _BadgeTile(badge: b).animate().fadeIn(delay: (500 + data.badges.indexOf(b) * 80).ms).scaleXY(begin: 0.8),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],

                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
                    
                    const SectionTitle('CLASSEMENT COMPLET'),
                    for (final p in data.ranking)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                        child: _RankRow(
                          player: p,
                          sips: data.sips[p.id] ?? 0,
                          maxSips: maxSips,
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              
              Padding(
                padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(top: 8, bottom: 16),
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    if (isHost)
                      AppButton(
                        label: 'Rejouer avec ce groupe',
                        icon: Icons.replay_rounded,
                        color: AppColors.accent,
                        onPressed: onReplay,
                      )
                    else
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: colors.fill,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.md),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                          children: [
                            const SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2)),
                            const SizedBox(width: 12),
                            Text('En attente de l’hôte…', style: context.text.bodyMedium),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: onQuit,
                      child: const Text('Quitter la partie'),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../models/player.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../services/haptics.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../widgets/ambient_background.dart';
import '../widgets/app_transitions.dart';
import '../widgets/avatar_view.dart';
import '../widgets/common.dart';
import 'create_character_screen.dart';
import 'host_screen.dart';
import 'join_screen.dart';
import 'online_lobby_screen.dart';

class MultiplayerHomeScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const MultiplayerHomeScreen({super.key});

  static const Color _accent = Color(0xFF38BDF8);
  static const Color _accentAlt = Color(0xFF8B7BFF);
  static const Color _onlineColor = Color(0xFF4ADE80);

  Future<void> _onlineMode(BuildContext context) async {
    Haptics.medium();
    
    if (AuthService.instance.isAnonymous) {
      await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
        context: context,
        isScrollControlled: true,
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        builder: (_) => const _RequireAccountSheet(),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!context.mounted) return;

    // 1. Afficher un indicateur de chargement
    unawaited(
      showDialog(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: false,
        builder: (ctx) {
          final colors = ctx.culColors;
          return Dialog(
            backgroundColor: colors.surfaceTop,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.md)),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.xl),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  const CircularProgressIndicator(color: _onlineColor),
                  const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
                  Text('Chargement du profil…', style: ctx.text.bodyMedium),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );

    // 2. Récupération du profil Firestore
    final String uid = AuthService.instance.uid!;
    Player? existingPlayer;
    
    try {
      final doc = await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(uid).get();
      if (doc.exists) {
        final data = doc.data()!;
        existingPlayer = Player(
          id: uid,
          name: data['name'] ?? 'Joueur',
          emoji: data['emoji'] ?? '🎉',
          colorIndex: data['colorIndex'] ?? 0,
          photoBase64: data['photoBase64'],
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Erreur chargement profil: $e');
    }

    if (context.mounted) {
      Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).pop(); // Fermer le loader
    }

    if (!context.mounted) return;

    // 3. Si le joueur existe, on lui demande s'il veut le garder
    Player? finalPlayer = existingPlayer;

    if (existingPlayer != null) {
      final bool? keepProfile = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (ctx) {
          final colors = ctx.culColors;
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: colors.surfaceTop,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.lg)),
            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.lg),
            content: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text(
                  'Bon retour !',
                  style: ctx.text.headlineMedium,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
                AvatarView.fromPlayer(existingPlayer!, size: 80),
                const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
                Text(
                  existingPlayer.name,
                  style: ctx.text.titleLarge?.copyWith(color: existingPlayer.color),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
                Text(
                  'C’est bien toi ?',
                  style: ctx.text.bodyMedium,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            actionsAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceEvenly,
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false), // Va modifier
                child: const Text('Changer de profil'),
              ),
              FilledButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true), // Garde le profil
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: _onlineColor),
                child: const Text('C\'est moi !'),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      );

      if (keepProfile == null) return; // L'utilisateur a annulé (clic en dehors)

      if (keepProfile == false) {
        // L'utilisateur veut modifier son profil -> on efface le profil existant
        // pour forcer la création, mais on passe quand même existingPlayer pour pré-remplir
        finalPlayer = null; 
      }
    }

    // 4. Menu de choix Héberger / Rejoindre
    if (!context.mounted) return;
    final bool? isHosting = await showModalBottomSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) {
        final colors = ctx.culColors;
        return Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: colors.surfaceTop,
            borderRadius: AppRadii.sheet,
            border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: colors.border)),
          ),
          padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
            top: AppSpacing.md,
            bottom: AppSpacing.xl + MediaQuery.paddingOf(ctx).bottom,
          ),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              Center(
                child: Container(
                  width: 38,
                  height: 4,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: colors.border,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
              Text(
                'Partie en ligne',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: ctx.text.headlineMedium,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
              AppButton(
                label: 'Héberger une partie',
                icon: Icons.wifi_tethering_rounded,
                color: _onlineColor,
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
              AppButton(
                label: 'Rejoindre une partie',
                icon: Icons.login_rounded,
                primary: false,
                color: _onlineColor,
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );

    if (isHosting == null || !context.mounted) return;

    // 5. Création ou récupération du personnage
    Player? player = finalPlayer;
    
    // Si pas de joueur, ou si le joueur a décidé de changer de profil
    if (player == null) {
      player = await Navigator.of(context).push<Player>(
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (_) => CreateCharacterScreen(
            title: isHosting ? 'Ton personnage (Hôte)' : 'Ton personnage',
            buttonLabel: isHosting ? 'Héberger' : 'Chercher la partie',
            initialPlayer: existingPlayer, // On pré-remplit avec l'ancien profil s'il existe
          ),
        ),
      );
      
      if (player == null || !context.mounted) return;

      // On sauvegarde (ou met à jour) le profil dans Firestore
      try {
        await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(uid).set({
          'name': player.name,
          'emoji': player.emoji,
          'colorIndex': player.colorIndex,
          'photoBase64': player.photoBase64,
        });
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('Erreur sauvegarde profil: $e');
      }
    }

    if (!context.mounted) return;

    // 6. Navigation finale
    if (isHosting) {
      Navigator.push(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => OnlineHostScreen(hostPlayer: player!)),
      );
    } else {
      Navigator.push(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => OnlineJoinScreen(player: player!)),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _host(BuildContext context) async {
    final Player? player = await Navigator.of(context).push<Player>(
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => const CreateCharacterScreen(
          title: 'Ton personnage',
          buttonLabel: 'Héberger la partie',
        ),
      ),
    );
    
    if (player == null || !context.mounted) return;
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      ForwardRoute<void>(builder: (_) => HostScreen(hostPlayer: player)),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _join(BuildContext context) async {
    final Player? player = await Navigator.of(context).push<Player>(
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => const CreateCharacterScreen(
          title: 'Ton personnage',
          buttonLabel: 'Chercher une partie',
        ),
      ),
    );
    
    if (player == null || !context.mounted) return;
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      ForwardRoute<void>(builder: (_) => JoinScreen(player: player)),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: AmbientBackground(
        primary: _accent,
        secondary: _accentAlt,
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: <Widget>[
              AppHeader(
                title: 'Multijoueur',
                subtitle: 'Chacun son téléphone',
                onBack: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: ListView(
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
                    top: AppSpacing.lg,
                    bottom: AppSpacing.xl,
                  ),
                  children: <Widget>[
                    const SectionTitle('EN LIGNE'),
                    _ActionCard(
                      icon: Icons.language_rounded,
                      title: 'Partie en ligne',
                      subtitle: 'Jouer avec des amis à distance',
                      color: _onlineColor,
                      onTap: () => _onlineMode(context),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
                    
                    const SectionTitle('RÉSEAU LOCAL'),
                    Text(
                      'Un appareil héberge la partie et affiche un QR code. '
                      'Les autres le scannent pour le rejoindre. Tout se '
                      'passe sur le réseau local — Wi-Fi ou partage de '
                      'connexion — sans aucune connexion Internet.',
                      style: context.text.bodyLarge,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
                    _ActionCard(
                      icon: Icons.wifi_tethering_rounded,
                      title: 'Héberger (Local)',
                      subtitle: 'Crée la partie et affiche le code d’appairage.',
                      color: _accent,
                      onTap: () => _host(context),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
                    _ActionCard(
                      icon: Icons.qr_code_scanner_rounded,
                      title: 'Rejoindre (Local)',
                      subtitle: 'Scanne le QR code ou cherche les parties à proximité.',
                      color: _accentAlt,
                      onTap: () => _join(context),
                    ),
                    
                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
                    const _Hint(
                      text: 'Tous les appareils doivent être sur le même réseau '
                          'Wi-Fi. En l’absence de box, active le partage de '
                          'connexion sur un des téléphones.',
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _RequireAccountSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const _RequireAccountSheet();

  @override
  State<_RequireAccountSheet> createState() => _RequireAccountSheetState();
}

class _RequireAccountSheetState extends State<_RequireAccountSheet> {
  bool _loading = false;

  Future<void> _login() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);
    Haptics.medium();
    final result = await AuthService.instance.linkWithGoogle();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _loading = false);
      if (result != null) {
        await Haptics.success();
        if (mounted) {
          Navigator.pop(context);
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(content: Text('Compte connecté ! Tu peux rejouer en ligne.')),
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: colors.surfaceTop,
        borderRadius: AppRadii.sheet,
        border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: colors.border)),
      ),
      padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
        top: AppSpacing.md,
        bottom: AppSpacing.lg + MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom,
      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Center(
            child: Container(
              width: 38,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: colors.border,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
          const Icon(Icons.lock_person_rounded, size: 64, color: AppColors.warning),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
          Text(
            'Compte requis',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.headlineMedium,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Text(
            'Pour jouer en ligne avec tes amis à distance, tu dois créer un compte. '
            'Cela permet de sauvegarder tes statistiques et de te reconnecter facilement.',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.bodyMedium,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
          GoogleSignInButton(
            loading: _loading,
            onPressed: _login,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            child: const Text('Plus tard'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

            Icons.chevron_right_rounded,

            color: context.culColors.textMuted,

import 'dart:convert';

class MultiplayerSnapshot {
  const MultiplayerSnapshot({
    required this.modeId,
    required this.turn,
    required this.players,
    required this.phase,
    required this.currentCard,
    required this.voterIndex,
    required this.votes,
    this.activePlayerId,
    this.activeKind,
    this.verdict,
    this.endGameData,
  });

  final String modeId;
  final int turn;
  final List<MultiplayerPlayer> players;
  final MultiplayerPhase phase;
  final MultiplayerCard? currentCard;
  final int voterIndex;
  final Map<String, String> votes;
  final String? activePlayerId;
  final String? activeKind;
  final MultiplayerVerdict? verdict;
  final MultiplayerEndData? endGameData;

  static const Object _sentinel = Object();

  MultiplayerSnapshot copyWith({
    String? modeId,
    int? turn,
    MultiplayerPhase? phase,
    MultiplayerCard? currentCard,
    bool clearCurrentCard = false,
    int? voterIndex,
    Map<String, String>? votes,
    Object? activePlayerId = _sentinel,
    Object? activeKind = _sentinel,
    Object? verdict = _sentinel,
    Object? endGameData = _sentinel,
  }) =>
      MultiplayerSnapshot(
        modeId: modeId ?? this.modeId,
        turn: turn ?? this.turn,
        players: players,
        phase: phase ?? this.phase,
        currentCard: clearCurrentCard ? null : (currentCard ?? this.currentCard),
        voterIndex: voterIndex ?? this.voterIndex,
        votes: votes ?? this.votes,
        activePlayerId: identical(activePlayerId, _sentinel)
            ? this.activePlayerId
            : activePlayerId as String?,
        activeKind: identical(activeKind, _sentinel)
            ? this.activeKind
            : activeKind as String?,
        verdict: identical(verdict, _sentinel)
            ? this.verdict
            : verdict as MultiplayerVerdict?,
        endGameData: identical(endGameData, _sentinel)
            ? this.endGameData
            : endGameData as MultiplayerEndData?,
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => <String, dynamic>{
        'modeId': modeId,
        'turn': turn,
        'players': players.map((MultiplayerPlayer p) => p.toJson()).toList(),
        'phase': phase.name,
        'currentCard': currentCard?.toJson(),
        'voterIndex': voterIndex,
        'votes': votes,
        if (activePlayerId != null) 'activePlayerId': activePlayerId,
        if (activeKind != null) 'activeKind': activeKind,
        'verdict': verdict?.toJson(),
        if (endGameData != null) 'endGameData': endGameData!.toJson(),
      };

  factory MultiplayerSnapshot.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final Object? rawPlayers = json['players'];
    final Object? rawCard = json['currentCard'];
    final Object? rawVotes = json['votes'];
    final Object? rawVerdict = json['verdict'];
    final Object? rawEnd = json['endGameData'];

    return MultiplayerSnapshot(
      modeId: json['modeId'] as String? ?? '',
      turn: (json['turn'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      players: rawPlayers is List
          ? rawPlayers
              .whereType<Map<String, dynamic>>()
              .map(MultiplayerPlayer.fromJson)
              .toList()
          : const <MultiplayerPlayer>[],
      phase: MultiplayerPhase.fromName(json['phase'] as String?),
      currentCard: rawCard is Map<String, dynamic>
          ? MultiplayerCard.fromJson(rawCard)
          : null,
      voterIndex: (json['voterIndex'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      votes: rawVotes is Map
          ? <String, String>{
              for (final MapEntry<dynamic, dynamic> e in rawVotes.entries)
                e.key.toString(): e.value.toString(),
            }
          : <String, String>{},
      activePlayerId: json['activePlayerId'] as String?,
      activeKind: json['activeKind'] as String?,
      verdict: rawVerdict is Map<String, dynamic>
          ? MultiplayerVerdict.fromJson(rawVerdict)
          : null,
      endGameData: rawEnd is Map<String, dynamic>
          ? MultiplayerEndData.fromJson(rawEnd)
          : null,
    );
  }

  String encode() => jsonEncode(toJson());

  static MultiplayerSnapshot? tryDecode(String raw) {
    try {
      final Object? decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is! Map<String, dynamic>) return null;
      return MultiplayerSnapshot.fromJson(decoded);
    } on FormatException {
      return null;
    }
  }
}

enum MultiplayerPhase {
  waiting,
  voting,
  revealed,
  finished;

  static MultiplayerPhase fromName(String? name) {
    for (final MultiplayerPhase p in MultiplayerPhase.values) {
      if (p.name == name) return p;
    }
    return MultiplayerPhase.waiting;
  }
}

          : const <String, dynamic>{},

class MultiplayerEndData {
  const MultiplayerEndData({
    required this.ranking,
    required this.sips,
    required this.badges,
  });

  final List<MultiplayerPlayer> ranking;
  final Map<String, int> sips;
  final List<MultiplayerBadgeData> badges;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => <String, dynamic>{
        'ranking': ranking.map((p) => p.toJson()).toList(),
        'sips': sips,
        'badges': badges.map((b) => b.toJson()).toList(),
      };

  factory MultiplayerEndData.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final Object? rawRanking = json['ranking'];
    final Object? rawSips = json['sips'];
    final Object? rawBadges = json['badges'];

    return MultiplayerEndData(
      ranking: rawRanking is List
          ? rawRanking
              .whereType<Map<String, dynamic>>()
              .map(MultiplayerPlayer.fromJson)
              .toList()
          : const <MultiplayerPlayer>[],
      sips: rawSips is Map
          ? <String, int>{
              for (final MapEntry<dynamic, dynamic> e in rawSips.entries)
                e.key.toString(): (e.value as num).toInt(),
            }
          : const <String, int>{},
      badges: rawBadges is List
          ? rawBadges
              .whereType<Map<String, dynamic>>()
              .map(MultiplayerBadgeData.fromJson)
              .toList()
          : const <MultiplayerBadgeData>[],
    );
  }
}
