class OnlineHostScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const OnlineHostScreen({super.key, required this.hostPlayer});

  final Player hostPlayer;

  @override
  State<OnlineHostScreen> createState() => _OnlineHostScreenState();
}

class _OnlineHostScreenState extends State<OnlineHostScreen> {
  String? _roomCode;
  FirestoreTransport? _transport;
  HostGameController? _controller;
  String? _error;
  bool _starting = true;
  bool _launching = false;

  _Selection _selection = const _Selection(modeId: GameModeId.tuPreferes);

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(_startHosting());
  }

  Future<void> _startHosting() async {
    final String? uid = AuthService.instance.uid;
    if (uid == null) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _starting = false;
          _error = 'Aucun identifiant Firebase.\nVérifiez votre connexion.';
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      final String code = RoomCode.generate();
      final FirestoreTransport transport = FirestoreTransport(
        selfId: uid,
        isHost: true,
        roomCode: code,
      );
      transport.listenAsHost();

      final HostGameController controller = HostGameController(
        transport: transport,
        hostPlayer: widget.hostPlayer,
      );

      if (!mounted) {
        unawaited(transport.close());
        controller.dispose();
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _roomCode = code;
        _transport = transport;
        _controller = controller;
        _starting = false;
        _error = null;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _starting = false;
          _error = 'Impossible de créer la partie :\n$e';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    final FirestoreTransport? transport = _transport;
    if (transport != null) unawaited(transport.close());
    _controller?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _kick(String playerId) {
    if (_controller == null) return;
    unawaited(Haptics.heavy());
    _controller!.removePlayer(playerId);
  }

  Future<void> _launch() async {
    if (_launching || _transport == null || _controller == null) return;
    if (_controller!.players.length < 2) return;

    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
    setState(() => _launching = true);

    try {
      final Map<String, GameSession> sessions = <String, GameSession>{};
      final List<Player> players = _controller!.players;

      if (_selection.multiGame) {
        for (final GameMode m in kGameModes) {
          sessions[m.slug] = await buildGameSession(
            state,
            m,
            players: players,
          );
        }
        _controller!.startGame(
          sessions: sessions,
          modeId: sessions.keys.first,
          multiGame: true,
        );
      } else {
        final GameMode mode = gameModeById(_selection.modeId!);
        sessions[mode.slug] = await buildGameSession(
          state,
          mode,
          players: players,
        );
        _controller!.startGame(
          sessions: sessions,
          modeId: mode.slug,
          multiGame: false,
        );
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      await Navigator.of(context).push(
        MaterialPageRoute<void>(
          builder: (_) => _screenFor(_controller!),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _launching = false);
    }
  }

  Widget _screenFor(HostGameController controller) {
    if (_selection.multiGame) {
      return MultiJeuMultiplayerScreen(
        hostController: controller,
        onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
      );
    }
    final GameMode mode = gameModeById(_selection.modeId!);
    return switch (_selection.modeId!) {
      GameModeId.tuPreferes => TuPreferesMultiplayerScreen(
          mode: mode,
          hostController: controller,
          onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
      GameModeId.quiPourrait => QuiPourraitMultiplayerScreen(
          mode: mode,
          hostController: controller,
          onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
      GameModeId.jeNaiJamais => JeNaiJamaisMultiplayerScreen(
          mode: mode,
          hostController: controller,
          onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
      GameModeId.actionOuVerite => ActionVeriteMultiplayerScreen(
          mode: mode,
          hostController: controller,
          onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
    };
  }

  Future<void> _confirmLeave() async {
    Haptics.light();
    final bool? leave = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text('Quitter la partie ?', style: ctx.text.titleLarge),
        content: Text(
          'Les joueurs connectés seront déconnectés.',
          style: ctx.text.bodyMedium,
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Rester'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Quitter'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (leave == true && mounted) Navigator.of(context).pop();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (bool didPop, Object? _) {
        if (!didPop) unawaited(_confirmLeave());
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        body: AmbientBackground(
          primary: _onlineAccent,
          secondary: _onlineAccentAlt,
          child: SafeArea(
            child: _starting
                ? _buildLoading()
                : _error != null
                    ? _ErrorView(
                        message: _error!,
                        onRetry: () {
                          setState(() {
                            _starting = true;
                            _error = null;
                          });
                          unawaited(_startHosting());
                        },
                      )
                    : _buildContent(),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLoading() {
    return Center(
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: <Widget>[
          const CircularProgressIndicator(color: _onlineAccent),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
          Text('Création de la partie…', style: context.text.bodyLarge),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildContent() {
    final HostGameController controller = _controller!;

    return Column(
      children: <Widget>[
        AppHeader(
          title: 'Héberger',
          subtitle: 'En ligne · code ${_roomCode!}',
          onBack: () => unawaited(_confirmLeave()),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: ListenableBuilder(
            listenable: controller,
            builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? _) {
              final List<MultiplayerPlayer> players =
                  controller.snapshot.players;
              final bool allConnected = players.length >= 2;

              return SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
                  top: AppSpacing.sm,
                  bottom: AppSpacing.xl,
                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    _CodeCard(code: _roomCode!, color: _onlineAccent),
                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
                    Center(
                      child: BrandedQr(
                        data: 'culsec://join?code=$_roomCode',
                        size: 200,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
                    Center(
                      child: Text(
                        'Scannez pour rejoindre',
                        style: context.text.bodySmall,
                      ),
                    ),

                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
                    SectionTitle(
                      'À TABLE',
                      trailing: '${players.length} / ${players.length}',
                    ),
                    Wrap(
                      alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                      spacing: AppSpacing.md,
                      runSpacing: AppSpacing.md,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        for (int i = 0; i < players.length; i++)
                          _LobbyAvatar(
                            player: players[i],
                            isHost: i == 0,
                            onKick: i == 0
                                ? null
                                : () => _kick(players[i].id),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),

                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
                    const SectionTitle('MODE DE JEU'),
                    Wrap(
                      spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                      runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        for (final GameModeId id in <GameModeId>[
                          GameModeId.tuPreferes,
                          GameModeId.quiPourrait,
                          GameModeId.jeNaiJamais,
                          GameModeId.actionOuVerite,
                        ])
                          _ModeChip(
                            mode: gameModeById(id),
                            selected: !_selection.multiGame &&
                                id == _selection.modeId,
                            onTap: () {
                              Haptics.tick();
                              setState(
                                () => _selection = _Selection(modeId: id),
                              );
                            },
                          ),
                        _MultiGameChip(
                          selected: _selection.multiGame,
                          onTap: () {
                            Haptics.tick();
                            setState(
                              () => _selection =
                                  const _Selection(multiGame: true),
                            );
                          },
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),

                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
                    if (!allConnected)
                      const _Hint(
                        text:
                            'En attente d’un 2ème joueur pour lancer la partie…',
                      ),
                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
                    AppButton(
                      label: _launching
                          ? 'Préparation…'
                          : !allConnected
                              ? 'En attente de joueurs'
                              : 'Lancer la partie',
                      icon: _launching
                          ? null
                          : allConnected
                              ? Icons.play_arrow_rounded
                              : Icons.hourglass_empty_rounded,
                      color: _onlineAccent,
                      onPressed: (allConnected && !_launching)
                          ? () => unawaited(_launch())
                          : null,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
                    Center(
                      child: Text(
                        'Les joueurs doivent saisir le code\n'
                        'ou scanner le QR code.',
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: context.text.bodySmall,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class OnlineJoinScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const OnlineJoinScreen({super.key, required this.player});
  final Player player;

  @override
  State<OnlineJoinScreen> createState() => _OnlineJoinScreenState();
}

class _OnlineJoinScreenState extends State<OnlineJoinScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _codeController = TextEditingController();
  bool _connecting = false;
  
  FirestoreTransport? _transport;
  ClientGameController? _controller;
  bool _navigatedToGame = false;
  bool _hostLeft = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Vérifier si on a une session en cours
    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
    final String? roomCode = state.onlineRoomCode;
    final String? playerId = state.onlinePlayerId;
    
    if (roomCode != null && playerId != null) {
      // On tente de restaurer la session
      _codeController.text = roomCode;
      unawaited(_connect(reconnectPlayerId: playerId));
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _codeController.dispose();
    _controller?.dispose();
    unawaited(_transport?.close());
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _openScanner() async {
    Haptics.light();
    final String? scannedCode = await Navigator.of(context).push<String>(
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => QrScannerView(
          title: 'Scanner la partie',
          color: _onlineAccent,
          onDetect: (BarcodeCapture capture) {
            final String? raw = capture.barcodes.first.rawValue;
            if (raw != null) {
              unawaited(Haptics.success());
              Navigator.of(context).pop(raw);
            }
          },
        ),
      ),
    );

    if (scannedCode == null || !mounted) return;

    final Uri? uri = Uri.tryParse(scannedCode);
    if (uri != null && uri.scheme == 'culsec') {
      final String code = uri.queryParameters['code'] ?? '';
      _codeController.text = code;
    } else {
      _codeController.text = scannedCode;
    }

    unawaited(_connect());
  }

  Future<void> _connect({String? reconnectPlayerId}) async {
    final String code = RoomCode.normalize(_codeController.text);
    if (!RoomCode.isValid(code)) {
      await Haptics.failure();
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Code invalide (6 caractères requis).')),
      );
      return;
    }

    Haptics.medium();
    setState(() => _connecting = true);

    try {
      final FirestoreTransport transport = FirestoreTransport(
        selfId: AuthService.instance.uid ?? 'client',
        isHost: false,
        roomCode: code,
      );

      await transport.join();
      transport.listenAsClient();

      final ClientGameController controller = ClientGameController(transport: transport);
      controller.addListener(_onControllerChanged);
      
      // Si on reconnecte, on passe l'ID du joueur
      controller.start(player: widget.player, reconnectPlayerId: reconnectPlayerId);

      if (!mounted) {
        controller.dispose();
        unawaited(transport.close());
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _transport = transport;
        _controller = controller;
        _hostLeft = false;
      });

      // Sauvegarder la session en cours
      if (controller.assignedPlayerId != null) {
        unawaited(context.read<AppState>().saveOnlineSession(code, controller.assignedPlayerId!));
      }

    } catch (e) {
      await Haptics.failure();
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Échec de connexion : $e')),
      );
      unawaited(context.read<AppState>().clearOnlineSession());
      setState(() => _connecting = false);
    }
  }

  void _onControllerChanged() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final ClientGameController? controller = _controller;
    if (controller == null) return;

    if (controller.disconnected.value && !_hostLeft) {
      setState(() => _hostLeft = true);
      unawaited(context.read<AppState>().clearOnlineSession());
      return;
    }

    final MultiplayerSnapshot? snapshot = controller.snapshot;
    final bool isInLobby = snapshot == null || snapshot.modeId == 'lobby';

    if (!_navigatedToGame && !isInLobby) {
      _navigatedToGame = true;
      Navigator.of(context)
          .push(
        MaterialPageRoute<void>(
          builder: (_) => MultiJeuMultiplayerScreen(
            clientController: controller,
            onQuit: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          ),
        ),
      )
          .then((_) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        setState(() {
          _navigatedToGame = false;
        });
        
        final snap = controller.snapshot;
        if (snap == null || snap.modeId != 'lobby') {
          setState(() {
            _controller?.dispose();
            _controller = null;
            _transport?.close();
            _transport = null;
            _connecting = false;
          });
          unawaited(context.read<AppState>().clearOnlineSession());
        }
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_hostLeft) {
      return Scaffold(
        body: AmbientBackground(
          primary: AppColors.danger,
          child: Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: AppSpacing.screen,
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.link_off_rounded, size: 64, color: AppColors.danger),
                  const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
                  Text(
                    'L’hôte a quitté la partie',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: context.text.headlineLarge,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
                  AppButton(
                    label: 'Retour à l’accueil',
                    color: AppColors.danger,
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    // Si on est connecté mais en salle d'attente
    if (_controller != null && _controller!.assignedPlayerId != null) {
      return _ClientLobbyView(controller: _controller!);
    }

    // Sinon, on affiche l'écran de saisie
    return Scaffold(
      body: AmbientBackground(
        primary: _onlineAccentAlt,
        secondary: _onlineAccent,
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: [
              AppHeader(
                title: 'Rejoindre',
                subtitle: 'En ligne',
                onBack: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(top: AppSpacing.md),
                  child: Column(
                    children: [
                      const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
                      
                      AvatarView.fromPlayer(widget.player, size: 80),
                      const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
                      Text(
                        widget.player.name,
                        style: context.text.headlineLarge?.copyWith(
                          color: widget.player.color,
                        ),
                      ),
                      
                      const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xxl),
                      
                      Text(
                        'ENTRE LE CODE À 6 LETTRES',
                        style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(letterSpacing: 2),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
                      AppCard(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: AppSpacing.md, vertical: AppSpacing.sm),
                        accent: _onlineAccent,

import 'dart:math';

/// Génère un code de connexion à 6 caractères, lisible à voix haute.
///
/// L'alphabet exclut les caractères visuellement ambigus (0/O, 1/I/L)
/// pour éviter les erreurs de saisie quand quelqu'un dicte le code à
/// un autre joueur.
class RoomCode {
  const RoomCode._();

  static const String _alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';

  static final Random _random = Random.secure();

  static String generate() => List<String>.generate(
        6,
        (_) => _alphabet[_random.nextInt(_alphabet.length)],
      ).join();

  /// Normalise une saisie utilisateur : majuscules, sans espaces ni tirets.
  static String normalize(String input) => input
      .toUpperCase()
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\s\-]'), '')
      .split('')
      .where(_alphabet.contains)
      .join();

  static bool isValid(String code) => normalize(code).length == 6;
}

========== DEBUT : lib\multiplayer\web_client_transport.dart ==========
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:web_socket_channel/web_socket_channel.dart';

import 'game_message.dart';
import 'game_transport.dart';

class WebClientTransport implements GameTransport {
  WebClientTransport._({
    required this.selfId,
    required WebSocketChannel channel,
  }) : _channel = channel;

  @override
  final String selfId;

  @override
  bool get isHost => false;

  final WebSocketChannel _channel;

  final StreamController<GameMessage> _incoming =
      StreamController<GameMessage>.broadcast();

  final StreamController<TransportEvent> _events =
      StreamController<TransportEvent>.broadcast();

  @override
  Stream<GameMessage> get messages => _incoming.stream;

  @override
  Stream<TransportEvent> get events => _events.stream;

  static Future<WebClientTransport> connect({
    required Uri uri,
    String? displayName,
  }) async {
    final WebSocketChannel channel = WebSocketChannel.connect(uri);
    await channel.ready;

    final String selfId = 'web-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}';
    final WebClientTransport transport = WebClientTransport._(
      selfId: selfId,
      channel: channel,
    );

    channel.stream.listen(
      (Object? raw) {
        final GameMessage? msg = GameMessage.tryDecode(raw.toString());
        if (msg != null) transport._incoming.add(msg);
      },
      onDone: () => transport._events.add(
        const TransportEvent(
          type: TransportEventType.connectionLost,
          peerId: 'host',
        ),
      ),
      onError: (_) => transport._events.add(
        const TransportEvent(
          type: TransportEventType.connectionLost,
          peerId: 'host',
        ),
      ),
    );

    // Le hello est supprimé ici. C'est le ClientGameController qui gère l'arrivée.

    return transport;
  }

  @override
  void broadcast(GameMessage message) {
    _channel.sink.add(message.encode());
  }

  @override
  void sendTo(String peerId, GameMessage message) {
    _channel.sink.add(message.encode());
  }

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    await _incoming.close();
    await _events.close();
    await _channel.sink.close();
  }
}

import 'package:flutter_animate/flutter_animate.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../data/game_modes_catalog.dart';
import '../models/enums.dart';
import '../models/game_mode.dart';
import '../models/prompt.dart';
import '../services/app_state.dart';
import '../services/haptics.dart';

class CustomCardsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CustomCardsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<CustomCardsScreen> createState() => _CustomCardsScreenState();
}

class _CustomCardsScreenState extends State<CustomCardsScreen> {
  GameModeId _filter = GameModeId.values.first;

  Future<void> _openEditor({Prompt? card}) async {
    Haptics.light();
    final GameModeId? savedIn = await showModalBottomSheet<GameModeId>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => CustomCardEditorSheet(initialMode: _filter, card: card),
    );
    if (savedIn != null && mounted) setState(() => _filter = savedIn);
  }

  Future<void> _exportCards() async {
    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
    final String code = state.exportCustomCards();
    
    if (code.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Aucune carte perso à partager.')),
      );
      return;
    }

    Haptics.medium();
    
    if (!mounted) return;
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Partager mes cartes'),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'Fais scanner ce QR Code par un autre joueur pour lui envoyer tes cartes.',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Center(child: BrandedQr(data: code, size: 240)),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('Fermer'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _importCards() async {
    final String? scannedCode = await Navigator.of(context).push<String>(
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => QrScannerView(
          title: 'Scanner les cartes',
          color: AppColors.accent,
          onDetect: (capture) {
            final raw = capture.barcodes.first.rawValue;
            if (raw != null) {
              Haptics.success();
              Navigator.of(context).pop(raw);
            }
          },
        ),
      ),
    );

    if (scannedCode == null || !mounted) return;

    try {
      final int count = await context.read<AppState>().importCustomCards(scannedCode);
      if (count > 0) {
        await Haptics.success();
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(content: Text('$count carte(s) importée(s) avec succès !')),
          );
        }
      } else {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(content: Text('Aucune nouvelle carte à importer (doublons ignorés).')),
          );
        }
      }
    } on FormatException {
      await Haptics.failure();
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('QR Code invalide ou corrompu.')),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final AppState state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final GameMode mode = gameModeById(_filter);
    final List<Prompt> cards = state.customCardsFor(_filter).reversed.toList();
    final int total = state.customCardCount;

    return Scaffold(
      body: AmbientBackground(
        primary: mode.color,
        secondary: mode.colorAlt,
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: <Widget>[
              AppHeader(
                title: 'Mes cartes',
                subtitle: total == 0
                    ? 'Aucune carte perso pour l’instant'
                    : total == 1
                        ? '1 carte perso'
                        : '$total cartes perso',
                onBack: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                action: total == 0
                    ? null
                    : IconButton(
                        icon: Icon(Icons.qr_code_rounded, color: context.culColors.textSecondary),
                        tooltip: 'Partager mes cartes via QR Code',
                        onPressed: _exportCards,
                      ),
              ),
              SizedBox(
                height: 40,
                child: ListView.separated(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen,
                  itemCount: kGameModes.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                      const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
                  itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int i) {
                    final GameMode m = kGameModes[i];
                    final int count = state.customCardsFor(m.id).length;
                    return _ChoicePill(
                      label: count == 0 ? m.title : '${m.title} · $count',
                      icon: m.icon,
                      color: m.color,
                      selected: m.id == _filter,
                      onTap: () {
                        Haptics.tick();
                        setState(() => _filter = m.id);
                      },
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
              Expanded(
                child: cards.isEmpty
                    ? _EmptyCards(mode: mode)
                    : ListView.separated(
                        padding:
                            AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(bottom: AppSpacing.md),
                        itemCount: cards.length,
                        separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
                        itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int i) =>
                            _CardTile(
                          key: ValueKey<String>(cards[i].id),
                          card: cards[i],
                          mode: mode,
                          onTap: () => _openEditor(card: cards[i]),
                        )
                                .animate()
                                .fadeIn(
                                  delay: (i * 35).ms,
                                  duration: 260.ms,
                                ),
                      ),
              ),
              Padding(
                padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
                  top: AppSpacing.sm,
                  bottom: AppSpacing.md,
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                      child: AppButton(
                        label: 'Scanner',
                        primary: false,
                        icon: Icons.qr_code_scanner_rounded,
                        color: mode.color,
                        onPressed: _importCards,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
                    Expanded(
                      flex: 2,
                      child: AppButton(
                        label: 'Nouvelle carte',
                        icon: Icons.add_rounded,
                        color: mode.color,
                        onPressed: () => _openEditor(),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _CardTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CardTile({
    super.key,
    required this.card,
    required this.mode,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final Prompt card;
  final GameMode mode;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  String get _preview => switch (mode.id) {
        GameModeId.jeNaiJamais => 'Je n’ai jamais ${card.text}',
        GameModeId.quiPourrait => 'Qui pourrait ${card.text}',
        GameModeId.tuPreferes => card.options.length > 1
            ? '${card.options[0]}\nou ${card.options[1]}'
            : card.text,
        GameModeId.actionOuVerite => card.text,
      };

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors; // <-- Ajouté
    final Intensity level = card.intensity;
    final TextStyle? meta = context.text.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontSize: 11.5);

    return AppCard(
      onTap: onTap,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.md),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text(
            _preview,
            style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(height: 1.35),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Icon(level.icon, size: 13, color: level.color),
              const SizedBox(width: 5),
              Text(level.label, style: meta?.copyWith(color: level.color)),
              if (level.isExplicit) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                const AdultBadge(),
              ],
              if (mode.id == GameModeId.actionOuVerite) ...<Widget>[
                _Dot(style: meta),
                Text(
                  card.kind == PromptKind.action ? 'Action' : 'Vérité',
                  style: meta,
                ),
              ],
              _Dot(style: meta),
              Icon(card.category.icon, size: 12, color: colors.textMuted), // <-- Modifié
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  card.category.label,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: meta,
                ),
              ),
              Icon(
                Icons.edit_outlined,
                size: 15,
                color: colors.textMuted, // <-- Modifié
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Dot extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Dot({this.style});

  final TextStyle? style;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6),
        child: Text('·', style: style),
      );
}

class _EmptyCards extends StatelessWidget {
  const _EmptyCards({required this.mode});

  final GameMode mode;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Center(
      child: Padding(
        padding: AppSpacing.screen,
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            Icon(
              mode.icon,
              size: 38,
              color: mode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
            Text(
              'Aucune carte perso pour « ${mode.title} »',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: context.text.titleLarge,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            Text(
              'Blagues internes, prénoms, souvenirs communs : ce sont '
              'souvent les cartes qui marquent le plus une soirée.',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: context.text.bodyMedium,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class CustomCardEditorSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const CustomCardEditorSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.initialMode,
    this.card,
  });

  final GameModeId initialMode;
  final Prompt? card;

  @override
  State<CustomCardEditorSheet> createState() => _CustomCardEditorSheetState();
}

class _CustomCardEditorSheetState extends State<CustomCardEditorSheet> {
  static final RegExp _jamaisPrefix = RegExp(
    r"^\s*je\s+n['’]ai\s+jamais\s*(\.\.\.|…)?\s*",
    caseSensitive: false,
  );
  static final RegExp _quiPrefix = RegExp(
    r'^\s*qui\s+pourrait\s*(\.\.\.|…)?\s*',
    caseSensitive: false,
  );
  static final RegExp _endPunctuation = RegExp(r'[.!?…]$');
  static final RegExp _trailingQuestion = RegExp(r'[\s?]+$');

  late GameModeId _mode = widget.initialMode;
  late PromptKind _kind = widget.card?.kind == PromptKind.verite
      ? PromptKind.verite
      : PromptKind.action;
  late Intensity _intensity = widget.card?.intensity ?? Intensity.normal;
  late GameCategory _category = widget.card?.category ?? GameCategory.amis;

  late final TextEditingController _text = TextEditingController(
    text: widget.card == null || widget.card!.isDilemme
        ? ''
        : widget.card!.text,
  );
  late final TextEditingController _optionA = TextEditingController(
    text: (widget.card?.options.length ?? 0) > 0 ? widget.card!.options[0] : '',
  );
  late final TextEditingController _optionB = TextEditingController(
    text: (widget.card?.options.length ?? 0) > 1 ? widget.card!.options[1] : '',
  );

  bool get _editing => widget.card != null;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    for (final TextEditingController c
        in <TextEditingController>[_text, _optionA, _optionB]) {
      c.addListener(_refresh);
    }
  }

  void _refresh() => setState(() {});

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _text.dispose();
    _optionA.dispose();
    _optionB.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Prompt? _build() {
    final String id = widget.card?.id ??
        '${Prompt.customPrefix}${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}';
    final int sips = switch (_intensity) {
      Intensity.soft => 1,
      Intensity.normal => 2,
      _ => 3,
    };

    switch (_mode) {
      case GameModeId.tuPreferes:
        final String a = _optionA.text.trim();
        final String b = _optionB.text.trim();
        if (a.isEmpty || b.isEmpty) return null;
        return Prompt(
          id: id,
          text: 'Tu préfères…',
          kind: PromptKind.dilemme,
          intensity: _intensity,
          category: _category,
          gorgees: 2,
          options: <String>[a, b],
        );

      case GameModeId.jeNaiJamais:
        String t = _text.text.trim().replaceFirst(_jamaisPrefix, '');
        if (t.isEmpty) return null;
        if (!_endPunctuation.hasMatch(t)) t = '$t.';
        return Prompt(
          id: id,
          text: t,
          kind: PromptKind.statement,
          intensity: _intensity,
          category: _category,
          gorgees: sips,
        );

      case GameModeId.quiPourrait:
        final String t = _text.text
            .trim()
            .replaceFirst(_quiPrefix, '')
            .replaceFirst(_trailingQuestion, '');
        if (t.isEmpty) return null;
        return Prompt(
          id: id,
          text: '$t ?',
          kind: PromptKind.statement,
          intensity: _intensity,
          category: _category,
          gorgees: sips,
        );

      case GameModeId.actionOuVerite:
        final String t = _text.text.trim();
        if (t.isEmpty) return null;
        return Prompt(
          id: id,
          text: t,
          kind: _kind,
          intensity: _intensity,
          category: _category,
          gorgees: sips,
        );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    final Prompt? card = _build();
    if (card == null) return;
    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
    Haptics.medium();
    await state.saveCustomCard(_mode, card);
    if (mounted) Navigator.of(context).pop(_mode);
  }

  Future<void> _delete() async {
    final Prompt? card = widget.card;
    if (card == null) return;
    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
    await Haptics.heavy();
    await state.deleteCustomCard(card.id);
    if (mounted) Navigator.of(context).pop();
  }

  Widget _field(
    TextEditingController controller,
    String hint, {
    TextCapitalization capitalization = TextCapitalization.sentences,
    int maxLength = 160,
    int minLines = 2,
  }) {
    return TextField(
      controller: controller,
      minLines: minLines,
      maxLines: 4,
      maxLength: maxLength,
      textCapitalization: capitalization,
      style: context.text.titleMedium,
      decoration: InputDecoration(hintText: hint, counterText: ''),
    );
  }

  List<Widget> _textFields() {
    switch (_mode) {
      case GameModeId.tuPreferes:
        return <Widget>[
          const _Hint('La carte s’affichera sous « Tu préfères… ».'),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          _field(
            _optionA,
            'Option A — ex. : Ne plus jamais boire de café',
            maxLength: 90,
            minLines: 1,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          _field(
            _optionB,
            'Option B — ex. : Ne plus jamais boire d’alcool',
            maxLength: 90,
            minLines: 1,
          ),
        ];
      case GameModeId.jeNaiJamais:
        return <Widget>[
          const _Hint('La carte commencera par « Je n’ai jamais… ».'),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          _field(
            _text,
            'ex. : dormi dans une gare',
            capitalization: TextCapitalization.none,
          ),
        ];
      case GameModeId.quiPourrait:
        return <Widget>[
          const _Hint('La carte commencera par « Qui pourrait… ».'),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          _field(
            _text,
            'ex. : se perdre dans son propre quartier ?',
            capitalization: TextCapitalization.none,
          ),
        ];
      case GameModeId.actionOuVerite:
        return <Widget>[
          _field(
            _text,
            _kind == PromptKind.action
                ? 'ex. : Imite quelqu’un du groupe jusqu’à ce qu’on devine.'
                : 'ex. : Quel est ton pire souvenir de soirée ?',
          ),
        ];
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors; // <-- Ajouté
    final GameMode mode = gameModeById(_mode);
    final bool valid = _build() != null;

    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom),
      child: Container(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(
          maxHeight: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * 0.9,
        ),
        decoration: BoxDecoration( // <-- Retrait du const
          color: colors.surfaceTop, // <-- Modifié
          borderRadius: AppRadii.sheet,
          border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: colors.border)), // <-- Modifié
        ),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
            top: AppSpacing.md,
            bottom: AppSpacing.lg + MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom,
          ),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Center(
                child: Container(
                  width: 38,
                  height: 4,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration( // <-- Retrait du const
                    color: colors.border, // <-- Modifié
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
              Text(
                _editing ? 'Modifier la carte' : 'Nouvelle carte',
                style: context.text.headlineMedium,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
              const _Label('JEU'),
              Wrap(
                spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                children: <Widget>[
                  for (final GameMode m in kGameModes)
                    _ChoicePill(
                      label: m.title,
                      icon: m.icon,
                      color: m.color,
                      selected: m.id == _mode,
                      onTap: () {
                        Haptics.tick();
                        setState(() => _mode = m.id);
                      },
                    ),
                ],
              ),
              if (_mode == GameModeId.actionOuVerite) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
                const _Label('TYPE'),
                Wrap(
                  spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                  runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    _ChoicePill(
                      label: 'Action',
                      icon: Icons.bolt_rounded,
                      color: AppColors.modeAction,
                      selected: _kind == PromptKind.action,
                      onTap: () {
                        Haptics.tick();
                        setState(() => _kind = PromptKind.action);
                      },
                    ),
                    _ChoicePill(
                      label: 'Vérité',
                      icon: Icons.chat_bubble_outline_rounded,
                      color: AppColors.modePrefereAlt,
                      selected: _kind == PromptKind.verite,
                      onTap: () {
                        Haptics.tick();
                        setState(() => _kind = PromptKind.verite);
                      },
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
              const _Label('TEXTE'),
              ..._textFields(),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
              const _Label('INTENSITÉ'),
              Wrap(
                spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                children: <Widget>[
                  for (final Intensity level in Intensity.values)
                    _ChoicePill(
                      label: level.label,
                      icon: level.icon,
                      color: level.color,
                      selected: level == _intensity,
                      onTap: () {
                        Haptics.tick();
                        setState(() => _intensity = level);
                      },
                    ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
              const _Label('THÈME'),
              Wrap(
                spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                children: <Widget>[
                  for (final GameCategory c in GameCategory.values)
                    _ChoicePill(
                      label: c.label,
                      icon: c.icon,
                      color: mode.color,
                      selected: c == _category,
                      onTap: () {
                        Haptics.tick();
                        setState(() => _category = c);
                      },
                    ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
              Row(
                children: <Widget>[
                  if (_editing) ...<Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                      child: AppButton(
                        label: 'Supprimer',
                        primary: false,
                        icon: Icons.delete_outline_rounded,
                        onPressed: _delete,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
                  ],
                  Expanded(
                    child: AppButton(
                      label: _editing ? 'Enregistrer' : 'Ajouter',
                      icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                      color: mode.color,
                      onPressed: valid ? _save : null,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Label extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Label(this.text);

  final String text;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: AppSpacing.sm),
        child: Text(text, style: context.text.labelMedium),
      );
}

class _Hint extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Hint(this.text);

  final String text;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>
      Text(text, style: context.text.bodySmall);
}

class _ChoicePill extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ChoicePill({
    required this.label,
    required this.selected,
    required this.color,
    required this.onTap,
    this.icon,
  });

  final String label;
  final bool selected;
  final Color color;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final IconData? icon;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors; // <-- Ajouté
    return Pressable(
      scale: 0.93,
      onTap: onTap,
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: AppMotion.base,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: selected ? color.withValues(alpha: 0.18) : colors.fill, // <-- Modifié
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
          border: Border.all(
            color: selected ? color.withValues(alpha: 0.6) : colors.borderSoft, // <-- Modifié
            width: selected ? 1.4 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            if (icon != null) ...<Widget>[
              Icon(
                icon,
                size: 13,
                color: selected ? color : colors.textMuted, // <-- Modifié
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
            ],
            Text(
              label,
              style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                fontSize: 12.5,
                color: selected ? color : colors.textMuted, // <-- Modifié
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_animate/flutter_animate.dart';

class EndScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const EndScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.mode,
    required this.session,
    required this.onReplay,
  });

  final GameMode mode;
  final GameSession session;

  static String _formatDuration(Duration d) {

class _ConfettiLayer extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ConfettiLayer();

  @override
  State<_ConfettiLayer> createState() => _ConfettiLayerState();
}

class _ConfettiLayerState extends State<_ConfettiLayer>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: const Duration(seconds: 6),
  )..repeat();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return IgnorePointer(
      child: RepaintBoundary(
        child: AnimatedBuilder(
          animation: _controller,
          builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) {
            return CustomPaint(
              painter: _ConfettiPainter(progress: _controller.value),
              size: Size.infinite,
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ConfettiPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _ConfettiPainter({required this.progress});

  final double progress;

  static const int _count = 34;
  static const List<Color> _palette = <Color>[
    AppColors.accent,
    AppColors.accentSoft,
    AppColors.warning,
    AppColors.modePrefere,
    AppColors.modeAction,
  ];

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final Paint paint = Paint();

    for (int i = 0; i < _count; i++) {
      final double seed = (i * 7919 % 1000) / 1000;
      final double speed = 0.6 + seed * 0.8;
      final double t = (progress * speed + seed) % 1.0;

      final double x = size.width * seed + math.sin(t * math.pi * 2 + i) * 28;
      final double y = -20 + (size.height + 40) * t;

      paint.color = _palette[i % _palette.length]
          .withValues(alpha: 0.55 * (1 - t).clamp(0.0, 1.0));

      canvas.save();
      canvas.translate(x, y);
      canvas.rotate(t * math.pi * 6 + i);
      canvas.drawRRect(
        RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
          const Rect.fromLTWH(-3, -6, 6, 12),
          const Radius.circular(2),
        ),
        paint,
      );
      canvas.restore();
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _ConfettiPainter old) =>
      old.progress != progress;
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

Future<GameSession> buildGameSession(
  AppState state,
  GameMode mode, {
  SessionScore? score,
  List<Player>? players,
}) async {
  final PromptPack pack = await ContentService.instance.load(mode.id);
  final Set<GameCategory> cats = state.categories;

  List<Prompt> prompts = pack.filtered(state.intensity, categories: cats);

  if (prompts.isEmpty) prompts = pack.filtered(state.intensity);
  if (prompts.isEmpty) prompts = pack.filtered(Intensity.soft);

  return GameSession(
    players: players ?? state.players,
    intensity: state.intensity,
    rules: state.gameRules,
    prompts: prompts,
    maxGorgeesParTour: math.max(pack.maxGorgeesParTour, state.gameRules.highest),
    seenIds: state.seenCards,
    onSeen: state.markCardSeen,
    onForget: state.forgetSeenCards,
    score: score,
  );
}

Widget gameScreenFor(GameMode mode) => switch (mode.id) {
      GameModeId.actionOuVerite => ActionVeriteScreen(mode: mode),
      GameModeId.jeNaiJamais => JeNaiJamaisScreen(mode: mode),
      GameModeId.tuPreferes => TuPreferesScreen(mode: mode),
      GameModeId.quiPourrait => QuiPourraitScreen(mode: mode),
    };

class GameLauncher extends StatefulWidget {
  const GameLauncher({super.key, required this.mode, this.resume});

  final GameMode mode;
  final SavedGame? resume;

  @override
  State<GameLauncher> createState() => _GameLauncherState();
}

class _GameLauncherState extends State<GameLauncher> {
  late final Future<GameSession> _future = _build();

  Future<GameSession> _build() async {
    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);

    final SavedGame? resume = widget.resume;
    final List<Player> players =
        resume?.playersFrom(state.roster) ?? state.players;
    final SessionScore score = resume?.restoreScore() ?? SessionScore();

    final GameSession session = await buildGameSession(
      state,
      widget.mode,
      score: score,
      players: players,
    );
    if (resume == null) await state.incrementGamesPlayed();

    SavedGame.attach(
      state,
      score,
      multi: false,
      modes: <GameModeId>[widget.mode.id],
      players: players,
    );
    session.onRoundComplete = _onRoundComplete;
    return session;
  }

  final EventDeck _events = EventDeck();
  bool _eventShowing = false;

  Future<void> _onRoundComplete() async {
    if (!mounted || _eventShowing) return;
    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
    if (!state.eventsEnabled || !_events.shouldTrigger()) return;
    final GameSession session = await _future;
    final RoundEvent? event = _events.draw(session);
    if (event == null || !mounted) return;
    _eventShowing = true;
    try {
      await showEventDialog(context, session, event);
    } finally {
      _eventShowing = false;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return FutureBuilder<GameSession>(
      future: _future,
      builder: (BuildContext context, AsyncSnapshot<GameSession> snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.hasError) return _ErrorScreen(mode: widget.mode);
        if (!snapshot.hasData) return _LoadingScreen(mode: widget.mode);

        return ChangeNotifierProvider<GameSession>.value(
          value: snapshot.data!,
          child: gameScreenFor(widget.mode),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../models/game_mode.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/client_game_controller.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/host_game_controller.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/multiplayer_session.dart';
import '../../services/haptics.dart';

/// Écran de jeu « Action ou Vérité » en multijoueur local.
class ActionVeriteMultiplayerScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const ActionVeriteMultiplayerScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.mode,
    this.hostController,
    this.clientController,
    this.onQuit,
  }) : assert(
          hostController != null || clientController != null,
          'Il faut au moins un contrôleur (hôte ou client).',
        );

  final GameMode mode;
  final HostGameController? hostController;
  final ClientGameController? clientController;
  final VoidCallback? onQuit;

  bool get isHost => hostController != null;

  Listenable get _listenables =>
      Listenable.merge(<Listenable?>[hostController, clientController]);

  MultiplayerSnapshot? get _snapshot =>
      hostController?.snapshot ?? clientController?.snapshot;

  bool get _iAmActivePlayer {
    final MultiplayerSnapshot? snap = _snapshot;
    if (snap == null) return false;
    final String? activeId = snap.activePlayerId;
    if (activeId == null) return false;
    if (isHost) {
      if (snap.players.isEmpty) return false;
      return activeId == snap.players.first.id;
    }
    return activeId == clientController!.assignedPlayerId;
  }

  MultiplayerCard? get _privateCard =>
      isHost ? hostController!.localPrivateCard : clientController!.privateCard;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: _listenables,
      builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? _) {
        final MultiplayerSnapshot? snapshot = _snapshot;
        if (snapshot == null) {
          return GameScaffold(
            mode: mode,
            onQuit: onQuit,
            child: const _Waiting(),
          );
        }

        return GameScaffold(
          mode: mode,
          onQuit: onQuit,
          turn: snapshot.turn,
          bottom: _buildBottom(snapshot),
          child: AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: AppMotion.base,
            switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
            child: _buildStage(snapshot),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget? _buildBottom(MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot) {
    if (_iAmActivePlayer && snapshot.phase == MultiplayerPhase.voting) {
      final MultiplayerCard? card = _privateCard;
      if (card != null) {
        void refuse() {
          if (isHost) {
            hostController!.refuseAvLocally();
          } else {
            clientController!.refuseAv();
          }
        }

        void redraw() {
          if (isHost) {
            hostController!.redrawAvLocally();
          } else {
            clientController!.redrawAv();
          }
        }

        void done() {
          if (isHost) {
            hostController!.doneAvLocally();
          } else {
            clientController!.doneAv();
          }
        }

        return Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(
              children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                  child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: refuse,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.local_bar_outlined, size: 17),
                    label: const Text('Je bois'),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
                Expanded(
                  child: AppButton(
                    label: 'Fait !',
                    icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                    color: AppColors.modeAction,
                    onPressed: done,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xs),
            TextButton.icon(
              onPressed: redraw,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 15),
              label: const Text('Autre carte'),
            ),
          ],
        );
      }
      return null;
    }

    if (isHost && snapshot.phase == MultiplayerPhase.revealed) {
      return AppButton(
        label: 'Manche suivante',
        icon: Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
        color: mode.color,
        onPressed: () {
          Haptics.light();
          hostController!.nextRound();
        },
      );
    }

    return null;
  }

  Widget _buildStage(MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot) {
    if (snapshot.phase == MultiplayerPhase.waiting) {
      return _ChoosingStage(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('choosing'),
        snapshot: snapshot,
        iAmActivePlayer: _iAmActivePlayer,
        isHost: isHost,
        hostController: hostController,
        clientController: clientController,
      );
    }

    if (snapshot.phase == MultiplayerPhase.voting) {
      return _PlayingStage(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('playing'),
        snapshot: snapshot,
        iAmActivePlayer: _iAmActivePlayer,
        privateCard: _privateCard,
      );
    }

    if (snapshot.phase == MultiplayerPhase.revealed) {
      return _ResolvedStage(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('resolved'),
        snapshot: snapshot,
      );
    }

    return const _Waiting(key: ValueKey<String>('finished'));
  }
}

class _ChoosingStage extends StatelessWidget {

    this.clientController,
  });

  final MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot;
  final bool iAmActivePlayer;
  final bool isHost;
  final HostGameController? hostController;
  final ClientGameController? clientController;

    final String? id = snapshot.activePlayerId;
    if (id == null) return null;

class _PrivateCardView extends StatelessWidget {

            Row(

                    color: color,

                ),
              ],
            ),
            const Spacer(),
            Text(
              card.text,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: context.text.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
                fontSize: size,
                height: 1.25,
              ),
            ),
            const Spacer(),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_animate/flutter_animate.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../../models/enums.dart';
import '../../models/game_mode.dart';
import '../../models/player.dart';
import '../../models/prompt.dart';
import '../../services/game_session.dart';
import '../../services/haptics.dart';
import '../../theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../widgets/avatar_view.dart';
import '../../widgets/common.dart';
import '../../widgets/game_scaffold.dart';
import '../../widgets/intensity_selector.dart';
import 'game_finish.dart';

enum _Phase { handoff, choosing, flipping, revealed }

class ActionVeriteScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ActionVeriteScreen({super.key, required this.mode});

  final GameMode mode;

  @override
  State<ActionVeriteScreen> createState() => _ActionVeriteScreenState();
}

class _ActionVeriteScreenState extends State<ActionVeriteScreen>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin, GameFinishMixin<ActionVeriteScreen> {
  @override
  GameMode get gameMode => widget.mode;

  _Phase _phase = _Phase.handoff;
  PromptKind _kind = PromptKind.action;

  late final AnimationController _flip = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 720),
  );

  int _streak = 0;
  int _bestStreak = 0;
  int _shake = 0;

  bool _resolving = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _flip.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Color get _kindColor => _kind == PromptKind.action
      ? AppColors.modeAction
      : AppColors.modePrefereAlt;

  void _ready() {
    if (_phase != _Phase.handoff) return;
    Haptics.tick();
    setState(() => _phase = _Phase.choosing);
  }

  Future<void> _choose(PromptKind kind) async {
    if (_phase != _Phase.choosing) return;

    Haptics.medium();
    context.read<GameSession>().drawWhere((Prompt p) => p.kind == kind);

    setState(() {
      _kind = kind;
      _phase = _Phase.flipping;
    });

    await _flip.forward(from: 0);
    if (!mounted) return;

    unawaited(Haptics.double());
    setState(() => _phase = _Phase.revealed);
  }

  void _accomplish() {
    if (_phase != _Phase.revealed || _resolving) return;
    final GameSession done = context.read<GameSession>();
    done.bump(
      done.currentPlayer,
      _kind == PromptKind.action ? Stat.gage : Stat.verite,
    );
    Haptics.success();
    setState(() {
      _streak++;
      _bestStreak = math.max(_bestStreak, _streak);
      _phase = _Phase.handoff;
    });
    context.read<GameSession>().advancePlayer();
  }

  void _refuse() {
    if (_phase != _Phase.revealed || _resolving) return;
    final GameSession session = context.read<GameSession>();
    session.recordSips(
      session.currentPlayer,
      session.cappedSips(session.rules.actionRefusal),
    );
    session.bump(session.currentPlayer, Stat.refus);
    Haptics.failure();
    setState(() {
      _streak = 0;
      _shake++;
      _phase = _Phase.handoff;
    });
    session.advancePlayer();
  }

  Future<void> _skip() async {
    if (_phase != _Phase.revealed || _resolving) return;
    _resolving = true;
    try {
      final GameSession session = context.read<GameSession>();
      final bool? drink = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (BuildContext dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text(
            'Une autre carte ?',
            style: dialogContext.text.titleLarge,
          ),
          content: Text(
            'Nouvelle carte : '
            '${session.sanctionLabel(session.rules.actionRedraw)}.',
            style: dialogContext.text.bodyMedium,
          ),
          actions: <Widget>[
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
              child: Text(
                'Tirer · '
                '${session.sanctionLabel(session.rules.actionRedraw)}',
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
      if (!mounted || drink != true) return;
      session.recordSips(
        session.currentPlayer,
        session.cappedSips(session.rules.actionRedraw),
      );
      session.bump(session.currentPlayer, Stat.redraw);
      Haptics.tick();
      session.drawWhere((Prompt p) => p.kind == _kind);
      await _flip.forward(from: 0.5);
    } finally {
      _resolving = false;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final GameSession session = context.watch<GameSession>();
    final Player? player = session.currentPlayer;

    return GameScaffold(
      mode: widget.mode,
      accent: _phase == _Phase.flipping || _phase == _Phase.revealed
          ? _kindColor
          : widget.mode.color,
      onQuit: finishGame,
      bottom: _phase == _Phase.choosing || _phase == _Phase.handoff
          ? null
          : _ResolveBar(
              enabled: _phase == _Phase.revealed,
              color: _kindColor,
              onRefuse: _refuse,
              onSkip: _skip,
              onAccomplish: _accomplish,
              sanction: session.sanctionLabel(
                session.cappedSips(session.rules.actionRefusal),
              ),
              redrawLabel:
                  session.sanctionLabel(session.rules.actionRedraw),
            ),
      child: _phase == _Phase.handoff
          ? _HandoffStage(
              key: ValueKey<String>(
                'handoff-${player?.id ?? 'none'}-${session.turn}',
              ),
              player: player,
              reader: session.nextPlayer,
              color: widget.mode.color,
              onReady: _ready,
            )
          : AnimatedSwitcher(
              duration: AppMotion.base,
              child: _phase == _Phase.choosing
                  ? _ChoiceStage(
                      key: const ValueKey<String>('choice'),
                      player: player,
                      reader: session.nextPlayer,
                      streak: _streak,
                      bestStreak: _bestStreak,
                      shake: _shake,
                      onChoose: _choose,
                    )
                  : _RevealStage(
                      key: const ValueKey<String>('reveal'),
                      flip: _flip,
                      kind: _kind,
                      color: _kindColor,
                      prompt: session.current,
                      player: player,
                    ),
            ),
    );
  }
}

    required this.onTap,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String title;
  final String subtitle;
  final Color color;
  final Color colorAlt;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  State<_HalfChoice> createState() => _HalfChoiceState();
}

class _HalfChoiceState extends State<_HalfChoice>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _ripple = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 540),
  );

  Offset _origin = Offset.zero;
  bool _pressed = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _ripple.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onTapDown(TapDownDetails d) {
    setState(() {
      _origin = d.localPosition;
      _pressed = true;
    });
    Haptics.light();
    _ripple.forward(from: 0);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    return GestureDetector(
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      onTapDown: _onTapDown,
      onTapUp: (_) => setState(() => _pressed = false),
      onTapCancel: () => setState(() => _pressed = false),
      onTap: widget.onTap,
      child: AnimatedScale(
        scale: _pressed ? 0.975 : 1,
        duration: AppMotion.fast,
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: AppMotion.fast,
          width: double.infinity,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: AppRadii.bigCard,
            boxShadow: _pressed
                ? AppShadows.glow(widget.color, opacity: 0.35)
                : AppShadows.card,
          ),
          child: ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: AppRadii.bigCard,
            child: Stack(
              fit: StackFit.expand,
              children: <Widget>[
                DecoratedBox(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                      begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                      end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                      colors: <Color>[
                        Color.lerp(colors.surface, widget.color, 0.22)!,
                        Color.lerp(colors.surface, widget.colorAlt, 0.08)!,
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),

                AnimatedBuilder(
                  animation: _ripple,
                  builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) {
                    if (_ripple.value == 0) return const SizedBox.shrink();
                    return CustomPaint(
                      painter: _RipplePainter(
                        origin: _origin,
                        progress: _ripple.value,
                        color: widget.color,
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),

                Positioned(
                  right: -18,
                  bottom: -22,
                  child: Icon(
                    widget.icon,
                    size: 118,
                    color: widget.color.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                  ),
                ),

                AnimatedContainer(
                  duration: AppMotion.fast,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    borderRadius: AppRadii.bigCard,
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: _pressed
                          ? widget.color
                          : widget.color.withValues(alpha: 0.32),
                      width: _pressed ? 2 : 1.2,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),

                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.lg),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Container(
                        width: 40,
                        height: 40,
                        alignment: Alignment.center,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: widget.color.withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.sm + 2),
                        ),
                        child:
                            Icon(widget.icon, size: 21, color: widget.color),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
                      Text(
                        widget.title,
                        style: context.text.displaySmall?.copyWith(
                          letterSpacing: 1.5,
                          color: colors.textOnAccent, // <-- Modifié (était Colors.white)
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xs),
                      Text(
                        widget.subtitle,
                        style: context.text.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                          color: colors.textOnAccent.withValues(alpha: 0.8), // <-- Modifié
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _RipplePainter extends CustomPainter {
  _RipplePainter({
    required this.origin,
    required this.progress,
    required this.color,
  });

  final Offset origin;
  final double progress;
  final Color color;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final double t = Curves.easeOut.transform(progress);
    final double radius = size.longestSide * 1.15 * t;
    final double alpha = (1 - t) * 0.30;

    canvas.drawCircle(
      origin,
      radius,
      Paint()
        ..shader = RadialGradient(
          colors: <Color>[
            color.withValues(alpha: alpha),
            color.withValues(alpha: 0),
          ],
        ).createShader(Rect.fromCircle(center: origin, radius: radius)),
    );
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _RipplePainter old) =>
      old.progress != progress || old.origin != origin;
}

class _RevealStage extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RevealStage({
    super.key,
    required this.flip,
    required this.kind,
    required this.color,
    required this.prompt,
    required this.player,
  });

  final AnimationController flip;
  final PromptKind kind;
  final Color color;
  final Prompt? prompt;
  final Player? player;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    if (prompt == null) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: AppSpacing.screen,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: <Widget>[
              Icon(
                Icons.inbox_outlined,
                size: 40,
                color: colors.textMuted,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
              Text(
                'Aucune carte de ce type à ce niveau d’intensité.',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: context.text.bodyLarge,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Padding(
      padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(bottom: AppSpacing.sm),
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: flip,
        builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) {
          final double t = Curves.easeInOutCubic.transform(flip.value);
          final double angle = t * math.pi;
          final bool showBack = angle < math.pi / 2;

          return Transform(
            alignment: Alignment.center,
            transform: Matrix4.identity()
              ..setEntry(3, 2, 0.0013)
              ..rotateY(angle),
            child: showBack
                ? _CardBack(kind: kind, color: color)
                : Transform(
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    transform: Matrix4.identity()..rotateY(math.pi),
                    child: _CardFace(
                      kind: kind,
                      color: color,
                      prompt: prompt!,
                      player: player,
                    ),
                  ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../../models/game_mode.dart';
import '../../services/game_session.dart';
import '../../theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../end_screen.dart';
import '../game_launcher.dart';
import '../multi_jeu_screen.dart';

/// Mixin partagé par les écrans de jeu.
///
/// Factorise la sortie de partie : afficher le récapitulatif, puis relancer
/// une manche propre ou revenir à l'accueil.
mixin GameFinishMixin<T extends StatefulWidget> on State<T> {
  /// Le mode joué — à exposer dans chaque écran.
  GameMode get gameMode;

  /// Bascule vers l'écran de fin, en remplaçant l'écran de jeu dans la pile
  /// pour qu'un retour arrière ne ramène pas sur une partie terminée.
  void finishGame() {
    // Multi-jeu : récapitulatif global et relance du même mélange.
    final MultiJeuController? multi = context.read<MultiJeuController?>();
    if (multi != null) {
      multi.finish(context);
      return;
    }

    final GameSession session = context.read<GameSession>();

    Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(
      PageRouteBuilder<void>(
        transitionDuration: AppMotion.slow,
        pageBuilder: (_, __, ___) => EndScreen(
          mode: gameMode,
          session: session,
          onReplay: () => _replay(context),
        ),
        transitionsBuilder: (
          BuildContext context,
          Animation<double> animation,
          Animation<double> secondary,
          Widget child,
        ) {
          final Animation<double> curved = CurvedAnimation(
            parent: animation,
            curve: AppMotion.enter,
          );
          return FadeTransition(
            opacity: curved,
            child: SlideTransition(
              position: Tween<Offset>(
                begin: const Offset(0, 0.06),
                end: Offset.zero,
              ).animate(curved),
              child: child,
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  void _replay(BuildContext context) {
    Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: (_) => GameLauncher(mode: gameMode)),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../models/game_mode.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/client_game_controller.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/host_game_controller.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/multiplayer_session.dart';
import '../../services/haptics.dart';
import '../../theme/app_theme.dart';
