import '../../widgets/common.dart';
import '../../widgets/game_scaffold.dart';

/// Écran de jeu « Je n'ai jamais » en multijoueur local.
class JeNaiJamaisMultiplayerScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const JeNaiJamaisMultiplayerScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.mode,
    this.hostController,
    this.clientController,
    this.onQuit,
  }) : assert(
          hostController != null || clientController != null,
          'Il faut au moins un contrôleur (hôte ou client).',
        );

  final GameMode mode;
  final HostGameController? hostController;
  final ClientGameController? clientController;
  final VoidCallback? onQuit;

  bool get isHost => hostController != null;

  Listenable get _listenables =>
      Listenable.merge(<Listenable?>[hostController, clientController]);

  MultiplayerSnapshot? get _snapshot =>
      hostController?.snapshot ?? clientController?.snapshot;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: _listenables,
      builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? _) {
        final MultiplayerSnapshot? snapshot = _snapshot;

        if (snapshot == null) {
          return GameScaffold(
            mode: mode,
            onQuit: onQuit,
            child: const _WaitingForStart(),
          );
        }

        return GameScaffold(
          mode: mode,
          onQuit: onQuit,
          turn: snapshot.turn,
          bottom: _buildBottom(snapshot),
          child: AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: AppMotion.base,
            switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
            child: _buildStage(snapshot),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget? _buildBottom(MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot) {
    if (!isHost) return null;

    if (snapshot.phase == MultiplayerPhase.voting) {
      return AppButton(
        label: 'Terminer la manche',
        icon: Icons.check_rounded,
        color: mode.color,
        onPressed: () {
          Haptics.medium();
          hostController!.endJnimRound();
        },
      );
    }

    if (snapshot.phase == MultiplayerPhase.revealed) {
      return AppButton(
        label: 'Carte suivante',
        icon: Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
        color: mode.color,
        onPressed: () {
          Haptics.light();
          hostController!.nextRound();
        },
      );
    }

    return null;
  }

  Widget _buildStage(MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot) {
    switch (snapshot.phase) {
      case MultiplayerPhase.waiting:
        return const _WaitingForStart(key: ValueKey<String>('waiting'));
      case MultiplayerPhase.voting:
        return _VotingStage(
          key: const ValueKey<String>('voting'),
          snapshot: snapshot,
          isHost: isHost,
          hostController: hostController,
          clientController: clientController,
        );
      case MultiplayerPhase.revealed:
        return _RevealedStage(
          key: const ValueKey<String>('revealed'),
          snapshot: snapshot,
        );
      case MultiplayerPhase.finished:
        return const _WaitingForStart(key: ValueKey<String>('finished'));
    }
  }
}

class _VotingStage extends StatelessWidget {
  const _VotingStage({
    super.key,
    required this.snapshot,
    required this.isHost,
    this.hostController,
    this.clientController,
  });

  final MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot;
  final bool isHost;
  final HostGameController? hostController;
  final ClientGameController? clientController;

  MultiplayerCard? get _card => snapshot.currentCard;

  String? get _myPlayerId {
    if (isHost) {
      return snapshot.players.isEmpty ? null : snapshot.players.first.id;
    }
    return clientController!.assignedPlayerId;
  }

  bool get _amIMarked {
    final String? id = _myPlayerId;
    if (id == null) return false;
    return snapshot.votes[id] == 'marked';
  }

  int get _markedCount => snapshot.votes.values
      .where((String v) => v == 'marked')
      .length;

  void _toggleMyMark() {
    final String? id = _myPlayerId;
    if (id == null) return;

    if (isHost) {
      if (_amIMarked) {
        hostController!.unmarkJnimLocally();
      } else {
        hostController!.markJnimLocally();
      }
    } else {
      if (!_amIMarked) {
        clientController!.markJnim();
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final MultiplayerCard? card = _card;
    if (card == null) return const _WaitingForStart();

    return Padding(
      padding: AppSpacing.screen,
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          Expanded(
            flex: 5,
            child: _StatementCard(
              card: card,
              markedCount: _markedCount,
              totalPlayers: snapshot.players.length,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
          Text(
            'TE DÉNONCES-TU ?',
            style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
              color: AppColors.modeJamais,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
          _SelfMarkButton(
            marked: _amIMarked,
            onTap: _toggleMyMark,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _SelfMarkButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SelfMarkButton({required this.marked, required this.onTap});

  final bool marked;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    return GestureDetector(
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      onTap: onTap,

          horizontal: AppSpacing.lg,

class _RevealedStage extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RevealedStage({super.key, required this.snapshot});

  final MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot;

  MultiplayerPlayer? _playerById(String id) {
    for (final MultiplayerPlayer p in snapshot.players) {
      if (p.id == id) return p;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final MultiplayerVerdict? verdict = snapshot.verdict;
    if (verdict == null) return const _WaitingForStart();

    final List<MultiplayerPlayer> concerned = <MultiplayerPlayer>[
      for (final String id in verdict.loserIds)
        if (_playerById(id) != null) _playerById(id)!,
    ];

    return Padding(
      padding: AppSpacing.screen,
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Text(
            'VERDICT',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
              letterSpacing: 3,
              color: AppColors.warning,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
          Text(
            verdict.summary,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.headlineLarge,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
          if (concerned.isEmpty)
            Text(
              'Personne ne s’est dénoncé',
              style: context.text.bodyLarge,
            )
          else ...<Widget>[
            Text(
              'CONCERNÉS',
              style: context.text.labelMedium,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
            Expanded(
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Wrap(
                  alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                  spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                  runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    for (final MultiplayerPlayer p in concerned)
                      _PlayerChip(player: p),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _PlayerChip extends StatelessWidget {

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_animate/flutter_animate.dart';

class JeNaiJamaisScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const JeNaiJamaisScreen({super.key, required this.mode});

  final GameMode mode;

  @override
  State<JeNaiJamaisScreen> createState() => _JeNaiJamaisScreenState();
}

class _JeNaiJamaisScreenState extends State<JeNaiJamaisScreen>
    with GameFinishMixin<JeNaiJamaisScreen> {
  @override
  GameMode get gameMode => widget.mode;

  final Set<String> _guilty = <String>{};
  int _cardKey = 0;
  bool _advancing = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) context.read<GameSession>().next();
    });
  }

  void _toggleGuilty(Player player) {
    if (_advancing) return;
    setState(() {
      if (_guilty.contains(player.id)) {
        _guilty.remove(player.id);
        Haptics.tick();
      } else {
        _guilty.add(player.id);
        Haptics.medium();
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _next() async {
    if (_advancing) return;
    setState(() => _advancing = true);
    try {
      final GameSession session = context.read<GameSession>();
      final List<Player> targets = session.players
          .where((Player p) => _guilty.contains(p.id))
          .toList();

      if (targets.isNotEmpty) {
        session.bumpAll(targets, Stat.jamais);
        session.recordSipsForAll(targets, session.rules.jamaisConcerned);
        await Haptics.triple();
      } else {
        Haptics.light();
      }
      if (!mounted) return;

      setState(() {
        _guilty.clear();
        _cardKey++;
      });
      session.next();
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _advancing = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final GameSession session = context.watch<GameSession>();
    final Prompt? prompt = session.current;
    final List<Player> players = session.players;

    return GameScaffold(
      mode: widget.mode,
      onQuit: finishGame,
      bottom: AppButton(
        label: _guilty.isEmpty
            ? 'Personne ? Carte suivante'
            : session.rules.jamaisConcerned == 0
                ? '${_guilty.length} concernés · suivante'
                : '${_guilty.length} ${_guilty.length > 1 ? "boivent" : "boit"} '
                    '${session.sanctionLabel(session.rules.jamaisConcerned)} · suivante',
        icon: Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
        color: widget.mode.color,
        onPressed: _advancing ? null : _next,
      ),
      child: prompt == null
          ? const _EmptyPack()
          : Padding(
              padding: AppSpacing.screen,
              child: Column(
                children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    flex: 5,
                    child: _StatementCard(
                      key: ValueKey<int>(_cardKey),
                      prompt: prompt,
                      mode: widget.mode,
                      guiltyCount: _guilty.length,
                      totalPlayers: players.length,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
                  Text(
                    'COCHEZ CEUX QUI L’ONT DÉJÀ FAIT',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                      color: widget.mode.color,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xs),
                  Text(
                    'Touchez un prénom pour cocher ou décocher.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: context.text.bodySmall,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
                  Expanded(
                    flex: 3,
                    child: SingleChildScrollView(
                      child: Wrap(
                        alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                        spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                        runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          for (int i = 0; i < players.length; i++)
                            _GuiltyChip(
                              key: ValueKey<String>(players[i].id),
                              player: players[i],
                              guilty: _guilty.contains(players[i].id),
                              onTap: () => _toggleGuilty(players[i]),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
    );
  }
}

class _StatementCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _StatementCard({
    super.key,
    required this.prompt,
    required this.mode,
    required this.guiltyCount,
    required this.totalPlayers,
  });

  final Prompt prompt;
  final GameMode mode;
  final int guiltyCount;
  final int totalPlayers;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final bool isAdult = prompt.intensity == Intensity.adulte;

    final int len = prompt.text.length;
    final double size = switch (len) {
      < 45 => 33,
      < 80 => 28,
      < 120 => 23,
      _ => 20,
    };

    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.lg),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topCenter,
          end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
          colors: <Color>[
            Color.lerp(colors.surface, mode.color, 0.16)!,
            colors.surface,
          ],
        ),
        borderRadius: AppRadii.bigCard,
        border: Border.all(
          color: mode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.38),
          width: 1.4,
        ),
        boxShadow: AppShadows.raised,
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: <Widget>[
              Icon(
                prompt.category.icon,
                size: 13,
                color: mode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(
                prompt.category.label.toUpperCase(),
                style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontSize: 10,
                  color: mode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                ),
              ),
              if (isAdult) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
                const AdultBadge(),
              ],
            ],
          ),

          const Spacer(),

          Text(
            'JE N’AI JAMAIS',
            style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
              letterSpacing: 5,
              color: colors.textSecondary, // <-- Modifié
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),

          Text(
            prompt.text,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.displayMedium?.copyWith(
              fontSize: size,
              height: 1.25,
              color: colors.textPrimary, // <-- Modifié
            ),
          )
              .animate()
              .fadeIn(duration: 340.ms)
              .slideY(begin: 0.1, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),

          const Spacer(),

          AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: AppMotion.base,
            child: guiltyCount == 0
                ? Text(
                    'personne pour l’instant…',
                    key: const ValueKey<String>('none'),
                    style: context.text.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontSize: 12),
                  )
                : Row(
                    key: ValueKey<int>(guiltyCount),
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      const Icon(
                        Icons.local_bar_rounded,
                        size: 16,
                        color: AppColors.warning,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 7),
                      Text(
                        '$guiltyCount sur $totalPlayers',
                        style: context.text.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                          color: AppColors.warning,
                          fontSize: 17,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ).animate().scaleXY(begin: 0.8, curve: Curves.easeOutBack),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_animate/flutter_animate.dart';

import '../../data/game_modes_catalog.dart';
import '../../models/enums.dart';
import '../../models/game_mode.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/client_game_controller.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/game_message.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/host_game_controller.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/multiplayer_end_screen.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/multiplayer_session.dart';
import '../../theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../widgets/ambient_background.dart';
import '../../widgets/common.dart';
import 'action_verite_multiplayer_screen.dart';
import 'je_nai_jamais_multiplayer_screen.dart';
import 'qui_pourrait_multiplayer_screen.dart';
import 'tu_preferes_multiplayer_screen.dart';

class MultiJeuMultiplayerScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const MultiJeuMultiplayerScreen({
    super.key,
    this.hostController,
    this.clientController,
    this.onQuit,
  }) : assert(hostController != null || clientController != null, 'Il faut au moins un contrôleur.');

  final HostGameController? hostController;
  final ClientGameController? clientController;
  final VoidCallback? onQuit;

  bool get isHost => hostController != null;

  Listenable get _listenables => Listenable.merge([hostController, clientController]);

  MultiplayerSnapshot? get _snapshot => hostController?.snapshot ?? clientController?.snapshot;

  GameModeId _modeIdFromSlug(String slug) {
    for (final GameModeId id in GameModeId.values) {
      if (id.slug == slug) return id;
    }
    return GameModeId.tuPreferes;
  }

  void _showReactionMenu(BuildContext context) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => Container(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.paddingOf(ctx).bottom + 16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: ctx.culColors.surfaceTop,
          borderRadius: AppRadii.sheet,
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceEvenly,
          children: ['😂', '🔥', '🍻', '😱', '💩'].map((e) => 
            IconButton(
              icon: Text(e, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 32)),
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                if (isHost) {
                  hostController!.transport.broadcast(GameMessage(
                    type: 'reaction', 
                    senderId: hostController!.transport.selfId, 
                    payload: {'emoji': e, 'name': 'Hôte'},
                  ),);
                } else {
                  clientController!.sendReaction(e, clientController!.assignedName ?? 'Joueur');
                }
              },
            ),
          ).toList(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: _listenables,
      builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? _) {
        if (!isHost && clientController?.disconnected.value == true) {
          return Scaffold(
            body: AmbientBackground(
              primary: AppColors.danger,
              child: Center(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen,
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      const Icon(Icons.link_off_rounded, size: 64, color: AppColors.danger),
                      const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
                      Text(
                        'L’hôte a quitté la partie',
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: context.text.headlineLarge,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
                      Text(
                        'La connexion avec l’appareil hôte a été perdue.',
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: context.text.bodyLarge,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
                      AppButton(
                        label: 'Retour à l’accueil',
                        color: AppColors.danger,
                        onPressed: () {
                          Navigator.of(context).popUntil((route) => route.isFirst);
                        },
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }

        final MultiplayerSnapshot? snapshot = _snapshot;

        if (snapshot == null || snapshot.modeId.isEmpty) {
          return _Loader(onQuit: onQuit);
        }

        // --- Retour au lobby après une partie ---
        if (snapshot.modeId == 'lobby') {
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
            if (context.mounted && Navigator.canPop(context)) {
              Navigator.of(context).pop();
            }
          });
          return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
        }

        if (snapshot.phase == MultiplayerPhase.finished && snapshot.endGameData != null) {
          return MultiplayerEndScreen(
            data: snapshot.endGameData!,
            isHost: isHost,
            onQuit: onQuit ?? () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
            onReplay: () {
              if (isHost) {
                hostController!.resetForReplay();
              }
            },
          );
        }

        final GameModeId modeId = _modeIdFromSlug(snapshot.modeId);
        final GameMode mode = gameModeById(modeId);

        return Stack(
          children: [
            Positioned.fill(
              child: KeyedSubtree(
                key: ValueKey<String>('mode-${snapshot.modeId}'),
                child: switch (modeId) {
                  GameModeId.tuPreferes => TuPreferesMultiplayerScreen(mode: mode, hostController: hostController, clientController: clientController, onQuit: onQuit),
                  GameModeId.quiPourrait => QuiPourraitMultiplayerScreen(mode: mode, hostController: hostController, clientController: clientController, onQuit: onQuit),
                  GameModeId.jeNaiJamais => JeNaiJamaisMultiplayerScreen(mode: mode, hostController: hostController, clientController: clientController, onQuit: onQuit),
                  GameModeId.actionOuVerite => ActionVeriteMultiplayerScreen(mode: mode, hostController: hostController, clientController: clientController, onQuit: onQuit),
                },
              ),
            ),

            // Bouton de réaction
            Positioned(
              bottom: 24, right: 20,
              child: FloatingActionButton(
                mini: true,
                backgroundColor: context.culColors.surfaceTop,
                child: const Text('😂', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 24)),
                onPressed: () => _showReactionMenu(context),
              ),
            ),

            // Affichage des emojis flottants
            if (isHost)
              ValueListenableBuilder<Map<String, String>?>(
                valueListenable: hostController!.lastReaction,
                builder: (context, reaction, _) {
                  if (reaction == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
                  return _FloatingEmoji(
                    key: ValueKey(reaction.hashCode),
                    reaction: reaction,
                  );
                },
              )
            else
              ValueListenableBuilder<Map<String, String>?>(
                valueListenable: clientController!.lastReaction,
                builder: (context, reaction, _) {
                  if (reaction == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
                  return _FloatingEmoji(
                    key: ValueKey(reaction.hashCode),
                    reaction: reaction,
                  );
                },
              ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _FloatingEmoji extends StatelessWidget {
  final Map<String, String> reaction;
  const _FloatingEmoji({super.key, required this.reaction});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Positioned(
      top: 100,
      left: 20,
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: Text(
          '${reaction['emoji']} par ${reaction['name']}', 
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 24, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        )
            .animate()
            .slideY(begin: 0, end: -2, duration: 2.seconds)
            .fadeOut(delay: 1.5.seconds),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Loader extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Loader({required this.onQuit});

  final VoidCallback? onQuit;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    return Scaffold(
      body: AmbientBackground(

            children: <Widget>[
              Center(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    const CircularProgressIndicator(color: AppColors.accent),
                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
                    Text('Préparation du multi-jeu…', style: context.text.bodyLarge),
                  ],

              ),
              if (onQuit != null)
                Positioned(
                  top: 8,
                  left: 8,
                  child: AppPill(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    onTap: onQuit,
                    child: SizedBox(
                      width: 24,
                      height: 24,
                      child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 22, color: colors.textSecondary),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import '../../widgets/game_scaffold.dart';

/// Écran de jeu « Qui pourrait… » en multijoueur local.
class QuiPourraitMultiplayerScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const QuiPourraitMultiplayerScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.mode,
    this.hostController,
    this.clientController,
    this.onQuit,
  }) : assert(
          hostController != null || clientController != null,
          'Il faut au moins un contrôleur (hôte ou client).',
        );

  final GameMode mode;
  final HostGameController? hostController;
  final ClientGameController? clientController;
  final VoidCallback? onQuit;

  bool get isHost => hostController != null;

  Listenable get _listenables =>
      Listenable.merge(<Listenable?>[hostController, clientController]);

  MultiplayerSnapshot? get _snapshot =>
      hostController?.snapshot ?? clientController?.snapshot;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: _listenables,
      builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? _) {
        final MultiplayerSnapshot? snapshot = _snapshot;

        if (snapshot == null) {
          return GameScaffold(
            mode: mode,
            onQuit: onQuit,
            child: const _WaitingForStart(),
          );
        }

        return GameScaffold(
          mode: mode,
          onQuit: onQuit,
          turn: snapshot.turn,
          bottom: _buildBottom(snapshot),
          child: AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: AppMotion.base,
            switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
            child: _buildStage(snapshot),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget? _buildBottom(MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot) {
    if (!isHost) return null;
    if (snapshot.phase != MultiplayerPhase.revealed) return null;

    return AppButton(
      label: 'Question suivante',
      icon: Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
      color: mode.color,
      onPressed: () {
        Haptics.light();
        hostController!.nextRound();
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStage(MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot) {
    switch (snapshot.phase) {
      case MultiplayerPhase.waiting:
        return const _WaitingForStart(key: ValueKey<String>('waiting'));
      case MultiplayerPhase.voting:
        return _VotingStage(
          key: ValueKey<String>('voting-${snapshot.voterIndex}'),
          snapshot: snapshot,
          isHost: isHost,
          hostController: hostController,
          clientController: clientController,
        );
      case MultiplayerPhase.revealed:
        return _RevealedStage(
          key: const ValueKey<String>('revealed'),
          snapshot: snapshot,
        );
      case MultiplayerPhase.finished:
        return const _WaitingForStart(key: ValueKey<String>('finished'));
    }
  }
}

class _WaitingForStart extends StatelessWidget {
  const _WaitingForStart({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Center(
      child: Padding(
        padding: AppSpacing.screen,
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            const CircularProgressIndicator(color: AppColors.accent),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
            Text(
              'Préparation de la question…',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: context.text.bodyLarge,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _VotingStage extends StatelessWidget {
  const _VotingStage({
    super.key,
    required this.snapshot,
    required this.isHost,
    this.hostController,
    this.clientController,
  });

  final MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot;
  final bool isHost;
  final HostGameController? hostController;
  final ClientGameController? clientController;

  MultiplayerCard? get _card => snapshot.currentCard;

  MultiplayerPlayer? get _voter {
    if (snapshot.voterIndex >= snapshot.players.length) return null;
    return snapshot.players[snapshot.voterIndex];
  }

  bool get _amIVoter {
    final MultiplayerPlayer? voter = _voter;
    if (voter == null) return false;
    if (isHost) {
      return hostController!.currentVoterIsLocal;
    } else {
      return voter.id == clientController!.assignedPlayerId;
    }
  }

  void _voteFor(MultiplayerPlayer target) {
    if (isHost) {
      hostController!.castVoteLocally(target.id);
    } else {
      clientController!.castVote(target.id);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final MultiplayerCard? card = _card;
    if (card == null) {
      return const _WaitingForStart();
    }

    final MultiplayerPlayer? voter = _voter;
    if (voter == null) {
      return const _WaitingForStart();
    }

    final List<MultiplayerPlayer> targets = snapshot.players
        .where((MultiplayerPlayer p) => p.id != voter.id)
        .toList(growable: false);

    return Padding(
      padding: AppSpacing.screen,
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          _VoterBanner(
            voter: voter,
            amIVoter: _amIVoter,
            totalVoters: snapshot.players.length,
            voterIndex: snapshot.voterIndex,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
          Expanded(
            flex: 3,
            child: _QuestionCard(card: card),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
          Text(
            _amIVoter ? 'TOUCHE TA RÉPONSE' : 'EN ATTENTE…',
            style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
              letterSpacing: 2,
              color: _amIVoter
                  ? AppColors.modeJamais
                  : colors.textMuted,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Expanded(
            flex: 4,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Wrap(
                alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                children: <Widget>[
                  for (final MultiplayerPlayer p in targets)
                    _TargetTile(
                      player: p,
                      enabled: _amIVoter,
                      onTap: () => _voteFor(p),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _VoterBanner extends StatelessWidget {
  const _VoterBanner({
    required this.voter,
    required this.amIVoter,
    required this.totalVoters,
    required this.voterIndex,
  });

  final MultiplayerPlayer voter;
  final bool amIVoter;
  final int totalVoters;
  final int voterIndex;

  static Color _colorFor(int index) =>
      AppColors.playerPalette[index % AppColors.playerPalette.length];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bool waiting = !amIVoter;
    return Column(
      children: <Widget>[
        Text(
          amIVoter ? 'À TOI DE VOTER' : 'EN ATTENTE DU VOTE DE',
          style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(letterSpacing: 3),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
        Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: <Widget>[
            _AvatarFromMultiplayer(player: voter, size: 40),
            const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
            Flexible(
              child: Text(
                voter.name,
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: context.text.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
                  color: _colorFor(voter.colorIndex),
                  fontSize: 22,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        if (waiting) ...<Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xs),
          Text(
            'Patiente quelques secondes…',
            style: context.text.bodySmall,
          ),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xs + 2),
        Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: <Widget>[
            for (int i = 0; i < totalVoters; i++)
              Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 3),
                width: i == voterIndex ? 18 : 8,
                height: 8,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: i < voterIndex
                      ? AppColors.success
                      : i == voterIndex
                          ? _colorFor(voter.colorIndex)
                          : context.culColors.fillStrong,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _QuestionCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _QuestionCard({required this.card});

  final MultiplayerCard card;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final int len = card.text.length;
    final double size = switch (len) {
      < 45 => 24,
      < 80 => 21,
      < 120 => 18,
      _ => 16,
    };

    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.md + 2),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topCenter,
          end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
          colors: <Color>[
            Color.lerp(colors.surface, AppColors.modeJamais, 0.16)!,
            colors.surface,
          ],
        ),
        borderRadius: AppRadii.bigCard,
        border: Border.all(
          color: AppColors.modeJamais.withValues(alpha: 0.38),
          width: 1.4,
        ),
        boxShadow: AppShadows.raised,
      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text(
            'QUI POURRAIT…',
            style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
              letterSpacing: 4,
              color: AppColors.modeJamais,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Text(
            card.text,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
              fontSize: size,
              height: 1.25,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _TargetTile extends StatefulWidget {
  const _TargetTile({
    required this.player,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final MultiplayerPlayer player;
  final bool enabled;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  State<_TargetTile> createState() => _TargetTileState();
}

class _TargetTileState extends State<_TargetTile> {
  bool _pressed = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final MultiplayerPlayer p = widget.player;
    final Color color = AppColors
        .playerPalette[p.colorIndex % AppColors.playerPalette.length];
    final double opacity = widget.enabled ? 1 : 0.40;

    return GestureDetector(
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      onTapDown: widget.enabled
          ? (_) => setState(() => _pressed = true)
          : null,
      onTapUp: widget.enabled
          ? (_) => setState(() => _pressed = false)
          : null,
      onTapCancel: widget.enabled
          ? () => setState(() => _pressed = false)
          : null,
      onTap: widget.enabled ? widget.onTap : null,
      child: AnimatedOpacity(
        duration: AppMotion.base,
        opacity: opacity,
        child: AnimatedScale(
          scale: _pressed ? 0.94 : 1,
          duration: AppMotion.fast,
          child: AnimatedContainer(
            duration: AppMotion.fast,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: _pressed
                  ? color.withValues(alpha: 0.24)
                  : colors.surfaceHigh,
              borderRadius: AppRadii.button,
              border: Border.all(
                color: _pressed ? color : colors.borderSoft,
                width: _pressed ? 2 : 1,
              ),
              boxShadow: _pressed
                  ? AppShadows.glow(color, opacity: 0.30)
                  : null,
            ),
            child: Row(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: <Widget>[
                _AvatarFromMultiplayer(player: p, size: 34),
                const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
                Text(
                  p.name,
                  style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                    fontSize: 16,
                    color: color,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _RevealedStage extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RevealedStage({
    super.key,
    required this.snapshot,
  });

  final MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot;

  MultiplayerPlayer? _playerById(String id) {
    for (final MultiplayerPlayer p in snapshot.players) {
      if (p.id == id) return p;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final MultiplayerVerdict? verdict = snapshot.verdict;
    if (verdict == null) {
      return const _WaitingForStart();
    }

    final bool tie = verdict.loserIds.length > 1;
    final Map<String, dynamic> extra = verdict.extraJson;
    final Object? rawTally = extra['tally'];
    final Map<String, int> tally = rawTally is Map
        ? <String, int>{
            for (final MapEntry<dynamic, dynamic> e in rawTally.entries)
              e.key.toString(): (e.value as num).toInt(),
          }
        : <String, int>{};

    final List<MultiplayerPlayer> designated = <MultiplayerPlayer>[
      for (final String id in verdict.loserIds)
        if (_playerById(id) != null) _playerById(id)!,
    ];

    final List<MultiplayerPlayer> losers = snapshot.players
        .where((MultiplayerPlayer p) => verdict.loserIds.contains(p.id))
        .toList(growable: false);

    final int maxVotes = designated.isEmpty
        ? 0
        : tally[designated.first.id] ?? 0;

    return Padding(
      padding: AppSpacing.screen,
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Text(
            designated.isEmpty
                ? 'PERSONNE N’A ÉTÉ DÉSIGNÉ'
                : tie
                    ? 'EX ÆQUO'
                    : 'VERDICT DU GROUPE',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
              letterSpacing: 3,
              color: designated.isEmpty
                  ? colors.textMuted
                  : AppColors.warning,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
          if (losers.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final MultiplayerPlayer p in losers.take(3))
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: AppSpacing.sm,
                    ),
                    child: _WinnerTile(
                      player: p,
                      votes: tally[p.id] ?? 0,
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
            if (verdict.summary.isNotEmpty)
              Text(
                verdict.summary,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: context.text.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                  color: AppColors.warning,
                ),
              ),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
          Text(
            'RÉPARTITION DES VOTES',
            style: context.text.labelMedium,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Expanded(
            child: ListView.separated(
              itemCount: snapshot.players.length,
              separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                  const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xs),
              itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int index) {
                final MultiplayerPlayer p = snapshot.players[index];
                final int count = tally[p.id] ?? 0;
                final bool isDesignated = verdict.loserIds.contains(p.id);
                return _VoteRow(
                  player: p,
                  votes: count,
                  maxVotes: maxVotes,
                  isDesignated: isDesignated,
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _WinnerTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _WinnerTile({required this.player, required this.votes});

  final MultiplayerPlayer player;
  final int votes;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final Color color = AppColors
        .playerPalette[player.colorIndex % AppColors.playerPalette.length];
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: <Widget>[
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(3),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
            color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.20),
            border: Border.all(color: color, width: 2.5),
            boxShadow: AppShadows.glow(color, opacity: 0.35),
          ),
          child: _AvatarFromMultiplayer(player: player, size: 66),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
        Text(
          player.name,
          maxLines: 1,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
            fontSize: 14,
            color: color,
          ),
        ),
        Text(
          '$votes ${votes > 1 ? 'votes' : 'vote'}',
          style: context.text.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontSize: 11.5),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _VoteRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _VoteRow({
    required this.player,
    required this.votes,
    required this.maxVotes,
    required this.isDesignated,
  });

  final MultiplayerPlayer player;
  final int votes;
  final int maxVotes;
  final bool isDesignated;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final Color color = AppColors
        .playerPalette[player.colorIndex % AppColors.playerPalette.length];
    final double ratio = maxVotes == 0 ? 0 : votes / maxVotes;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDesignated
            ? AppColors.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.10)
            : colors.surfaceHigh,
        borderRadius: AppRadii.button,
        border: Border.all(
          color: isDesignated
              ? AppColors.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.6)
              : colors.borderSoft,
          width: isDesignated ? 1.5 : 1,
        ),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: <Widget>[
          _AvatarFromMultiplayer(player: player, size: 28),
          const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
          SizedBox(
            width: 82,
            child: Text(
              player.name,
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(fontSize: 13.5),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
          Expanded(
            child: ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
              child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: ratio),
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 650),
                curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                builder: (BuildContext context, double v, Widget? _) =>
                    LinearProgressIndicator(
                  value: v,
                  minHeight: 6,
                  backgroundColor: colors.fill,
                  valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                    isDesignated ? AppColors.warning : color,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
          SizedBox(
            width: 24,
            child: Text(
              '$votes',
              textAlign: TextAlign.right,
              style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                fontSize: 14,
                color: votes > 0 ? color : colors.textMuted,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _AvatarFromMultiplayer extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AvatarFromMultiplayer({
    required this.player,
    required this.size,
  });

  final MultiplayerPlayer player;

    return AvatarView(
      emoji: player.emoji,
      photoBase64: player.photoBase64,
      color: color,
      size: size,
      showRing: false,
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_animate/flutter_animate.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../../models/enums.dart';
import '../../models/game_mode.dart';
import '../../models/player.dart';
import '../../models/prompt.dart';
import '../../services/game_session.dart';
import '../../services/haptics.dart';
import '../../theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../widgets/avatar_view.dart';
import '../../widgets/common.dart';
import '../../widgets/game_scaffold.dart';
import '../../widgets/intensity_selector.dart';
import 'game_finish.dart';

enum _Phase { voting, revealed }

class QuiPourraitScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const QuiPourraitScreen({super.key, required this.mode});

  final GameMode mode;

  @override
  State<QuiPourraitScreen> createState() => _QuiPourraitScreenState();
}

class _QuiPourraitScreenState extends State<QuiPourraitScreen>
    with GameFinishMixin<QuiPourraitScreen> {
  @override
  GameMode get gameMode => widget.mode;

  _Phase _phase = _Phase.voting;
  int _voterIndex = 0;
  final Map<String, int> _votes = <String, int>{};
  final List<String> _voteHistory = <String>[];
  bool _revealing = false;
  bool _initialized = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted && !_initialized) {
        _initialized = true;
        context.read<GameSession>().next();
      }
    });
  }

  int _votesOf(Player p) => _votes[p.id] ?? 0;

  Player? _voterAt(List<Player> players) =>
      players.isEmpty ? null : players[_voterIndex % players.length];

  List<Player> _designated(List<Player> players) {
    int best = 0;
    for (final Player p in players) {
      if (_votesOf(p) > best) best = _votesOf(p);
    }
    if (best == 0) return const <Player>[];
    return players.where((Player p) => _votesOf(p) == best).toList();
  }

  void _castVoteFor(Player target) {
    if (_phase != _Phase.voting) return;
    final GameSession session = context.read<GameSession>();
    final Player? voter = _voterAt(session.players);
    if (voter == null || voter.id == target.id) return;

    Haptics.medium();
    setState(() {
      _votes[target.id] = _votesOf(target) + 1;
      _voteHistory.add(target.id);
      _voterIndex++;
      if (_voterIndex >= session.players.length) {
        _phase = _Phase.revealed;
      }
    });

    if (_phase == _Phase.revealed) {
      unawaited(_revealVerdict());
    }
  }

  void _undoLastVote() {
    if (_phase != _Phase.voting || _voteHistory.isEmpty) return;
    Haptics.tick();
    setState(() {
      final String lastTargetId = _voteHistory.removeLast();
      final int current = _votes[lastTargetId] ?? 0;
      if (current <= 1) {
        _votes.remove(lastTargetId);
      } else {
        _votes[lastTargetId] = current - 1;
      }
      _voterIndex--;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _revealVerdict() async {
    if (_revealing) return;
    _revealing = true;
    try {
      final GameSession session = context.read<GameSession>();
      await Haptics.roll();
      if (!mounted) return;

      final List<Player> designated = _designated(session.players);
      session.bumpAll(designated, Stat.designe);
      session.recordSipsForAll(designated, session.rules.quiDesigne);
      await Haptics.triple();
    } finally {
      _revealing = false;
    }
  }

  void _next() {
    if (_revealing) return;
    Haptics.light();
    setState(() {
      _votes.clear();
      _voteHistory.clear();
      _voterIndex = 0;
      _phase = _Phase.voting;
    });
    context.read<GameSession>().next();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final GameSession session = context.watch<GameSession>();
    final Prompt? prompt = session.current;
    final List<Player> players = session.players;

    if (prompt == null) {
      return GameScaffold(
        mode: widget.mode,
        onQuit: finishGame,
        child: const _EmptyPack(),
      );
    }

    return GameScaffold(
      mode: widget.mode,
      onQuit: finishGame,
      bottom: _phase == _Phase.revealed
          ? AppButton(
              label: 'Question suivante',
              icon: Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
              color: widget.mode.color,
              onPressed: _revealing ? null : _next,
            )
          : null,
      child: AnimatedSwitcher(
        duration: AppMotion.base,
        switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
        child: _phase == _Phase.voting
            ? _VotingStage(
                key: ValueKey<String>('vote-$_voterIndex'),
                voter: _voterAt(players),
                voterIndex: _voterIndex,
                totalVoters: players.length,
                prompt: prompt,
                players: players,
                votes: _votes,
                onVote: _castVoteFor,
                onUndo:
                    _voteHistory.isNotEmpty ? _undoLastVote : null,
              )
            : _RevealStage(
                key: const ValueKey<String>('reveal'),
                prompt: prompt,
                players: players,
                votes: _votes,
                designated: _designated(players),
                sanction: session.sanctionLabel(session.rules.quiDesigne),
                noSips: session.rules.quiDesigne == 0,
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _VotingStage extends StatelessWidget {
  const _VotingStage({
    super.key,
    required this.voter,
    required this.voterIndex,
    required this.totalVoters,
    required this.prompt,
    required this.players,
    required this.votes,
    required this.onVote,
    required this.onUndo,
  });

  final Player? voter;
  final int voterIndex;
  final int totalVoters;
  final Prompt prompt;
  final List<Player> players;
  final Map<String, int> votes;
  final ValueChanged<Player> onVote;
  final VoidCallback? onUndo;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (voter == null) {
      return const _EmptyPack();
    }

    final List<Player> targets =
        players.where((Player p) => p.id != voter!.id).toList(growable: false);

    return Padding(
      padding: AppSpacing.screen,
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          _VoterBanner(
            voter: voter!,
            voterIndex: voterIndex,
            totalVoters: totalVoters,
            onUndo: onUndo,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
          Expanded(
            flex: 3,
            child: _QuestionCard(prompt: prompt),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
          Text(
            'TOUCHE TA RÉPONSE',
            style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
              color: AppColors.modeJamais,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Expanded(
            flex: 4,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Wrap(
                alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
                children: <Widget>[
                  for (final Player p in targets)
                    _TargetTile(
                      player: p,
                      currentVotes: votes[p.id] ?? 0,
                      onTap: () => onVote(p),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _QuestionCard extends StatelessWidget {

      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,

          Row(

                  letterSpacing: 4,
                  color: AppColors.modeJamais,
                ),
              ),
              if (isAdult) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
                const AdultBadge(),
              ],
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Text(
            prompt.text,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
              fontSize: size,
              height: 1.25,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),

class _TargetTileState extends State<_TargetTile> {
  bool _pressed = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final Player p = widget.player;
    return GestureDetector(
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      onTapDown: (_) => setState(() => _pressed = true),
      onTapUp: (_) => setState(() => _pressed = false),
      onTapCancel: () => setState(() => _pressed = false),
      onTap: widget.onTap,
      child: AnimatedScale(
        scale: _pressed ? 0.94 : 1,
        duration: AppMotion.fast,
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: AppMotion.fast,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: _pressed
                ? p.color.withValues(alpha: 0.24)
                : colors.surfaceHigh,
            borderRadius: AppRadii.button,
            border: Border.all(
              color: _pressed
                  ? p.color
                  : colors.borderSoft,
              width: _pressed ? 2 : 1,
            ),
            boxShadow: _pressed
                ? AppShadows.glow(p.color, opacity: 0.30)
                : null,
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: <Widget>[
              AvatarView.fromPlayer(p, size: 34, showRing: false),
              const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
              Text(
                p.name,
                style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontSize: 16,
                  color: p.color,
                ),
              ),
              if (widget.currentVotes > 0) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 7,
                    vertical: 2,
                  ),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: p.color.withValues(alpha: 0.22),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    '${widget.currentVotes}',
                    style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                      fontSize: 11,
                      letterSpacing: 0,
                      color: p.color,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _RevealStage extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RevealStage({
    super.key,
    required this.prompt,
    required this.players,
    required this.votes,
    required this.designated,
    required this.sanction,
    required this.noSips,
  });

  final Prompt prompt;
  final List<Player> players;
  final Map<String, int> votes;
  final List<Player> designated;
  final String sanction;
  final bool noSips;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final bool tie = designated.length > 1;
    final int maxVotes = designated.isEmpty
        ? 0
        : votes[designated.first.id] ?? 0;

    return Padding(
      padding: AppSpacing.screen,
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Text(
            designated.isEmpty
                ? 'PERSONNE N’A ÉTÉ DÉSIGNÉ'
                : tie
                    ? 'EX ÆQUO'
                    : 'VERDICT DU GROUPE',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
              letterSpacing: 3,
              color: designated.isEmpty
                  ? colors.textMuted
                  : AppColors.warning,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
          if (designated.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final Player p in designated.take(3))
                  Padding(
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: AppSpacing.sm),
                    child: _WinnerTile(player: p, votes: votes[p.id] ?? 0),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
            Text(
              tie ? 'Tous concernés' : designated.first.name,
              style: context.text.headlineLarge?.copyWith(
                color: designated.first.color,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            Text(
              noSips ? 'Désigné par le groupe' : sanction,
              style: context.text.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                color: AppColors.warning,
              ),
            ),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
          Text(
            'RÉPARTITION DES VOTES',
            style: context.text.labelMedium,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Expanded(
            child: ListView.separated(
              itemCount: players.length,
              separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                  const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xs),
              itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int index) {
                final Player p = players[index];
                final int count = votes[p.id] ?? 0;
                final bool isDesignated =
                    designated.any((Player d) => d.id == p.id);
                return _VoteRow(
                  player: p,
                  votes: count,
                  maxVotes: maxVotes,
                  isDesignated: isDesignated,
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ).animate().fadeIn(duration: 380.ms);
  }
}

class _VoteRow extends StatelessWidget {

    required this.player,
    required this.votes,
    required this.maxVotes,
    required this.isDesignated,
  });

  final Player player;
  final int votes;
  final int maxVotes;
  final bool isDesignated;

  @override

    final colors = context.culColors;
    final double ratio = maxVotes == 0 ? 0 : votes / maxVotes;
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDesignated
            ? AppColors.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.10)
            : colors.surfaceHigh,
        borderRadius: AppRadii.button,
        border: Border.all(

              ? AppColors.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.6)
              : colors.borderSoft,
          width: isDesignated ? 1.5 : 1,
        ),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: <Widget>[
          AvatarView.fromPlayer(player, size: 28, showRing: false),
          const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
          SizedBox(
            width: 82,
            child: Text(
              player.name,
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(fontSize: 13.5),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
          Expanded(
            child: ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
              child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: ratio),
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 650),
                curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                builder: (BuildContext context, double v, Widget? _) =>
                    LinearProgressIndicator(
                  value: v,
                  minHeight: 6,
                  backgroundColor: colors.fill,
                  valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                    isDesignated ? AppColors.warning : player.color,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
          SizedBox(
            width: 24,
            child: Text(
              '$votes',
              textAlign: TextAlign.right,
              style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                fontSize: 14,
                color: votes > 0 ? player.color : colors.textMuted,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../models/game_mode.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/client_game_controller.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/host_game_controller.dart';
import '../../multiplayer/multiplayer_session.dart';
import '../../services/haptics.dart';
import '../../services/sounds.dart';
import '../../theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../widgets/avatar_view.dart';
import '../../widgets/common.dart';
import '../../widgets/game_scaffold.dart';

class TuPreferesMultiplayerScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const TuPreferesMultiplayerScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.mode,
    this.hostController,
    this.clientController,
    this.onQuit,
  }) : assert(
          hostController != null || clientController != null,
          'Il faut au moins un contrôleur (hôte ou client).',
        );

  final GameMode mode;
  final HostGameController? hostController;
  final ClientGameController? clientController;
  final VoidCallback? onQuit;

  bool get isHost => hostController != null;

  Listenable get _listenables =>
      Listenable.merge(<Listenable?>[hostController, clientController]);

  MultiplayerSnapshot? get _snapshot =>
      hostController?.snapshot ?? clientController?.snapshot;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: _listenables,
      builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? _) {
        final MultiplayerSnapshot? snapshot = _snapshot;

        if (snapshot == null) {
          return GameScaffold(
            mode: mode,
            onQuit: onQuit,
            child: const _WaitingForStart(),
          );
        }

        return GameScaffold(
          mode: mode,
          onQuit: onQuit,
          turn: snapshot.turn,
          bottom: _buildBottom(snapshot),
          child: AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: AppMotion.base,
            switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
            child: _buildStage(snapshot),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget? _buildBottom(MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot) {
    if (!isHost) return null;
    if (snapshot.phase != MultiplayerPhase.revealed) return null;

    return AppButton(
      label: 'Manche suivante',
      icon: Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
      color: mode.color,
      onPressed: () {
        Haptics.light();
        hostController!.nextRound();
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStage(MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot) {
    switch (snapshot.phase) {
      case MultiplayerPhase.waiting:
        return const _WaitingForStart(key: ValueKey<String>('waiting'));
      case MultiplayerPhase.voting:
        return _VotingStage(
          key: ValueKey<String>('voting-${snapshot.voterIndex}'),
          snapshot: snapshot,
          isHost: isHost,
          hostController: hostController,
          clientController: clientController,
        );
      case MultiplayerPhase.revealed:
        return _RevealedStage(
          key: const ValueKey<String>('revealed'),
          snapshot: snapshot,
        );
      case MultiplayerPhase.finished:
        return const _WaitingForStart(key: ValueKey<String>('finished'));
    }
  }
}

              'Préparation de la carte…',

              style: context.text.bodyLarge,
            ),

class _VotingStage extends StatefulWidget {
  const _VotingStage({
    super.key,
    required this.snapshot,
    required this.isHost,
    this.hostController,
    this.clientController,
  });

  final MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot;
  final bool isHost;
  final HostGameController? hostController;
  final ClientGameController? clientController;

  @override
  State<_VotingStage> createState() => _VotingStageState();
}

class _VotingStageState extends State<_VotingStage> {
  MultiplayerCard? get _card => widget.snapshot.currentCard;

  MultiplayerPlayer? get _voter {
    if (widget.snapshot.voterIndex >= widget.snapshot.players.length) {
      return null;
    }
    return widget.snapshot.players[widget.snapshot.voterIndex];
  }

  bool get _amIVoter {
    final MultiplayerPlayer? voter = _voter;
    if (voter == null) return false;
    if (widget.isHost) {
      return widget.hostController!.currentVoterIsLocal;
    } else {
      final String? assignedId = widget.clientController!.assignedPlayerId;
      return assignedId != null && voter.id == assignedId;
    }
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (_amIVoter) {
      Haptics.medium();
      Sounds.play(Sfx.pop);
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _VotingStage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    final bool wasIVoter = oldWidget.snapshot.voterIndex == widget.snapshot.voterIndex && 
      (oldWidget.hostController?.currentVoterIsLocal == widget.hostController?.currentVoterIsLocal);
      
    if (!wasIVoter && _amIVoter) {
      Haptics.medium();
      Sounds.play(Sfx.pop);
    }
  }

  void _vote(String choice) {
    if (widget.isHost) {
      widget.hostController!.castVoteLocally(choice);
    } else {
      widget.clientController!.castVote(choice);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final MultiplayerCard? card = _card;
    if (card == null || card.options.length < 2) {
      return const _WaitingForStart();
    }

    return Padding(
      padding: AppSpacing.screen,
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          _VoterBanner(
            voter: _voter,
            amIVoter: _amIVoter,
            totalVoters: widget.snapshot.players.length,
            voterIndex: widget.snapshot.voterIndex,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
          Expanded(
            child: _VoteZone(
              side: 'A',
              label: card.options[0],
              color: AppColors.modePrefere,
              enabled: _amIVoter,
              onTap: () => _vote('0'),
            ),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: AppSpacing.xs),
            child: Text(
              'OU',
              style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                letterSpacing: 3,
                color: colors.textMuted,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: _VoteZone(
              side: 'B',
              label: card.options[1],
              color: AppColors.modePrefereAlt,
              enabled: _amIVoter,
              onTap: () => _vote('1'),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

        if (waiting) ...<Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xs + 2),
          Text(
            'Patiente quelques secondes…',
            style: context.text.bodySmall,
          ),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xs + 2),
        Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: <Widget>[
            for (int i = 0; i < totalVoters; i++)
              Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 3),
                width: i == voterIndex ? 18 : 8,
                height: 8,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: i < voterIndex
                      ? AppColors.success
                      : i == voterIndex
                          ? _colorFor(voter!.colorIndex)
                          : colors.fillStrong,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _RevealedStage extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RevealedStage({
    super.key,
    required this.snapshot,
  });

  final MultiplayerSnapshot snapshot;

  MultiplayerCard? get _card => snapshot.currentCard;

  MultiplayerPlayer? _playerById(String id) {
    for (final MultiplayerPlayer p in snapshot.players) {
      if (p.id == id) return p;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final MultiplayerCard? card = _card;
    final MultiplayerVerdict? verdict = snapshot.verdict;
    if (card == null || verdict == null) {
      return const _WaitingForStart();
    }

    final Object? votesA = verdict.extraJson['votesA'];
    final Object? votesB = verdict.extraJson['votesB'];
    final Object? losingSide = verdict.extraJson['losingSide'];

    return Padding(
      padding: AppSpacing.screen,
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Text(
            losingSide == -1 ? 'ÉGALITÉ PARFAITE' : 'LA MINORITÉ BOIT',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
              letterSpacing: 3,
              color: AppColors.warning,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: _TallyCard(
                  side: 'A',
                  label: card.options.isNotEmpty ? card.options[0] : '',
                  votes: (votesA as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
                  total: snapshot.players.length,
                  color: AppColors.modePrefere,
                  losing: losingSide == -1 || losingSide == 0,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
              Expanded(
                child: _TallyCard(
                  side: 'B',
                  label: card.options.length > 1 ? card.options[1] : '',
                  votes: (votesB as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
                  total: snapshot.players.length,
                  color: AppColors.modePrefereAlt,
                  losing: losingSide == -1 || losingSide == 1,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
          if (verdict.summary.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            Text(
              verdict.summary,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: context.text.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                color: AppColors.warning,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
          ],
          if (verdict.loserIds.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            Text('CONCERNÉS', style: context.text.labelMedium),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            Wrap(
              alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
              spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
              runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final String id in verdict.loserIds)
                  if (_playerById(id) != null)
                    _PlayerChip(player: _playerById(id)!),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _TallyCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TallyCard({
    required this.side,
    required this.label,
    required this.votes,
    required this.total,
    required this.color,
    required this.losing,
  });

  final String side;
  final String label;
  final int votes;
  final int total;
  final Color color;
  final bool losing;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final double ratio = total == 0 ? 0 : votes / total;
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.md),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: losing
            ? AppColors.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.10)
            : colors.surfaceHigh,
        borderRadius: AppRadii.bigCard,
        border: Border.all(
          color: losing
              ? AppColors.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.7)
              : color.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
          width: losing ? 1.8 : 1,
        ),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Container(
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  side,
                  style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    letterSpacing: 1,
                    color: color,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              if (losing)
                const Icon(
                  Icons.local_bar_rounded,
                  size: 16,
                  color: AppColors.warning,
                ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(
                '$votes',
                style: context.text.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                  color: color,
                  fontSize: 20,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Text(
            label,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            maxLines: 3,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(fontSize: 13.5),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
            child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
              tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: ratio),
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 700),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              builder: (BuildContext context, double v, Widget? _) =>
                  LinearProgressIndicator(
                value: v,
                minHeight: 5,
                backgroundColor: colors.fill,
                valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(color),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
