import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_animate/flutter_animate.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../../models/game_mode.dart';
import '../../models/player.dart';
import '../../models/prompt.dart';
import '../../services/game_session.dart';
import '../../services/haptics.dart';
import '../../theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../widgets/avatar_view.dart';
import '../../widgets/common.dart';
import '../../widgets/game_scaffold.dart';
import 'game_finish.dart';

enum _Phase { voting, revealed }

class TuPreferesScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const TuPreferesScreen({super.key, required this.mode});

  final GameMode mode;

  @override
  State<TuPreferesScreen> createState() => _TuPreferesScreenState();
}

class _TuPreferesScreenState extends State<TuPreferesScreen>
    with GameFinishMixin<TuPreferesScreen> {
  @override
  GameMode get gameMode => widget.mode;

  _Phase _phase = _Phase.voting;
  int _voterIndex = 0;
  final Map<String, int> _votes = <String, int>{};
  bool _revealing = false;
  bool _initialized = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted && !_initialized) {
        _initialized = true;
        context.read<GameSession>().next();
      }
    });
  }

  int get _votesA => _votes.values.where((int s) => s == 0).length;
  int get _votesB => _votes.values.where((int s) => s == 1).length;

  int get _losingSide {
    if (_votesA == _votesB) return -1;
    return _votesA < _votesB ? 0 : 1;
  }

  Player? _voterAt(List<Player> players) =>
      players.isEmpty ? null : players[_voterIndex % players.length];

  void _castVote(int side) {
    if (_phase != _Phase.voting) return;
    final GameSession session = context.read<GameSession>();
    final Player? voter = _voterAt(session.players);
    if (voter == null) return;

    Haptics.medium();
    setState(() {
      _votes[voter.id] = side;
      _voterIndex++;
      if (_voterIndex >= session.players.length) {
        _phase = _Phase.revealed;
      }
    });

    if (_phase == _Phase.revealed) {
      unawaited(_revealVerdict());
    }
  }

  void _undoLastVote() {
    if (_phase != _Phase.voting || _voterIndex == 0) return;
    final GameSession session = context.read<GameSession>();
    final int previousIndex = _voterIndex - 1;
    final Player previous =
        session.players[previousIndex % session.players.length];
    Haptics.tick();
    setState(() {
      _votes.remove(previous.id);
      _voterIndex = previousIndex;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _revealVerdict() async {
    if (_revealing) return;
    _revealing = true;
    try {
      final GameSession session = context.read<GameSession>();
      await Haptics.roll();
      if (!mounted) return;

      final int losing = _losingSide;
      final List<Player> punished = session.players.where((Player p) {
        final int? side = _votes[p.id];
        return side != null && (losing == -1 || side == losing);
      }).toList();

      if (losing != -1) {
        session.bumpAll(punished, Stat.minorite);
        session.bumpAll(
          session.players.where(
            (Player p) => _votes[p.id] != null && _votes[p.id] != losing,
          ),
          Stat.majorite,
        );
      }
      session.recordSipsForAll(punished, session.rules.prefereMinority);
      await Haptics.triple();
    } finally {
      _revealing = false;
    }
  }

  void _next() {
    if (_revealing) return;
    Haptics.light();
    setState(() {
      _votes.clear();
      _voterIndex = 0;
      _phase = _Phase.voting;
    });
    context.read<GameSession>().next();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final GameSession session = context.watch<GameSession>();
    final Prompt? prompt = session.current;
    final List<Player> players = session.players;

    if (prompt == null) {
      return GameScaffold(
        mode: widget.mode,
        onQuit: finishGame,
        child: const _EmptyPack(),
      );
    }

    final String optionA =
        prompt.options.isNotEmpty ? prompt.options[0] : '…';
    final String optionB =
        prompt.options.length > 1 ? prompt.options[1] : '…';

    return GameScaffold(
      mode: widget.mode,
      onQuit: finishGame,
      bottom: _phase == _Phase.revealed
          ? AppButton(
              label: 'Dilemme suivant',
              icon: Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
              color: widget.mode.color,
              onPressed: _revealing ? null : _next,
            )
          : null,
      child: AnimatedSwitcher(
        duration: AppMotion.base,
        switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
        child: _phase == _Phase.voting
            ? _VotingStage(
                key: ValueKey<String>('vote-$_voterIndex'),
                voter: _voterAt(players),
                voterIndex: _voterIndex,
                totalVoters: players.length,
                optionA: optionA,
                optionB: optionB,
                onVote: _castVote,
                onUndo: _voterIndex > 0 ? _undoLastVote : null,
              )
            : _RevealStage(
                key: const ValueKey<String>('reveal'),
                optionA: optionA,
                optionB: optionB,
                votesA: _votesA,
                votesB: _votesB,
                losingSide: _losingSide,
                players: players,
                votes: _votes,
                sanction:
                    session.sanctionLabel(session.rules.prefereMinority),
                noSips: session.rules.prefereMinority == 0,
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _RevealStage extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RevealStage({
    super.key,
    required this.optionA,
    required this.optionB,
    required this.votesA,
    required this.votesB,
    required this.losingSide,
    required this.players,
    required this.votes,
    required this.sanction,
    required this.noSips,
  });

  final String optionA;
  final String optionB;
  final int votesA;
  final int votesB;
  final int losingSide;
  final List<Player> players;
  final Map<String, int> votes;
  final String sanction;
  final bool noSips;

  bool _isOnLosingSide(Player p) {
    final int? side = votes[p.id];
    return side != null && (losingSide == -1 || side == losingSide);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final List<Player> losers =
        players.where(_isOnLosingSide).toList(growable: false);
    final List<Player> winners =
        players.where((Player p) => votes.containsKey(p.id) && !_isOnLosingSide(p))
            .toList(growable: false);

    final bool tie = losingSide == -1;

    return Padding(
      padding: AppSpacing.screen,
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Text(
            tie ? 'ÉGALITÉ PARFAITE' : 'LA MINORITÉ BOIT',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
              letterSpacing: 3,
              color: tie ? AppColors.warning : AppColors.warning,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: _TallyCard(
                  side: 'A',
                  label: optionA,
                  votes: votesA,
                  total: votesA + votesB,
                  color: AppColors.modePrefere,
                  losing: tie || losingSide == 0,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
              Expanded(
                child: _TallyCard(
                  side: 'B',
                  label: optionB,
                  votes: votesB,
                  total: votesA + votesB,
                  color: AppColors.modePrefereAlt,
                  losing: tie || losingSide == 1,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
          if (losers.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            Text(
              tie ? 'TOUT LE MONDE BOIT' : 'CONCERNÉS',
              style: context.text.labelMedium,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            Wrap(
              alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
              spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
              runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final Player p in losers)
                  _PlayerChip(player: p, highlighted: true),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
            Text(
              noSips ? 'Désignés par le groupe' : sanction,
              style: context.text.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                color: AppColors.warning,
              ),
            ),
          ],
          if (winners.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl),
            Text(
              'MAJORITÉ',
              style: context.text.labelMedium,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            Wrap(
              alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
              spacing: AppSpacing.sm,
              runSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final Player p in winners)
                  _PlayerChip(player: p, highlighted: false),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    ).animate().fadeIn(duration: 380.ms);
  }
}

class _TallyCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TallyCard({
    required this.side,
    required this.label,
    required this.votes,
    required this.total,
    required this.color,
    required this.losing,
  });

  final String side;
  final String label;
  final int votes;
  final int total;
  final Color color;
  final bool losing;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final double ratio = total == 0 ? 0 : votes / total;
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.md),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: losing
            ? AppColors.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.10)
            : colors.surfaceHigh,
        borderRadius: AppRadii.bigCard,
        border: Border.all(
          color: losing
              ? AppColors.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.7)
              : color.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
          width: losing ? 1.8 : 1,
        ),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Container(
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  side,
                  style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    letterSpacing: 1,
                    color: color,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              if (losing)
                const Icon(
                  Icons.local_bar_rounded,
                  size: 16,
                  color: AppColors.warning,
                ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(
                '$votes',
                style: context.text.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                  color: color,
                  fontSize: 20,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          Text(
            label,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            maxLines: 3,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(fontSize: 13.5),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
            child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
              tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: ratio),
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 700),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              builder: (BuildContext context, double v, Widget? _) =>
                  LinearProgressIndicator(
                value: v,
                minHeight: 5,
                backgroundColor: colors.fill,
                valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(color),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class HomeScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const HomeScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<HomeScreen> createState() => _HomeScreenState();
}

class _HomeScreenState extends State<HomeScreen> {
  final ScrollController _scroll = ScrollController();
  final ValueNotifier<double> _offset = ValueNotifier<double>(0);

  Map<Intensity, int>? _cachedCounts;
  int _cachedCustomCount = -1;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _scroll.addListener(_onScroll);
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => _offerResume());
  }

  Future<void> _offerResume() async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
    final SavedGame? saved = SavedGame.fromJson(state.savedGame);
    if (saved == null) return;

    final List<Player> players = saved.playersFrom(state.roster);
    if (!saved.isFresh || saved.turn == 0 || players.length < 2) {
      await state.clearSavedGame();
      return;
    }
    final List<GameMode> modes = <GameMode>[
      for (final GameModeId id in saved.modes)
        ...kGameModes.where((GameMode m) => m.id == id),
    ];
    if (modes.isEmpty || (saved.multi && modes.length < 2)) {
      await state.clearSavedGame();
      return;
    }

    final Object? rawSips = saved.score['sips'];
    final int sips = rawSips is Map
        ? rawSips.values.whereType<num>().fold<int>(
              0,
              (int sum, num v) => sum + v.toInt(),
            )
        : 0;
    final Duration ago = DateTime.now().difference(saved.savedAt);
    final String when = ago.inMinutes < 1
        ? 'à l’instant'
        : ago.inHours < 1
            ? 'il y a ${ago.inMinutes} min'
            : 'il y a ${ago.inHours} h';
    final String title = saved.multi ? 'Multi-jeu' : modes.first.title;

    Haptics.medium();
    final bool? resume = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (BuildContext dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(
          'Reprendre la partie ?',
          style: dialogContext.text.titleLarge,
        ),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(
              '$title · ${saved.turn} tours · $sips gorgées',
              style: dialogContext.text.titleMedium,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            _AvatarStack(players: players),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            Text(
              '${players.map((Player p) => p.name).join(', ')}\n'
              'Interrompue $when.',
              style: dialogContext.text.bodyMedium,
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
            child: const Text('Nouvelle partie'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
            child: const Text('Reprendre'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (resume != true) {
      await state.clearSavedGame();
      return;
    }
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => saved.multi
            ? MultiJeuLauncher(modes: modes, resume: saved)
            : GameLauncher(mode: modes.first, resume: saved),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _onScroll() {
    _offset.value = _scroll.offset;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scroll
      ..removeListener(_onScroll)
      ..dispose();
    _offset.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Map<Intensity, int> _globalCounts() {
    final int custom = context.read<AppState>().customCardCount;
    if (_cachedCounts != null && custom == _cachedCustomCount) {
      return _cachedCounts!;
    }

    final Map<Intensity, int> counts = <Intensity, int>{};
    for (final Intensity level in Intensity.values) {
      int total = 0;
      for (final GameMode mode in kGameModes) {
        final PromptPack? pack = ContentService.instance.cached(mode.id);
        if (pack != null) total += pack.countAt(level);
      }
      counts[level] = total;
    }
    _cachedCounts = counts;
    _cachedCustomCount = custom;
    return counts;
  }

  void _openMode(GameMode mode) {
    Haptics.medium();
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => ModeIntroSheet(mode: mode),
    );
  }

  void _openMultiplayer() {
    Haptics.medium();
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      ForwardRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => const MultiplayerHomeScreen(),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final AppState state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final Map<Intensity, int> counts = _globalCounts();

    return Scaffold(
      body: AmbientBackground(
        primary: state.intensity.color,
        secondary: AppColors.accent,
        child: SafeArea(
          bottom: false,
          child: CustomScrollView(
            controller: _scroll,
            scrollCacheExtent: const ScrollCacheExtent.pixels(800),
            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(
              parent: AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            ),
            slivers: <Widget>[
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: _ParallaxHeader(
                  offset: _offset,
                  child: _Header(state: state),
                ),
              ),
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(top: AppSpacing.lg),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      const SectionTitle('INTENSITÉ'),
                      IntensitySelector(cardCounts: counts),
                    ],
                  ),
                )
                    .animate()
                    .fadeIn(delay: 180.ms, duration: 400.ms)
                    .slideY(begin: 0.1, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),
              ),
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(top: AppSpacing.xl),
                  child: SectionTitle(
                    'LES JEUX',
                    trailing: '${kGameModes.length} modes',
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              SliverPadding(
                padding: AppSpacing.screen,
                sliver: SliverList.separated(
                  itemCount: kGameModes.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                      const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
                  itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int i) {
                    final GameMode mode = kGameModes[i];
                    final PromptPack? pack =
                        ContentService.instance.cached(mode.id);

                    return RepaintBoundary(
                      child: _ModeCard(
                        mode: mode,
                        cardCount: pack?.countAt(state.intensity) ?? 0,
                        onTap: () => _openMode(mode),
                      )
                          .animate()
                          .fadeIn(delay: (260 + i * 90).ms, duration: 420.ms)
                          .slideY(begin: 0.14, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic)
                          .scaleXY(begin: 0.96, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(top: AppSpacing.xl),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      const SectionTitle('MULTI-JEU'),
                      RepaintBoundary(
                        child: _ModeCard(
                          mode: kMultiJeuMode,
                          cardCount: counts[state.intensity] ?? 0,
                          onTap: () {
                            Haptics.medium();
                            MultiJeuSheet.show(context);
                          },
                        )
                            .animate()
                            .fadeIn(
                              delay: (260 + kGameModes.length * 90).ms,
                              duration: 420.ms,
                            )
                            .slideY(begin: 0.14, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic)
                            .scaleXY(begin: 0.96, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(top: AppSpacing.xl),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      const SectionTitle('MULTIJOUEUR LOCAL'),
                      RepaintBoundary(
                        child: _ModeCard(
                          mode: kMultiplayerMode,
                          cardCount: counts[state.intensity] ?? 0,
                          onTap: _openMultiplayer,
                        )
                            .animate()
                            .fadeIn(
                              delay: (260 + (kGameModes.length + 1) * 90).ms,
                              duration: 420.ms,
                            )
                            .slideY(begin: 0.14, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic)
                            .scaleXY(begin: 0.96, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
                    top: AppSpacing.xl,
                    bottom:
                        AppSpacing.xxl + MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom,
                  ),
                  child: Center(
                    child: Text(
                      state.gamesPlayed == 0
                          ? 'Hors-ligne · sans publicité · sans compte'
                          : '${state.gamesPlayed} parties jouées',
                      style: context.text.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontSize: 11.5),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ParallaxHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ParallaxHeader({required this.offset, required this.child});

  final ValueNotifier<double> offset;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: offset,
      child: child,
      builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? built) {
        final double value = offset.value < 0 ? 0 : offset.value;
        final double fade = (1 - value / 220).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

        return Transform.translate(
          offset: Offset(0, value * 0.3),
          child: fade >= 1 ? built : Opacity(opacity: fade, child: built),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _AvatarStack extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AvatarStack({required this.players});

  final List<Player> players;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final List<Player> shown = players.take(4).toList();
    final int extra = players.length - shown.length;
    final int slots = shown.length + (extra > 0 ? 1 : 0);

    return SizedBox(
      height: 30,
      width: 30 + (slots - 1) * 20,
      child: Stack(
        children: <Widget>[
          for (int i = 0; i < shown.length; i++)
            Positioned(
              left: i * 20,
              child: Container(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  color: colors.ink,
                ),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                child: AvatarView.fromPlayer(
                  shown[i],
                  size: 26,
                  showRing: false,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (extra > 0)
            Positioned(
              left: shown.length * 20,
              child: Container(
                width: 30,
                height: 30,
                alignment: Alignment.center,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  color: colors.fillStrong,
                  border: Border.all(color: colors.ink, width: 2),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  '+$extra',
                  style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    letterSpacing: 0,
                    color: colors.textSecondary,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ModeCard extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ModeCard({
    required this.mode,
    required this.cardCount,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final GameMode mode;
  final int cardCount;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  State<_ModeCard> createState() => _ModeCardState();
}

class _ModeCardState extends State<_ModeCard> {
  bool _pressed = false;

  void _set(bool v) {
    if (_pressed != v && mounted) setState(() => _pressed = v);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final GameMode mode = widget.mode;

    final Color borderColor =
        _pressed ? mode.color : mode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.35);
    final Color accentSoft = mode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.9);

    return GestureDetector(
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      onTapDown: (_) => _set(true),
      onTapUp: (_) => _set(false),
      onTapCancel: () => _set(false),
      onTap: widget.onTap,
      child: AnimatedScale(
        scale: _pressed ? 0.975 : 1,
        duration: AppMotion.fast,
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: AppMotion.fast,
          height: 132,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: AppRadii.bigCard,
            boxShadow: _pressed
                ? AppShadows.glow(mode.color, opacity: 0.35)
                : AppShadows.card,
          ),
          child: ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: AppRadii.bigCard,
            clipBehavior: Clip.hardEdge,
            child: Stack(
              fit: StackFit.expand,
              children: <Widget>[
                DecoratedBox(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                      begin: Alignment.centerLeft,
                      end: Alignment.centerRight,
                      colors: <Color>[
                        Color.lerp(colors.surface, mode.color, 0.26)!,
                        Color.lerp(colors.surface, mode.colorAlt, 0.08)!,
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                Positioned(
                  right: -20,
                  top: -14,
                  child: Icon(
                    mode.icon,
                    size: 150,
                    color: mode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.13),
                  ),
                ),
                AnimatedContainer(

class _ModeIntroSheetState extends State<ModeIntroSheet> {
  PromptPack? get _pack => ContentService.instance.cached(widget.mode.id);

  Map<Intensity, int> get _counts {
    final PromptPack? pack = _pack;
    if (pack == null) return <Intensity, int>{};
    return <Intensity, int>{
      for (final Intensity level in Intensity.values)
        level: pack.countAt(level),
    };
  }

  void _start() {
    Haptics.medium();
    Navigator.of(context).pop();
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      ForwardRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => GameLauncher(mode: widget.mode),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openSettings() {
    Haptics.light();
    Navigator.of(context).pop();
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      ForwardRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => const SettingsScreen(),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors; // <-- Ajouté
    final AppState state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final GameMode mode = widget.mode;
    final PromptPack? pack = _pack;

    final bool enoughPlayers = state.selectedCount >= mode.minPlayers;

    final int playable = pack == null
        ? 0
        : pack.filtered(state.intensity, categories: state.categories).length;

      initialChildSize: 0.86,
      minChildSize: 0.5,
      maxChildSize: 0.95,
      expand: false,
      builder: (BuildContext context, ScrollController controller) {
        return DecoratedBox(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: colors.surfaceTop, // <-- Modifié
            borderRadius: AppRadii.sheet,
            border: Border(
              top: BorderSide(
                color: mode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                width: 1.5,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          child: Column(
            children: <Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
              Container(
                width: 38,
                height: 4,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: colors.border, // <-- Modifié
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
                ),
              ),

              Expanded(
                child: ListView(
                  controller: controller,
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(top: AppSpacing.lg),
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Row(
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Container(
                          width: 54,
                          height: 54,
                          alignment: Alignment.center,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            gradient: AppGradients.pair(
                              mode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.28),
                              mode.colorAlt.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                            ),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.md),
                            border: Border.all(

/// Mode « virtuel » du multi-jeu, utilisé pour l'écran de fin.
const GameMode kMultiJeuMode = GameMode(
  id: GameModeId.actionOuVerite,
  title: 'Multi-jeu',
  tagline: 'Le jeu change à chaque manche',
  rules: 'Choisissez 2 à 4 jeux : à chaque manche, l’un d’eux est tiré au '
      'hasard. Les gorgées s’additionnent sur toute la partie.',
  howTo: <String>[

/// Exposé aux écrans de jeu pendant un multi-jeu : la sortie de partie
/// affiche le récapitulatif global et « Rejouer » relance le même mélange.
class MultiJeuController {
  MultiJeuController({required this.modes, required this.onFinish});

  final List<GameMode> modes;
  final void Function(BuildContext context) onFinish;

  void finish(BuildContext context) => onFinish(context);
}

/// Choix des jeux du mélange (2 à 4), ouvert depuis l'accueil.
class MultiJeuSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const MultiJeuSheet({super.key});

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context) {
    return showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => const MultiJeuSheet(),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<MultiJeuSheet> createState() => _MultiJeuSheetState();
}

class _MultiJeuSheetState extends State<MultiJeuSheet> {
  /// Par défaut, tous les jeux sont dans le mélange.
  final Set<GameModeId> _chosen =
      kGameModes.map((GameMode m) => m.id).toSet();

  void _toggle(GameMode mode) {
    Haptics.tick();
    setState(() {
      if (!_chosen.remove(mode.id)) _chosen.add(mode.id);
    });
  }

  void _start(List<GameMode> modes) {
    Haptics.medium();
    Navigator.of(context).pop();
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: (_) => MultiJeuLauncher(modes: modes)),
    );
  }

  void _openSettings() {
    Haptics.light();
    Navigator.of(context).pop();
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: (_) => const SettingsScreen()),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors; // <-- Modifié
    final AppState state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final int players = state.selectedCount;

    bool playable(GameMode m) => players >= m.minPlayers;

    final List<GameMode> selected = kGameModes
        .where((GameMode m) => _chosen.contains(m.id) && playable(m))
        .toList();
    final bool enoughPlayers = state.hasEnoughPlayers;
    final bool canStart = enoughPlayers && selected.length >= 2;

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: colors.surfaceTop, // <-- Modifié
        borderRadius: AppRadii.sheet,
        border: Border(
          top: BorderSide(
            color: kMultiJeuMode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
            width: 1.5,
          ),
        ),
      ),
      padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
        top: AppSpacing.sm + 2,
        bottom: AppSpacing.lg + MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom,
      ),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Center(
              child: Container(
                width: 38,
                height: 4,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: colors.border, // <-- Modifié
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
            Row(
              children: <Widget>[
                Container(
                  width: 54,
                  height: 54,
                  alignment: Alignment.center,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: AppGradients.pair(
                      kMultiJeuMode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.28),
                      kMultiJeuMode.colorAlt.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                    ),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.md),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: kMultiJeuMode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    kMultiJeuMode.icon,
                    size: 26,
                    color: kMultiJeuMode.color,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.md),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Text(
                        kMultiJeuMode.title,
                        style: context.text.headlineLarge,
                      ),
                      Text(
                        kMultiJeuMode.tagline,
                        style: context.text.bodyMedium,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
            Text(kMultiJeuMode.rules, style: context.text.bodyLarge),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
            SectionTitle(
              'JEUX DU MÉLANGE',
              trailing: '${selected.length} choisis',
            ),
            for (final GameMode mode in kGameModes) ...<Widget>[
              _ModeToggle(
                mode: mode,
                selected: _chosen.contains(mode.id) && playable(mode),
                enabled: playable(mode),
                disabledReason: '${mode.minPlayers} joueurs minimum',
                onTap: () => _toggle(mode),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
            const SectionTitle('OPTIONS'),
            _OptionRow(
              icon: Icons.casino_rounded,
              title: 'Roulette',
              subtitle: 'Une roue tire le jeu avant chaque manche',
              value: state.rouletteEnabled,
              onChanged: state.setRouletteEnabled,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            _OptionRow(
              icon: Icons.bolt_rounded,
              title: 'Cartes Événement',
              subtitle: 'Surprises entre deux manches',
              value: state.eventsEnabled,
              onChanged: state.setEventsEnabled,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
            if (!enoughPlayers)
              _Hint(
                text: 'Il faut au moins 2 joueurs sélectionnés.',
                action: 'Joueurs',
                onAction: _openSettings,
              )
            else if (selected.length < 2)
              const _Hint(text: 'Choisissez au moins 2 jeux.'),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
            AppButton(
              label: canStart
                  ? 'Lancer le multi-jeu · ${selected.length} jeux'
                  : 'Lancer le multi-jeu',
              icon: Icons.shuffle_rounded,
              color: kMultiJeuMode.color,
              onPressed: canStart ? () => _start(selected) : null,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ModeToggle extends StatelessWidget {

                  if (!enabled)
                    Text(
                      disabledReason,
                      style: context.text.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontSize: 11.5),
                    ),
                ],

            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: AppMotion.base,
              curve: AppMotion.emphasized,

              alignment: Alignment.center,

                ),
              ),
              child: selected
                  ? const Icon(
                      Icons.check_rounded,
                      size: 16,
                      color: Colors.white,
                    )
                  : null,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

/// Prépare une session par jeu choisi, toutes reliées au même score.
class MultiJeuLauncher extends StatefulWidget {
  const MultiJeuLauncher({super.key, required this.modes, this.resume});

  final List<GameMode> modes;

  /// Partie sauvegardée à reprendre, le cas échéant.
  final SavedGame? resume;

  @override
  State<MultiJeuLauncher> createState() => _MultiJeuLauncherState();
}

class _MultiJeuLauncherState extends State<MultiJeuLauncher> {
  late final Future<Map<GameModeId, GameSession>> _future = _build();

  Future<Map<GameModeId, GameSession>> _build() async {
    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);

    final SavedGame? resume = widget.resume;
    final List<Player> players =
        resume?.playersFrom(state.roster) ?? state.players;
    final SessionScore score = resume?.restoreScore() ?? SessionScore();
    final Map<GameModeId, GameSession> sessions = <GameModeId, GameSession>{};
    for (final GameMode mode in widget.modes) {
      sessions[mode.id] = await buildGameSession(
        state,
        mode,
        score: score,
        players: players,
      );
    }
    // Un multi-jeu compte pour une seule partie (déjà comptée si reprise).
    if (resume == null) await state.incrementGamesPlayed();
    SavedGame.attach(
      state,
      score,
      multi: true,
      modes: widget.modes.map((GameMode m) => m.id).toList(),
      players: players,
    );
    return sessions;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return FutureBuilder<Map<GameModeId, GameSession>>(
      future: _future,
      builder: (
        BuildContext context,
        AsyncSnapshot<Map<GameModeId, GameSession>> snapshot,
      ) {
        if (snapshot.hasError) {
          return Scaffold(
            body: AmbientBackground(
              child: Center(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: AppSpacing.screen,
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Text(
                        'Impossible de charger les cartes.',
                        style: context.text.titleLarge,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
                      AppButton(
                        label: 'Retour',
                        expand: false,
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }
        if (!snapshot.hasData) {
          return Scaffold(
            body: AmbientBackground(
              primary: kMultiJeuMode.color,
              secondary: kMultiJeuMode.colorAlt,
              child: Center(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Icon(
                      kMultiJeuMode.icon,
                      size: 42,
                      color: kMultiJeuMode.color,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
                    Text('On mélange les jeux…', style: context.text.bodyLarge),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }
        return MultiJeuScreen(
          modes: widget.modes,
          sessions: snapshot.data!,
          resumed: widget.resume != null,
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Enchaîne les manches : à chaque fin de manche, un jeu est tiré au hasard
/// parmi ceux choisis. Gorgées, tours et ordre de passage sont communs.
class MultiJeuScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const MultiJeuScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.modes,
    required this.sessions,
    this.resumed = false,
  });

  final List<GameMode> modes;
  final Map<GameModeId, GameSession> sessions;

  /// Partie reprise : pas de roulette d'ouverture.
  final bool resumed;

  @override
  State<MultiJeuScreen> createState() => _MultiJeuScreenState();
}

class _MultiJeuScreenState extends State<MultiJeuScreen> {
  final math.Random _random = math.Random();
  late final MultiJeuController _controller = MultiJeuController(
    modes: widget.modes,
    onFinish: _finish,
  );

  late GameMode _mode;
  int _round = 0;
  bool _finished = false;

  final EventDeck _events = EventDeck();

  /// Une carte Événement ou la roulette est affichée.
  bool _transitioning = false;

  /// La pastille du jeu n'est utile que sans roulette.
  bool _showBanner = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    for (final GameSession s in widget.sessions.values) {
      s.onRoundEnd = _nextRound;
    }
    _mode = _pick();
    _prepare(_mode);
    _showBanner =
        widget.resumed || !context.read<AppState>().rouletteEnabled;

    // Roulette d'ouverture : le premier jeu est tiré devant tout le monde.
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) async {
      if (!mounted || widget.resumed) return;
      if (!context.read<AppState>().rouletteEnabled) return;
      _transitioning = true;
      try {
        await showRouletteDialog(context, modes: widget.modes, target: _mode);
      } finally {
        _transitioning = false;
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final GameSession s in widget.sessions.values) {
      s.onRoundEnd = null;
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// Tirage totalement aléatoire parmi les jeux choisis.
  GameMode _pick() => widget.modes[_random.nextInt(widget.modes.length)];

  GameSession get _session => widget.sessions[_mode.id]!;

  /// Les jeux à carte unique tirent leur carte avant l'affichage ;
  /// Action ou Vérité tire la sienne après le choix du joueur.
  void _prepare(GameMode mode) {
    if (mode.id != GameModeId.actionOuVerite) {
      widget.sessions[mode.id]!.prepareRound();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _nextRound() async {
    if (!mounted || _finished || _transitioning) return;
    _transitioning = true;
    try {
      final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();

      // Carte Événement entre deux manches.
      if (state.eventsEnabled && _events.shouldTrigger()) {
        final RoundEvent? event = _events.draw(_session);
        if (event != null) {
          await showEventDialog(context, _session, event);
          if (!mounted || _finished) return;
        }
      }

      final GameMode next = _pick();
      final bool roulette = state.rouletteEnabled && widget.modes.length > 1;
      if (roulette) {
        await showRouletteDialog(context, modes: widget.modes, target: next);
        if (!mounted || _finished) return;
      } else {
        Haptics.light();
      }

      _prepare(next);
      setState(() {
        _mode = next;
        _round++;
        _showBanner = !roulette;
      });
    } finally {
      _transitioning = false;
    }
  }

  void _finish(BuildContext context) {
    if (_finished) return;
    _finished = true;
    for (final GameSession s in widget.sessions.values) {
      s.onRoundEnd = null;
    }
    final List<GameMode> modes = widget.modes;
    final NavigatorState navigator = Navigator.of(context);
    navigator.pushReplacement(
      PageRouteBuilder<void>(
        transitionDuration: AppMotion.slow,
        pageBuilder: (_, __, ___) => EndScreen(
          mode: kMultiJeuMode,
          session: _session,
          onReplay: () => navigator.pushReplacement(
            MaterialPageRoute<void>(
              builder: (_) => MultiJeuLauncher(modes: modes),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        transitionsBuilder: (
          BuildContext context,
          Animation<double> animation,
          Animation<double> secondary,
          Widget child,
        ) =>
            FadeTransition(opacity: animation, child: child),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final GameMode mode = _mode;

    return Provider<MultiJeuController?>.value(
      value: _controller,
      child: Stack(
        children: <Widget>[
          Positioned.fill(
            child: AnimatedSwitcher(
              duration: AppMotion.slow,
              switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              switchOutCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
              transitionBuilder: (Widget child, Animation<double> anim) =>
                  AnimatedBuilder(
                animation: anim,
                // L'écran sortant ne réagit plus aux touches : impossible
                // de sauter une manche par un double appui.
                builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? built) =>
                    IgnorePointer(
                  ignoring: anim.status == AnimationStatus.reverse ||
                      anim.status == AnimationStatus.dismissed,
                  child: built,
                ),
                child: FadeTransition(
                  opacity: anim,
                  child: ScaleTransition(
                    scale: Tween<double>(begin: 0.97, end: 1).animate(anim),
                    child: child,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              child: KeyedSubtree(
                key: ValueKey<int>(_round),
                child: ChangeNotifierProvider<GameSession>.value(
                  value: _session,
                  child: gameScreenFor(mode),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          // Annonce du jeu de la manche.
          Positioned(
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            top: MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).top + 64,
            child: IgnorePointer(
              child: Center(
                child: _showBanner
                    ? _RoundBanner(key: ValueKey<int>(_round), mode: mode)
                    : const SizedBox.shrink(),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _RoundBanner extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RoundBanner({super.key, required this.mode});

  final GameMode mode;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors; // <-- Modifié
    return Material(
      type: MaterialType.transparency,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: colors.surfaceTop, // <-- Modifié
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
          border: Border.all(color: mode.color, width: 1.5),
          boxShadow: AppShadows.glow(mode.color, opacity: 0.35),
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            Icon(
              Icons.shuffle_rounded,
              size: 15,
              color: colors.textSecondary, // <-- Modifié
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Icon(mode.icon, size: 16, color: mode.color),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            Text(
              mode.title,
              style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                fontSize: 14,
                color: mode.color,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      )
          .animate()
          .fadeIn(duration: 220.ms)
          .scaleXY(begin: 0.85, curve: Curves.easeOutBack)
          .then(delay: 1100.ms)
          .fadeOut(duration: 350.ms),
    );
  }
}

Set<String> takenAvatars(List<Player> roster, {Player? except}) => roster
    .where(
      (Player p) =>
          p.id != except?.id && p.isSelected && !p.hasPhoto,
    )
    .map((Player p) => p.emoji)
    .toSet();

class SettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SettingsScreen> createState() => _SettingsScreenState();
}

class _SettingsScreenState extends State<SettingsScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _controller = TextEditingController();
  final FocusNode _focus = FocusNode();

  String? _nextAvatar;

  Set<String> _usedAvatars(AppState state) => takenAvatars(state.roster);

  String _avatarFor(AppState state) {
    final Set<String> taken = _usedAvatars(state);
    final String? next = _nextAvatar;
    if (next != null && !taken.contains(next)) return next;
    return _nextAvatar = AvatarCatalog.randomMascot(taken: taken);
  }

  void _shuffleAvatar(AppState state) {
    Haptics.tick();
    setState(() {
      _nextAvatar = AvatarCatalog.randomMascot(
        taken: _usedAvatars(state),
        current: _nextAvatar,
      );
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    _focus.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _add() async {
    final String name = _controller.text.trim();
    if (name.isEmpty) return;
    final AppState state = context.read<AppState>();
    Haptics.medium();
    await state.addPlayer(name, _avatarFor(state));
    _controller.clear();
    setState(() {
      _nextAvatar = AvatarCatalog.randomMascot(taken: _usedAvatars(state));
    });
    _focus.requestFocus();
  }

  Future<void> _edit(Player player) {
    return showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => _PlayerEditSheet(player: player),
    );
  }

  void _openCustomCards() {
    Haptics.light();
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: (_) => const CustomCardsScreen()),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _reorder(
    AppState state,
    int oldIndex,
    int newIndex,
  ) async {
    if (oldIndex == newIndex) return;
    Haptics.medium();
    await state.reorderPlayers(oldIndex, newIndex);
  }

    final colors = context.culColors;
    final AppState state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final List<Player> roster = state.roster;
    final bool allSelected =

  Future<void> _confirmReset(BuildContext context, AppState state) async {
    final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(
          'Effacer les statistiques ?',
          style: context.text.titleLarge,
        ),
        content: Text(
          'Les compteurs de parties et de gorgées repartent à zéro. '
          'Le répertoire de joueurs est conservé.',
          style: context.text.bodyMedium,
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('Effacer'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok == true) {
      Haptics.medium();
      await state.resetStats();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _confirmForget(BuildContext context, AppState state) async {
    final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(
          'Oublier les cartes vues ?',
          style: context.text.titleLarge,
        ),
        content: Text(
          'Toutes les cartes redeviennent inédites. Vos cartes perso et vos '
          'statistiques sont conservées.',
          style: context.text.bodyMedium,
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('Annuler'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('Oublier'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok == true) {
      Haptics.medium();
      await state.resetSeenCards();
    }
  }

class _AccountCard extends StatefulWidget {
  const _AccountCard();

  @override
  State<_AccountCard> createState() => _AccountCardState();
}

class _AccountCardState extends State<_AccountCard> {
  bool _loading = false;

  Future<void> _login() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);
    Haptics.medium();
    final result = await AuthService.instance.linkWithGoogle();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _loading = false);
      if (result != null) {
        await Haptics.success();
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(content: Text('Progression sauvegardée avec succès !')),
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bool isAnonymous = AuthService.instance.isAnonymous;
    final String email = AuthService.instance.currentUser?.email ?? '';

    return AppCard(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.md),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Icon(
                isAnonymous ? Icons.person_outline_rounded : Icons.cloud_done_rounded,
                size: 22,
                color: isAnonymous ? AppColors.warning : AppColors.success,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.md),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      isAnonymous ? 'Compte local (Anonyme)' : 'Compte synchronisé',
                      style: context.text.titleMedium,
                    ),
                    Text(
                      isAnonymous
                          ? 'Créez un compte pour sauvegarder votre progression.'
                          : email,
                      style: context.text.bodySmall,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          if (isAnonymous) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
            GoogleSignInButton(
              loading: _loading,
              onPressed: _login,
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ReorderableRoster extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ReorderableRoster({
    required this.roster,
    required this.onEdit,
    required this.onToggle,
    required this.onReorder,
  });

  final List<Player> roster;
  final void Function(Player) onEdit;
  final void Function(Player) onToggle;
  final void Function(int oldIndex, int newIndex) onReorder;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    return ReorderableListView.builder(
      shrinkWrap: true,
      physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
      buildDefaultDragHandles: false,
      itemCount: roster.length,
      onReorderItem: onReorder,
      proxyDecorator: (
        Widget child,
        int index,
        Animation<double> animation,
      ) {
        return AnimatedBuilder(
          animation: animation,
          builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? _) {
            final double t = Curves.easeOut.transform(animation.value);
            return Transform.scale(
              scale: 1 + 0.03 * t,
              child: Material(
                color: Colors.transparent,
                elevation: 8 * t,
                shadowColor:
                    roster[index].color.withValues(alpha: 0.4 * t),
                borderRadius: AppRadii.card,
                child: child,
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
      itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int i) {
        final Player p = roster[i];
        return Padding(
          key: ValueKey<String>(p.id),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
          child: _PlayerTile(
            player: p,
            onToggle: () => onToggle(p),
            onEdit: () => onEdit(p),
            dragHandle: ReorderableDragStartListener(
              index: i,
              child: SizedBox(
                width: 48,
                height: 48,
                child: Icon(
                  Icons.drag_indicator_rounded,
                  size: 22,
                  color: colors.textMuted,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          )
              .animate()
              .fadeIn(duration: 240.ms),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _RuleStepper extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RuleStepper({
    required this.label,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final String label;
  final int value;
  final ValueChanged<int> onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      children: <Widget>[
        Expanded(
          child: Text(
            label,
            maxLines: 2,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: context.text.bodyMedium,
          ),
        ),
        IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Diminuer : $label',
          visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
          onPressed: value > 0 ? () => onChanged(value - 1) : null,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.remove_circle_outline_rounded, size: 22),
        ),
        SizedBox(
          width: 24,
          child: Text(
            '$value',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.text.titleMedium,
          ),
        ),
        IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Augmenter : $label',
          visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
          onPressed: value < GameRules.limit
              ? () => onChanged(value + 1)
              : null,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded, size: 22),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _PlayerEditSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const _PlayerEditSheet({required this.player});

  final Player player;

  @override
  State<_PlayerEditSheet> createState() => _PlayerEditSheetState();
}

class _PlayerEditSheetState extends State<_PlayerEditSheet> {
  late final TextEditingController _name =
      TextEditingController(text: widget.player.name);

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _name.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _pickAvatar(AppState state, Player player) async {
    final AvatarChoice? choice = await AvatarPickerSheet.show(
      context,
      currentEmoji: player.emoji,
      currentPhoto: player.photoBase64,
      color: player.color,
      taken: takenAvatars(state.roster, except: player),
    );
    if (choice == null || !mounted) return;

    if (choice.photoBase64 != null) {
      await state.setPhoto(player.id, choice.photoBase64);
    } else if (choice.emoji != null) {
      await state.setAvatar(player.id, choice.emoji!);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final AppState state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final Player player = widget.player;

    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom),
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: colors.surfaceTop,
          borderRadius: AppRadii.sheet,
          border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: colors.border)),
        ),
        padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
          top: AppSpacing.md,
          bottom: AppSpacing.lg + MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom,
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Center(
              child: Container(
                width: 38,
                height: 4,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: colors.border,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
            Text('NOM', style: context.text.labelMedium),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            TextField(
              controller: _name,
              textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
              style: context.text.titleMedium,
              onSubmitted: (String v) => state.renamePlayer(player.id, v),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
            Text('AVATAR', style: context.text.labelMedium),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            Row(
              children: <Widget>[
                AvatarView.fromPlayer(player, size: 56),
                const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.md),
                Expanded(
                  child: AppButton(
                    label: player.hasPhoto
                        ? 'Changer la photo'
                        : 'Choisir un avatar',
                    primary: false,
                    icon: Icons.face_retouching_natural_outlined,
                    onPressed: () => _pickAvatar(state, player),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (player.hasPhoto) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xs),
              Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                child: TextButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () {
                    Haptics.tick();
                    state.clearPhoto(player.id);
                  },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 15),
                  label: const Text('Revenir à un avatar'),
                ),
              ),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
            Text('BOISSON', style: context.text.labelMedium),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
            AppCard(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.md),
              accent: player.noDrink ? AppColors.modePrefere : null,
              child: Row(
                children: <Widget>[
                  Icon(
                    Icons.no_drinks_rounded,
                    size: 20,
                    color: colors.textSecondary,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.md),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text(
                          'Je ne bois pas',
                          style: context.text.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          'Ses gorgées deviennent des gages',
                          style: context.text.bodySmall,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  MiniSwitch(
                    value: player.noDrink,
                    onChanged: (bool v) {
                      Haptics.tick();
                      state.setNoDrink(player.id, v);
                    },
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
            Row(
              children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                  child: AppButton(
                    label: 'Supprimer',
                    primary: false,
                    icon: Icons.delete_outline_rounded,
                    onPressed: () {
                      Haptics.heavy();
                      state.deletePlayer(player.id);
                      Navigator.of(context).pop();
                    },
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
                Expanded(
                  child: AppButton(
                    label: 'Terminé',
                    color: player.color,
                    onPressed: () {
                      state.renamePlayer(player.id, _name.text);
                      Navigator.of(context).pop();
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

const Duration _splashDuration = Duration(milliseconds: 3600);

const List<String> _tips = <String>[
  'Le Multi-jeu change de jeu à chaque manche, avec la roulette.',
  'Les cartes Événement tombent par surprise entre deux manches.',
  'Fin de partie : découvrez les badges de chacun.',

class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen> {
  bool _navigating = false;

  late final String _tip = _tips[math.Random().nextInt(_tips.length)];

  late final Future<void> _content = ContentService.instance.preloadAll();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _scheduleNavigation();
  }

  Future<void> _scheduleNavigation() async {
    await Future.wait<void>(<Future<void>>[
      _content,
      Future<void>.delayed(_splashDuration),
    ]);
    if (mounted) _navigate();
  }

  void _navigate() {
    if (!mounted || _navigating) return;
    _navigating = true;
    final bool confirmed = context.read<AppState>().isAgeConfirmed;

    Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(
      PageRouteBuilder<void>(
        transitionDuration: AppMotion.slow,
        pageBuilder: (_, __, ___) =>
            confirmed ? const HomeScreen() : const AgeGateScreen(),
        transitionsBuilder: (
          BuildContext context,
          Animation<double> animation,
          Animation<double> secondary,
          Widget child,
        ) =>
            FadeTransition(
          opacity: CurvedAnimation(parent: animation, curve: AppMotion.enter),
          child: child,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: _navigate,
        child: AmbientBackground(
          primary: AppColors.accent,
          secondary: AppColors.modePrefere,
          intensity: 1.35,
          child: SafeArea(
            child: LayoutBuilder(
              builder: (BuildContext context, BoxConstraints constraints) {
                final double width =
                    constraints.maxWidth - AppSpacing.lg * 2;
                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: AppSpacing.lg,
                    vertical: AppSpacing.sm,
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    children: <Widget>[
                      _SplashHeader(onSkip: _navigate),
                      const Expanded(
                        child: Center(
                          child: FittedBox(
                            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                            child: _SplashHero(),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      ConstrainedBox(
                        constraints: BoxConstraints(
                          maxHeight: constraints.maxHeight * 0.68,
                        ),
                        child: IgnorePointer(
                          child: FittedBox(
                            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                            alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                            child: SizedBox(
                              width: width,
                              child: _SplashFooter(
                                tip: _tip,
                                content: _content,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
