  static TextTheme _buildTextTheme(Color textColor, Color textMuted) {
    const TextTheme base = Typography.whiteMountainView;
    final TextTheme display = GoogleFonts.outfitTextTheme(base);
    final TextTheme body = GoogleFonts.interTextTheme(base);

    return TextTheme(
      displayLarge: display.displayLarge!.copyWith(fontSize: 54, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, height: 1.05, letterSpacing: -1.6, color: textColor),
      displayMedium: display.displayMedium!.copyWith(fontSize: 42, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, height: 1.1, letterSpacing: -1, color: textColor),
      displaySmall: display.displaySmall!.copyWith(fontSize: 31, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, height: 1.18, letterSpacing: -0.5, color: textColor),
      headlineLarge: display.headlineLarge!.copyWith(fontSize: 26, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, height: 1.25, color: textColor),
      headlineMedium: display.headlineMedium!.copyWith(fontSize: 21, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: textColor),
      titleLarge: display.titleLarge!.copyWith(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: textColor),
      titleMedium: display.titleMedium!.copyWith(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: textColor),
      bodyLarge: body.bodyLarge!.copyWith(fontSize: 16, height: 1.5, color: textColor),
      bodyMedium: body.bodyMedium!.copyWith(fontSize: 14, height: 1.5, color: textColor),
      bodySmall: body.bodySmall!.copyWith(fontSize: 12.5, height: 1.45, color: textMuted),
      labelLarge: display.labelLarge!.copyWith(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, letterSpacing: 0.2, color: textColor),
      labelMedium: body.labelMedium!.copyWith(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, letterSpacing: 1.5, color: textMuted),
    );
  }

  static ThemeData _buildTheme(Brightness brightness, CulSecColors colors) {
    final bool isDark = brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final TextTheme textTheme = _buildTextTheme(colors.textPrimary, colors.textMuted);

    final ColorScheme colorScheme = ColorScheme(
      brightness: brightness,
      primary: AppColors.accent,
      onPrimary: colors.textOnAccent,
      secondary: AppColors.accentSoft,
      onSecondary: isDark ? colors.ink : Colors.white,
      surface: colors.surface,
      onSurface: colors.textPrimary,
      surfaceContainerHighest: colors.surfaceTop,
      error: AppColors.danger,
      onError: Colors.white,
    );

    return ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      brightness: brightness,
      colorScheme: colorScheme,
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: colors.ink,
      textTheme: textTheme,
      splashFactory: InkRipple.splashFactory,
      highlightColor: colors.fill,
      extensions: <ThemeExtension<dynamic>>[colors],
      appBarTheme: AppBarTheme(
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        centerTitle: true,
        systemOverlayStyle: isDark ? systemOverlayDark : systemOverlayLight,
        titleTextStyle: textTheme.titleLarge,
        iconTheme: IconThemeData(color: colors.textPrimary),
      ),
      filledButtonTheme: FilledButtonThemeData(
        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
          backgroundColor: AppColors.accent,
          foregroundColor: colors.textOnAccent,
          minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(56),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: AppRadii.button),
          textStyle: textTheme.labelLarge,
        ),
      ),
      textButtonTheme: TextButtonThemeData(
        style: TextButton.styleFrom(
          foregroundColor: AppColors.accentSoft,
          textStyle: textTheme.labelLarge,
        ),
      ),
      outlinedButtonTheme: OutlinedButtonThemeData(

          minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(56),
          side: BorderSide(color: colors.border),

      ),

        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: AppSpacing.md, vertical: AppSpacing.md),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.md), borderSide: BorderSide(color: colors.border)),

        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.md), borderSide: const BorderSide(color: AppColors.accent, width: 1.8)),
      ),
      dividerTheme: DividerThemeData(color: colors.borderSoft, thickness: 1, space: AppSpacing.lg),
      snackBarTheme: SnackBarThemeData(
        backgroundColor: colors.surfaceTop,

        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,

import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:ui' show PointMode;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

class AmbientBackground extends StatefulWidget {
  const AmbientBackground({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.primary = AppColors.accent,
    this.secondary,
    this.intensity = 1.0,
    this.animate = true,
  });

  final Widget child;
  final Color primary;
  final Color? secondary;
  final double intensity;
  final bool animate;

  @override
  State<AmbientBackground> createState() => _AmbientBackgroundState();
}

class _AmbientBackgroundState extends State<AmbientBackground>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: const Duration(seconds: 60),
  );

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.animate) _controller.repeat();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant AmbientBackground oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.animate && !_controller.isAnimating) {
      _controller.repeat();
    } else if (!widget.animate && _controller.isAnimating) {
      _controller.stop();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final bool isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return DecoratedBox(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(gradient: colors.gradientBackground),
      child: Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: <Widget>[
          RepaintBoundary(
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _controller,
              builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) {
                return CustomPaint(
                  painter: _GlowPainter(
                    progress: _controller.value,
                    primary: widget.primary,
                    secondary: widget.secondary ?? widget.primary,
                    // En mode clair, on réduit l'intensité des lueurs pour éviter de "baver"
                    intensity: widget.intensity * (isDark ? 1.0 : 0.35),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
          Positioned.fill(
            child: IgnorePointer(
              child: _GrainOverlay(isDark: isDark),
            ),
          ),
          widget.child,
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _GlowPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _GlowPainter({
    required this.progress,
    required this.primary,
    required this.secondary,
    required this.intensity,
  });

  final double progress;
  final Color primary;
  final Color secondary;
  final double intensity;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final double t = progress * 2 * math.pi;

    _glow(
      canvas,
      size,
      color: primary,
      cx: 0.5 + 0.13 * math.sin(t),
      cy: -0.02 + 0.05 * math.cos(t * 0.7),
      radius: 1.1,
      opacity: 0.22,
    );

    _glow(
      canvas,
      size,
      color: secondary,
      cx: 0.5 - 0.18 * math.sin(t * 0.8),
      cy: 1.02,
      radius: 0.85,
      opacity: 0.12,
    );
  }

  void _glow(
    Canvas canvas,
    Size size, {
    required Color color,
    required double cx,
    required double cy,
    required double radius,
    required double opacity,
  }) {
    final Offset center = Offset(size.width * cx, size.height * cy);
    final double r = size.shortestSide * radius;
    final double alpha = (opacity * intensity).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

    canvas.drawCircle(
      center,
      r,
      Paint()
        ..shader = RadialGradient(
          colors: <Color>[
            color.withValues(alpha: alpha),
            color.withValues(alpha: 0),
          ],
        ).createShader(Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: r)),
    );
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _GlowPainter old) =>
      old.progress != progress ||
      old.intensity != intensity ||
      old.primary != primary ||
      old.secondary != secondary;
}

class _GrainOverlay extends StatelessWidget {
  const _GrainOverlay({required this.isDark});

  final bool isDark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return RepaintBoundary(
      child: CustomPaint(painter: _GrainPainter(isDark: isDark)),
    );
  }
}

class _GrainPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _GrainPainter({required this.isDark});

  final bool isDark;

  static final math.Random _random = math.Random(42);
  static const int _dotCount = 700;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final List<Offset> points = <Offset>[
      for (int i = 0; i < _dotCount; i++)
        Offset(
          _random.nextDouble() * size.width,
          _random.nextDouble() * size.height,
        ),
    ];

    canvas.drawPoints(
      PointMode.points,
      points,
      Paint()
        ..color = (isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black).withValues(alpha: 0.018)
        ..strokeWidth = 1.2,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _GrainPainter oldDelegate) => oldDelegate.isDark != isDark;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
/// Transitions de navigation.
///
/// Trois routes, chacune pour une intention différente :
///
/// * [SheetRoute]      — l'écran monte depuis le bas, celui de dessous recule
///                       légèrement. Pour un écran « au-dessus » du parcours :
///                       réglages, répertoire, détail.
/// * [ForwardRoute]    — glissement latéral avec parallaxe. Pour avancer dans
///                       un parcours linéaire : configuration → partie.
/// * [FadeScaleRoute]  — fondu avec léger zoom. Pour un changement de contexte
///                       complet : splash → accueil, partie → fin de partie.
///
/// Toutes utilisent des widgets de transition au niveau RenderObject
/// (`SlideTransition`, `FadeTransition`, `ScaleTransition`) : ils animent sans
/// reconstruire l'arbre, ce qui reste tenable dans un budget de 6,9 ms.
/// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// L'écran entre par le bas et pousse le précédent en arrière-plan.
///
/// Le détail qui fait la différence : la page sortante recule (échelle 0,92)
/// et s'assombrit. On perçoit une pile de cartes, pas un simple remplacement.
class SheetRoute<T> extends PageRouteBuilder<T> {
  SheetRoute({
    required this.builder,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 420),
  }) : super(
          transitionDuration: duration,
          reverseTransitionDuration:
              Duration(milliseconds: (duration.inMilliseconds * 0.8).round()),
          opaque: false,
          barrierColor: Colors.black54,
          pageBuilder: (BuildContext context, _, __) => builder(context),
        );

  final WidgetBuilder builder;
  final Duration duration;

  @override
  Widget buildTransitions(
    BuildContext context,
    Animation<double> animation,
    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
    Widget child,
  ) {
    // Courbe « emphasized » de Material 3 : démarrage vif, arrivée posée.
    final Animation<double> curved = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: animation,
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
    );

    return SlideTransition(
      position: Tween<Offset>(
        begin: const Offset(0, 1),
        end: Offset.zero,
      ).animate(curved),
      child: FadeTransition(
        opacity: Tween<double>(begin: 0.6, end: 1).animate(curved),
        child: child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Recul de la page sortante, à appliquer à l'écran qui reste dessous.
///
/// À envelopper autour du `Scaffold` de l'écran appelant — voir l'exemple
/// dans `home_screen.dart`. Sans cela, la page du dessous reste figée et
/// l'effet de profondeur disparaît.
class SettleBehind extends StatelessWidget {
  const SettleBehind({super.key, required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // `secondaryAnimation` de la route courante : elle progresse de 0 à 1
    // quand une nouvelle page se pose par-dessus.
    final ModalRoute<Object?>? route = ModalRoute.of(context);
    if (route == null) return child;

    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: route.secondaryAnimation!,
      builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? inner) {
        final double t = Curves.easeOutCubic.transform(
          route.secondaryAnimation!.value,
        );

        return Transform.scale(
          scale: 1 - 0.08 * t,
          child: Opacity(
            // On ne descend pas sous 0,55 : l'écran doit rester lisible
            // derrière une feuille partiellement transparente.
            opacity: 1 - 0.45 * t,
            child: inner,
          ),
        );
      },
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

/// Glissement latéral avec parallaxe : la page entrante vient de la droite,
/// la sortante part vers la gauche à un tiers de la vitesse.
///
/// Ce décalage de vitesse est ce qui distingue une vraie transition d'un
/// simple balayage : l'œil perçoit deux plans de profondeur.
class ForwardRoute<T> extends PageRouteBuilder<T> {
  ForwardRoute({
    required this.builder,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 380),
  }) : super(
          transitionDuration: duration,
          reverseTransitionDuration: duration,
          pageBuilder: (BuildContext context, _, __) => builder(context),
        );

  final WidgetBuilder builder;
  final Duration duration;

  @override
  Widget buildTransitions(
    BuildContext context,
    Animation<double> animation,
    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
    Widget child,
  ) {
    final Animation<double> enter = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: animation,
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
    );
    final Animation<double> exit = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: secondaryAnimation,
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
    );

    return SlideTransition(
      // Page sortante : recul lent vers la gauche.
      position: Tween<Offset>(
        begin: Offset.zero,
        end: const Offset(-0.33, 0),
      ).animate(exit),
      child: SlideTransition(
        // Page entrante : arrivée pleine vitesse depuis la droite.
        position: Tween<Offset>(
          begin: const Offset(1, 0),
          end: Offset.zero,
        ).animate(enter),
        child: child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Fondu enchaîné avec un léger zoom avant. Pour un changement de contexte
/// complet, où aucune continuité spatiale n'a de sens.
class FadeScaleRoute<T> extends PageRouteBuilder<T> {
  FadeScaleRoute({
    required this.builder,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 460),
  }) : super(
          transitionDuration: duration,
          reverseTransitionDuration: duration,
          pageBuilder: (BuildContext context, _, __) => builder(context),
        );

  final WidgetBuilder builder;
  final Duration duration;

  @override
  Widget buildTransitions(
    BuildContext context,
    Animation<double> animation,
    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
    Widget child,
  ) {
    final Animation<double> curved = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: animation,
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
    );

    return FadeTransition(
      opacity: curved,
      child: ScaleTransition(
        // Zoom très léger : 1,04 suffit à donner une impression d'avancée.
        // Au-delà, l'effet devient voyant et fatigue à la longue.
        scale: Tween<double>(begin: 1.04, end: 1).animate(curved),
        child: child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

        taken: taken,

class _AvatarPickerSheetState extends State<AvatarPickerSheet> {
  bool _busy = false;

  late String? _selected =
      widget.currentPhoto == null ? widget.currentEmoji : null;

  Future<void> _capture(Future<AvatarPickResult> Function() action) async {
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    final AvatarPickResult result = await action();
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _busy = false);

    switch (result.status) {
      case AvatarPickStatus.success:
        Haptics.medium();
        if (!mounted) return;
        Navigator.of(context).pop(AvatarChoice.photo(result.base64!));

      case AvatarPickStatus.tooLarge:
        await Haptics.failure();
        if (!mounted) return;
        ScaffoldMessenger.maybeOf(context)
          ?..hideCurrentSnackBar()
          ..showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(
              content: Text(
                'Image trop lourde. Choisissez une photo plus légère '
                'ou utilisez l’appareil photo.',
              ),
              duration: Duration(seconds: 3),
            ),
          );

      case AvatarPickStatus.cancelled:
      case AvatarPickStatus.unavailable:
        break;
    }
  }

  void _pick(String value) {
    if (widget.taken.contains(value)) {
      Haptics.light();
      ScaffoldMessenger.maybeOf(context)
        ?..hideCurrentSnackBar()
        ..showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Cet avatar est déjà pris par un autre joueur.'),
            duration: Duration(seconds: 2),
          ),
        );
      return;
    }
    Haptics.tick();
    setState(() => _selected = value);
    Navigator.of(context).pop(AvatarChoice.emoji(value));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;

    return DraggableScrollableSheet(
      initialChildSize: 0.75,
      minChildSize: 0.5,
      maxChildSize: 0.95,
      expand: false,
      builder: (BuildContext context, ScrollController scrollController) {
        return Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: colors.surfaceHigh,
            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(
              top: Radius.circular(AppRadii.xl),
            ),
            border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: colors.border)),
          ),
          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
          child: Column(
            children: <Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm),
              Container(
                width: 44,
                height: 4,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: colors.textMuted,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
                ),
              ),
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                  AppSpacing.md,
                  AppSpacing.md,
                  AppSpacing.md,
                  AppSpacing.sm,
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: <Widget>[
                    AvatarView(
                      emoji: _selected ?? widget.currentEmoji,
                      photoBase64:
                          _selected == null ? widget.currentPhoto : null,
                      color: widget.color,
                      size: 52,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.md),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        'Choisis ton avatar',
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              _PhotoActions(busy: _busy, onCapture: _capture),
              const Divider(),
              Expanded(
                child: _AvatarGrid(
                  controller: scrollController,
                  selected: _selected,
                  taken: widget.taken,
                  color: widget.color,
                  onPick: _pick,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _AvatarGrid extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AvatarGrid({
    required this.controller,
    required this.selected,
    required this.taken,
    required this.color,
    required this.onPick,
  });

  final ScrollController controller;
  final String? selected;
  final Set<String> taken;
  final Color color;
  final ValueChanged<String> onPick;

  static const SliverGridDelegate _emojiDelegate =
      SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
    crossAxisCount: 6,
    mainAxisSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
    crossAxisSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
  );

  static const SliverGridDelegate _mascotDelegate =
      SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
    crossAxisCount: 4,
    mainAxisSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
    crossAxisSpacing: AppSpacing.sm,
    childAspectRatio: 0.78,
  );

  Widget _header(String text, TextStyle? style) => SliverPadding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
          AppSpacing.md,
          AppSpacing.md,
          AppSpacing.md,
          AppSpacing.sm,
        ),
        sliver: SliverToBoxAdapter(child: Text(text, style: style)),
      );

  Widget _mascotGrid(List<String> values) => SliverGrid(
        gridDelegate: _mascotDelegate,
        delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate(
          (BuildContext context, int index) {
            final String value = values[index];
            return _MascotTile(
              key: ValueKey<String>(value),
              value: value,
              selected: selected == value,
              taken: taken.contains(value),
              color: color,
              onTap: () => onPick(value),
            );
          },
          childCount: values.length,
          addAutomaticKeepAlives: false,
          addRepaintBoundaries: false,
        ),
      );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final TextStyle? headerStyle =
        Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
              letterSpacing: 1.2,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
            );

    return CustomScrollView(
      controller: controller,
      physics: const ClampingScrollPhysics(),
      scrollCacheExtent: const ScrollCacheExtent.pixels(400),
      slivers: <Widget>[
        for (final MapEntry<String, Map<String, String>> group
            in AvatarCatalog.mascotGroups.entries) ...<Widget>[
          _header('AVATARS · ${group.key}', headerStyle),
          SliverPadding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: AppSpacing.md),
            sliver: _mascotGrid(AvatarCatalog.valuesOf(group.value)),
          ),
        ],
        for (final MapEntry<String, List<String>> group
            in AvatarCatalog.groups.entries) ...<Widget>[
          _header(group.key.toUpperCase(), headerStyle),
          SliverPadding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: AppSpacing.md),
            sliver: SliverGrid(
              gridDelegate: _emojiDelegate,
              delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate(
                (BuildContext context, int index) {
                  final String emoji = group.value[index];
                  return _EmojiTile(
                    key: ValueKey<String>(emoji),
                    emoji: emoji,
                    selected: selected == emoji,
                    taken: taken.contains(emoji),
                    color: color,
                    onTap: () => onPick(emoji),
                  );
                },
                childCount: group.value.length,
                addAutomaticKeepAlives: false,
                addRepaintBoundaries: false,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
        const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xl)),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _MascotTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MascotTile({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.selected,
    required this.taken,
    required this.color,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final String value;
  final bool selected;
  final bool taken;
  final Color color;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return RepaintBoundary(
      child: Pressable(
        onTap: onTap,
        scale: taken ? 1 : 0.9,
        child: Opacity(
          opacity: taken ? 0.35 : 1,
          child: Column(
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: AspectRatio(
                  aspectRatio: 1,
                  child: Stack(
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Positioned.fill(
                        child: DecoratedBox(
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            border: selected
                                ? Border.all(color: color, width: 3)
                                : null,
                          ),
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: EdgeInsets.all(selected ? 3 : 0),
                            child: ClipOval(
                              child: LayoutBuilder(
                                builder: (_, BoxConstraints c) =>
                                    MascotImage(
                                  value: value,
                                  size: c.maxWidth,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (taken)
                        const Positioned(
                          right: 0,
                          bottom: 0,
                          child: _TakenBadge(),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(
                AvatarCatalog.nameFor(value),
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontWeight: selected ? FontWeight.w700 : null,
                      color: selected ? color : null,
                    ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

class _EmojiTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _EmojiTile({
    super.key,
    required this.emoji,
    required this.selected,
    required this.taken,
    required this.color,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final String emoji;
  final bool selected;
  final bool taken;
  final Color color;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  static const TextStyle _emojiStyle = TextStyle(fontSize: 24);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final Widget label = Text(emoji, style: _emojiStyle);

    if (taken) {
      return RepaintBoundary(
        child: GestureDetector(
          onTap: onTap,
          child: Stack(
            children: <Widget>[
              Positioned.fill(
                child: Opacity(
                  opacity: 0.35,
                  child: DecoratedBox(
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: colors.fill,
                      borderRadius:
                          const BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(AppRadii.sm)),
                    ),
                    child: Center(child: label),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const Positioned(right: 0, bottom: 0, child: _TakenBadge()),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (!selected) {
      return RepaintBoundary(
        child: Pressable(
          onTap: onTap,
          scale: 0.88,
          child: DecoratedBox(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: colors.fill,
              borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(AppRadii.sm)),
            ),
            child: Center(child: label),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return RepaintBoundary(
      child: Pressable(
        onTap: onTap,
        scale: 0.88,
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: AppMotion.fast,
          curve: AppMotion.emphasized,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.28),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.sm),
            border: Border.all(color: color, width: 2),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: label,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../data/avatar_catalog.dart';
import '../models/player.dart';

/// Rend l'avatar d'un joueur : sa photo si elle existe, sinon sa mascotte
/// Cul Sec, sinon son emoji.
///
/// À utiliser partout où un joueur est affiché : un `Text(player.emoji)`
/// afficherait une mascotte sous la forme brute « cs:… ».
class AvatarView extends StatelessWidget {
  const AvatarView({
    super.key,
    required this.emoji,
    required this.color,
    this.photoBase64,
    this.size = 56,
    this.showRing = true,
  });

  /// Construit directement depuis un joueur du répertoire.
  AvatarView.fromPlayer(
    Player player, {
    super.key,
    this.size = 56,
    this.showRing = true,
  })  : emoji = player.emoji,
        color = player.color,
        photoBase64 = player.photoBase64;

  /// Emoji, ou mascotte au format `cs:<id>`.
  final String emoji;

  /// Couleur du joueur : anneau et fond.
  final Color color;

  /// Photo encodée en base64, `null` si le joueur n'en a pas.
  final String? photoBase64;

  final double size;
  final bool showRing;

  Uint8List? get _bytes {
    final String? raw = photoBase64;
    if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return null;
    try {
      return base64Decode(raw);
    } on FormatException {
      return null;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final Uint8List? bytes = _bytes;
    final bool mascot = bytes == null && AvatarCatalog.isMascot(emoji);

    final Widget content;
    if (bytes != null) {
      content = Image.memory(
        bytes,
        width: size,
        height: size,
        fit: BoxFit.cover,
        cacheWidth: (size * 3).round(),
        gaplessPlayback: true,
        errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _EmojiLabel(emoji: emoji, size: size),
      );
    } else if (mascot) {
      content = MascotImage(value: emoji, size: size);
    } else {
      content = _EmojiLabel(emoji: emoji, size: size);
    }

    return RepaintBoundary(
      child: Container(
        width: size,
        height: size,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          shape: BoxShape.circle,
          // La mascotte apporte son propre fond.
          color: mascot ? null : color.withValues(alpha: 0.20),
          border: showRing ? Border.all(color: color, width: 2) : null,
        ),
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        alignment: Alignment.center,
        child: content,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Image d'une mascotte (`cs:<id>`), avec repli sur 🍻 si elle est inconnue.
///
/// Les avatars sont des fichiers WebP déclarés comme assets
/// (`assets/avatars/avatar_<id>.webp`) : ils ne sont lus et décodés qu'au
/// moment où ils s'affichent, à la taille affichée, puis gardés dans le
/// cache d'images de Flutter.
class MascotImage extends StatelessWidget {
  const MascotImage({super.key, required this.value, required this.size});

  final String value;
  final double size;

  /// Chemin de l'asset d'une mascotte.
  static String assetFor(String value) =>
      'assets/avatars/avatar_${AvatarCatalog.idOf(value)}.webp';

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Décodage à la taille réellement affichée (écrans haute densité
    // compris) : bien moins de mémoire qu'une image 256 px pleine.
    final int cache =
        (size * MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context)).ceil().clamp(32, 256).toInt();

    return Image.asset(
      assetFor(value),
      width: size,
      height: size,
      fit: BoxFit.cover,
      cacheWidth: cache,
      gaplessPlayback: true,
      filterQuality: FilterQuality.medium,
      errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _EmojiLabel(emoji: '🍻', size: size),
    );
  }
}

class _EmojiLabel extends StatelessWidget {
  const _EmojiLabel({required this.emoji, required this.size});

  final String emoji;
  final double size;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Sécurité : une valeur « cs:… » inconnue ne s'affiche jamais en brut.
    final String shown =
        emoji.startsWith(AvatarCatalog.mascotPrefix) ? '🍻' : emoji;
    return Text(
      shown,
      style: TextStyle(fontSize: size * 0.52),
      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:qr_flutter/qr_flutter.dart';

/// QR code brandé : bords arrondis, yeux ronds, points ronds, logo au
/// centre.
///
/// **Pourquoi le niveau H** : un logo central masque une partie des
/// modules du QR. Le niveau H tolère 30 % de dégradation — largement
/// suffisant pour un logo de 22 %.
///
/// **Pourquoi les yeux et points ronds** : sur les appareils photo
/// récents, les modules circulaires sont mieux détectés que les carrés
/// quand l'image est légèrement floue. C'est le style utilisé par les
/// générateurs de QR modernes (Google, Apple).
class BrandedQr extends StatelessWidget {
  const BrandedQr({
    super.key,
    required this.data,
    this.size = 220,
    this.backgroundColor = Colors.white,
    this.foregroundColor = const Color(0xFF0B0A12),
    this.cornerRadius = 24,
    this.logoCornerRadius = 999,
  });

  /// Contenu encodé dans le QR.
  final String data;

  /// Côté du QR en pixels logiques.
  final double size;

  final Color backgroundColor;
  final Color foregroundColor;

  /// Rayon des coins du fond blanc.
  final double cornerRadius;

  /// Rayon des coins du logo central. 999 = cercle parfait.
  final double logoCornerRadius;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Le logo occupe 22 % du côté, soit ~5 % de la surface totale.
    // Bien en dessous de la marge de sécurité du niveau H.
    final double logoSize = size * 0.22;
    // Petit espace entre le logo et les modules : améliore la fiabilité
    // de lecture et donne un rendu plus propre.
    final double logoPadding = logoSize * 0.10;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: backgroundColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(cornerRadius),
        boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.10),
            blurRadius: 20,
            offset: const Offset(0, 6),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: SizedBox(
        width: size,
        height: size,
        child: Stack(
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          children: <Widget>[
            // --- Le QR ---
            QrImageView(
              data: data,
              version: QrVersions.auto,
              size: size,
              // Niveau H : indispensable avec un logo au centre.
              errorCorrectionLevel: QrErrorCorrectLevel.H,
              backgroundColor: backgroundColor,

              // --- Yeux ronds (les 3 carrés des coins) ---
              eyeStyle: QrEyeStyle(
                eyeShape: QrEyeShape.circle,
                color: foregroundColor,
              ),

              // --- Points ronds (chaque module) ---
              dataModuleStyle: QrDataModuleStyle(
                dataModuleShape: QrDataModuleShape.circle,
                color: foregroundColor,
              ),
            ),

            // --- Le logo posé par-dessus ---
            Container(
              width: logoSize,
              height: logoSize,
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(logoPadding),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: backgroundColor,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(logoCornerRadius),
              ),
              child: ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
                  logoCornerRadius - logoPadding,
                ),
                child: Image.asset(
                  'assets/images/logo_cul_sec.png',
                  fit: BoxFit.contain,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

/// Carte de surface : dégradé neutre, bordure fine, ombre portée.
/// [accent] colore la bordure quand l'élément est actif.
class AppCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppCard({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.md),
    this.borderRadius,
    this.fill,
    this.accent,
    this.onTap,
    this.elevated = false,
  });

  final Widget child;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;
  final BorderRadius? borderRadius;
  final Color? fill;
  final Color? accent;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final bool elevated;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final BorderRadius radius = borderRadius ?? AppRadii.card;
    final colors = context.culColors;

    return DecoratedBox(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        borderRadius: radius,
        boxShadow: elevated ? AppShadows.raised : AppShadows.card,
      ),
      child: ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: radius,
        child: DecoratedBox(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: fill,
            gradient: fill == null ? colors.gradientSurface : null,
            borderRadius: radius,
            border: Border.all(
              color: accent != null ? accent!.withValues(alpha: 0.42) : colors.borderSoft,
              width: accent != null ? 1.4 : 1,
            ),
          ),
          child: Material(
            color: Colors.transparent,
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: onTap,
              borderRadius: radius,
              child: Padding(padding: padding, child: child),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Pastille compacte, pour les métadonnées.
class AppPill extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppPill({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.color,
    this.onTap,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 7),
  });

  final Widget child;
  final Color? color;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final Widget content = Container(
      padding: padding,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: color == null ? colors.fill : color!.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
        border: Border.all(
          color: color == null ? colors.borderSoft : color!.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
        ),
      ),
      child: child,
    );

    if (onTap == null) return content;
    return GestureDetector(behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque, onTap: onTap, child: content);
  }
}

/// Élément qui s'enfonce légèrement au toucher.
class Pressable extends StatefulWidget {
  const Pressable({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.onTap,
    this.onLongPress,
    this.scale = 0.97,
  });

  final Widget child;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final VoidCallback? onLongPress;
  final double scale;

  @override
  State<Pressable> createState() => _PressableState();
}

class _PressableState extends State<Pressable> {
  bool _pressed = false;
  bool get _interactive => widget.onTap != null || widget.onLongPress != null;
  void _set(bool value) => setState(() => _pressed = value);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GestureDetector(
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      onTapDown: _interactive ? (_) => _set(true) : null,
      onTapUp: _interactive ? (_) => _set(false) : null,
      onTapCancel: _interactive ? () => _set(false) : null,
      onTap: widget.onTap,
      onLongPress: widget.onLongPress,
      child: AnimatedScale(
        scale: _pressed ? widget.scale : 1,
        duration: AppMotion.fast,
        curve: AppMotion.enter,
        child: widget.child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Action principale d'un écran.
class AppButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppButton({
    super.key,
    required this.label,
    required this.onPressed,
    this.icon,
    this.color,
    this.height = 56,
    this.expand = true,
    this.primary = true,
  });

  final String label;
  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
  final IconData? icon;
  final Color? color;
  final double height;
  final bool expand;
  final bool primary;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final bool disabled = onPressed == null;
    final Color tint = color ?? AppColors.accent;

    final Widget button = AnimatedOpacity(
      duration: AppMotion.fast,
      opacity: disabled ? 0.42 : 1,
      child: Container(
        height: height,
        width: expand ? double.infinity : null,
        padding: expand ? null : const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: AppSpacing.lg),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: primary ? AppGradients.pair(tint, Color.lerp(tint, Colors.black, 0.24)!) : null,
          color: primary ? null : colors.fill,
          borderRadius: AppRadii.button,
          border: primary ? null : Border.all(color: colors.border),
          boxShadow: primary && !disabled ? AppShadows.glow(tint) : null,
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            if (icon != null) ...<Widget>[
              Icon(
                icon,
                size: 19,
                color: primary ? Colors.white : colors.textSecondary,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
            ],
            Flexible(
              child: Text(
                label,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: context.text.labelLarge?.copyWith(
                  fontSize: 16,
                  color: primary ? Colors.white : colors.textSecondary,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );

    return Pressable(onTap: onPressed, child: expand ? button : Center(child: button));
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../models/enums.dart';

class GameScaffold extends StatelessWidget {
  const GameScaffold({
    super.key,
    required this.mode,
    required this.child,
    this.accent,
    this.bottom,
    this.onQuit,
    this.showTurnCounter = true,
    this.turn,
  });

  final GameMode mode;
  final Widget child;
  final Color? accent;
  final Widget? bottom;
  final VoidCallback? onQuit;
  final bool showTurnCounter;
  final int? turn;

  Future<void> _confirmQuit(BuildContext context) async {
    Haptics.light();
    final bool? quit = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text('Terminer la partie ?', style: context.text.titleLarge),
        content: Text(
          'Le récapitulatif de fin de soirée sera affiché.',
          style: context.text.bodyMedium,
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('Continuer'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('Terminer'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (quit == true && context.mounted) {
      (onQuit ?? () => Navigator.of(context).pop()).call();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final GameSession? session = context.watch<GameSession?>();
    final int? currentTurn = turn ?? session?.turn;

    final Color tint = accent ?? mode.color;
    final bool multi =
        Provider.of<MultiJeuController?>(context, listen: false) != null;
    final colors = context.culColors;

    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (bool didPop, Object? result) {
        if (!didPop) _confirmQuit(context);
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        body: AmbientBackground(
          primary: tint,
          secondary: mode.colorAlt,
          child: Stack(
            fit: StackFit.expand,
            children: <Widget>[
              SafeArea(
                child: Column(
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Padding(
                      padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
                        top: AppSpacing.sm,
                        bottom: AppSpacing.sm,
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: <Widget>[
                          AppPill(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                            onTap: () => _confirmQuit(context),
                            child: SizedBox(
                              width: 24,
                              height: 24,
                              child: Icon(
                                Icons.close_rounded,
                                size: 22,
                                color: colors.textSecondary,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm + 4),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Row(
                              children: <Widget>[
                                Icon(
                                  multi ? Icons.shuffle_rounded : mode.icon,
                                  size: 14,
                                  color: tint,
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 7),
                                Flexible(
                                  child: Text(
                                    multi
                                        ? 'Multi-jeu · ${mode.title}'
                                        : mode.title,
                                    maxLines: 1,
                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                    style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                                      fontSize: 14,
                                      color: colors.textSecondary,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                          IntensityChip(
                            onTap: () => showIntensitySheet(
                              context,
                              onChanged: (Intensity _) {
                                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
                                  ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
                                  ..showSnackBar(
                                    const SnackBar(
                                      content: Text(
                                        'Appliqué à la prochaine partie.',
                                      ),
                                      duration: Duration(seconds: 3),
                                    ),
                                  );
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (showTurnCounter && currentTurn != null) ...<Widget>[
                            const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
                            AppPill(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 10,
                                vertical: 8,
                              ),
                              child: Text(
                                '$currentTurn',
                                style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                                  fontSize: 12,
                                  color: colors.textSecondary,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),

                    Expanded(child: child),

                    if (bottom != null)
                      Padding(
                        padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
                          top: AppSpacing.sm,
                          bottom: AppSpacing.md,
                        ),
                        child: bottom,
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              if (session != null)
                Positioned(
                  left: 0,
                  right: 0,
                  top: 0,
                  child: SafeArea(
                    bottom: false,
                    child: GageOverlay(session: session),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

                    ),
                  Align(

                        Haptics.success();
                        session.gages.value = null;
                      },
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded, size: 18),
                      label: Text(
                        notices.length > 1 ? 'Gages faits !' : 'Gage fait !',

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_animate/flutter_animate.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../models/enums.dart';
import '../services/app_state.dart';
import '../services/haptics.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

class IntensitySelector extends StatelessWidget {
  const IntensitySelector({
    super.key,
    this.onChanged,
    this.cardCounts,
    this.compact = false,
  });

  final ValueChanged<Intensity>? onChanged;
  final Map<Intensity, int>? cardCounts;
  final bool compact;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final AppState state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final Intensity selected = state.intensity;
    const List<Intensity> options = Intensity.values;
    final int index = options.indexOf(selected);

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: <Widget>[
        Container(
          height: compact ? 44 : 54,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: colors.surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.md),
            border: Border.all(color: colors.borderSoft),
          ),
          child: LayoutBuilder(
            builder: (BuildContext context, BoxConstraints c) {
              final double segment = c.maxWidth / options.length;

              return Stack(
                children: <Widget>[
                  AnimatedPositioned(
                    duration: AppMotion.base,
                    curve: AppMotion.emphasized,
                    left: segment * index,
                    top: 0,
                    bottom: 0,
                    width: segment,
                    child: AnimatedContainer(
                      duration: AppMotion.base,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        gradient: AppGradients.pair(
                          selected.color,
                          Color.lerp(selected.color, Colors.black, 0.22)!,
                        ),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.sm + 2),
                        boxShadow: AppShadows.glow(selected.color),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  Row(
                    children: options.map((Intensity value) {
                      final bool isOn = value == selected;

                      return Expanded(
                        child: GestureDetector(
                          behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                          onTap: () {
                            if (isOn) return;
                            Haptics.medium();
                            state.setIntensity(value);
                            onChanged?.call(value);
                          },
                          child: Center(
                            child: Column(
                              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                              children: <Widget>[
                                Row(
                                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                                  children: <Widget>[
                                    AnimatedScale(
                                      duration: AppMotion.base,
                                      curve: AppMotion.overshoot,
                                      scale: isOn ? 1 : 0.9,
                                      child: Icon(
                                        value.icon,
                                        size: compact ? 12 : 13,
                                        color: isOn
                                            ? Colors.white
                                            : value.color
                                                .withValues(alpha: 0.55),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 5),
                                    AnimatedDefaultTextStyle(
                                      duration: AppMotion.base,
                                      style:
                                          context.text.titleMedium!.copyWith(
                                        fontSize: compact ? 12 : 13.5,
                                        color: isOn
                                            ? Colors.white
                                            : colors.textSecondary,
                                        fontWeight: isOn
                                            ? FontWeight.w700
                                            : FontWeight.w500,
                                      ),
                                      child: Text(value.label),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                                if (!compact && cardCounts != null)
                                  AnimatedDefaultTextStyle(
                                    duration: AppMotion.base,
                                    style: context.text.bodySmall!.copyWith(
                                      fontSize: 10,
                                      color: isOn
                                          ? Colors.white
                                              .withValues(alpha: 0.85)
                                          : colors.textMuted,
                                    ),
                                    child:
                                        Text('${cardCounts![value] ?? 0}'),
                                  ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                    }).toList(),
                  ),
                ],
              );
            },
          ),
        ),

        if (!compact) ...<Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Container(
                width: 3,
                height: 15,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: selected.color,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
              Expanded(
                child: AnimatedSwitcher(
                  duration: AppMotion.base,
                  child: Row(
                    key: ValueKey<Intensity>(selected),
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          selected.tagline,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                            fontSize: 13,
                            color: selected.color,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (selected.isExplicit) ...<Widget>[
                        const SizedBox(width: AppSpacing.sm),
                        const AdultBadge(),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              if (cardCounts != null)
                Text(
                  '${cardCounts![selected] ?? 0} cartes',
                  style: context.text.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontSize: 11.5),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

class IntensitySheet extends StatelessWidget {
  const IntensitySheet({super.key, this.onChanged, this.cardCounts});

  final ValueChanged<Intensity>? onChanged;
  final Map<Intensity, int>? cardCounts;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final AppState state = context.watch<AppState>();

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: colors.surfaceTop,
        borderRadius: AppRadii.sheet,
        border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: colors.border)),
      ),
      padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
        top: AppSpacing.md,
        bottom: AppSpacing.lg + MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom,
      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Center(
            child: Container(
              width: 38,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: colors.border,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
          Text('INTENSITÉ', style: context.text.labelMedium),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.xs),
          Text(
            'Chaque palier inclut les précédents.',
            style: context.text.bodyMedium,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),

          for (int i = 0; i < Intensity.values.length; i++)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: AppSpacing.sm + 2),
              child: _IntensityRow(
                value: Intensity.values[i],
                selected: state.intensity == Intensity.values[i],
                count: cardCounts?[Intensity.values[i]],
                onTap: () {
                  Haptics.medium();
                  state.setIntensity(Intensity.values[i]);
                  onChanged?.call(Intensity.values[i]);
                },

class _QrScannerViewState extends State<QrScannerView> {
  final MobileScannerController _controller = MobileScannerController(
    detectionSpeed: DetectionSpeed.noDuplicates,
    formats: const <BarcodeFormat>[BarcodeFormat.qrCode],
  );
  bool _handled = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onDetectInternal(BarcodeCapture capture) {
    if (_handled) return;
    final List<Barcode> barcodes = capture.barcodes;
    if (barcodes.isEmpty || barcodes.first.rawValue == null) return;
    
    _handled = true;
    widget.onDetect(capture);

/// Transition commune aux surcouches : fondu + léger zoom.
Widget _popTransition(
  BuildContext context,
  Animation<double> animation,
  Animation<double> secondary,
  Widget child,
) {
  final Animation<double> curved =
      CurvedAnimation(parent: animation, curve: Curves.easeOutBack);
  return FadeTransition(
    opacity: animation,
    child: ScaleTransition(
      scale: Tween<double>(begin: 0.85, end: 1).animate(curved),
      child: child,
    ),
  );
}

class _Roulette extends StatefulWidget {
  const _Roulette({required this.modes, required this.target});

  final List<GameMode> modes;
  final GameMode target;

  @override
  State<_Roulette> createState() => _RouletteState();

class _RouletteState extends State<_Roulette>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 2600),
  );

  late final double _endAngle;
  late final Animation<double> _angle;
  int _lastSegment = -1;
  bool _landed = false;

  int get _count => widget.modes.length;
  double get _segment => 2 * math.pi / _count;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final math.Random random = math.Random();
    final int index =
        widget.modes.indexWhere((GameMode m) => m.id == widget.target.id);
    final double base = (-index * _segment) % (2 * math.pi);
    final double jitter = (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * _segment * 0.6;
    _endAngle = 2 * math.pi * 5 + base + jitter;
    _angle = Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: _endAngle).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),
    );
    _controller.addListener(_onTick);
    _spin();
  }

  void _onTick() {
    final int seg = ((_angle.value + _segment / 2) / _segment).floor();
    if (seg != _lastSegment) {
      _lastSegment = seg;
      Haptics.tick();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _spin() async {
    await _controller.forward();
    if (!mounted) return;
    unawaited(Haptics.double(sound: Sfx.land));
    setState(() => _landed = true);
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1100));
    if (mounted) Navigator.of(context).pop();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final GameMode target = widget.target;

    return SafeArea(
      child: Material(
        type: MaterialType.transparency,
        child: Center(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: <Widget>[
              Text(
                'PROCHAIN JEU',
                style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(letterSpacing: 5),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
              SizedBox(
                width: 280,
                height: 300,
                child: Stack(
                  alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Positioned(
                      top: 20,
                      child: AnimatedBuilder(
                        animation: _angle,
                        builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) =>
                            Transform.rotate(
                          angle: _angle.value,
                          child: child,
                        ),
                        child: CustomPaint(
                          size: const Size(280, 280),
                          painter: _WheelPainter(
                            modes: widget.modes,
                            borderColor: colors.ink,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Positioned(
                      top: 0,
                      child: Icon(
                        Icons.arrow_drop_down_rounded,
                        size: 54,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shadows: <Shadow>[
                          Shadow(color: Colors.black54, blurRadius: 8),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    Positioned(
                      top: 20 + 140 - 26,
                      child: Container(
                        width: 52,
                        height: 52,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                          color: colors.surfaceTop,
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.85),
                            width: 3,
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Icon(
                          Icons.shuffle_rounded,
                          size: 24,
                          color: colors.textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
              SizedBox(
                height: 44,
                child: AnimatedSwitcher(
                  duration: AppMotion.base,
                  child: _landed
                      ? Row(
                          key: const ValueKey<String>('landed'),
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: <Widget>[

class _WheelPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _WheelPainter({required this.modes, required this.borderColor});

  final List<GameMode> modes;
  final Color borderColor;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final Offset center = size.center(Offset.zero);
    final double radius = size.width / 2;
    final double seg = 2 * math.pi / modes.length;
    final Rect rect = Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius);

    for (int i = 0; i < modes.length; i++) {
      final GameMode mode = modes[i];
      final double start = -math.pi / 2 + i * seg - seg / 2;

      final Paint fill = Paint()
        ..shader = RadialGradient(
          colors: <Color>[mode.colorAlt, mode.color],
        ).createShader(rect);
      canvas.drawArc(rect, start, seg, true, fill);

      final Paint border = Paint()
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
        ..strokeWidth = 3
        ..color = borderColor;
      canvas.drawArc(rect, start, seg, true, border);

      final double mid = start + seg / 2;
      final Offset at = center +
          Offset(math.cos(mid), math.sin(mid)) * (radius * 0.62);
      final TextPainter icon = TextPainter(
        text: TextSpan(
          text: String.fromCharCode(mode.icon.codePoint),
          style: TextStyle(
            fontFamily: mode.icon.fontFamily,
            package: mode.icon.fontPackage,
            fontSize: 38,
            color: Colors.white,
            shadows: const <Shadow>[
              Shadow(color: Colors.black38, blurRadius: 6),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      )..layout();
      canvas.save();
      canvas.translate(at.dx, at.dy);
      canvas.rotate(mid + math.pi / 2);
      icon.paint(canvas, Offset(-icon.width / 2, -icon.height / 2));
      canvas.restore();
    }

    canvas.drawCircle(
      center,
      radius - 2,
      Paint()
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
        ..strokeWidth = 5
        ..color = Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.85),
    );
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _WheelPainter old) =>
      old.modes != modes || old.borderColor != borderColor;
}

class _SharePreview extends StatefulWidget {
  const _SharePreview({
    required this.mode,
    required this.session,
    required this.badges,
  });

  final GameMode mode;
  final GameSession session;
  final List<EveningBadge> badges;

  @override
  State<_SharePreview> createState() => _SharePreviewState();
}

class _SharePreviewState extends State<_SharePreview> {
  final GlobalKey _captureKey = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _buttonKey = GlobalKey();
  bool _busy = false;

  Future<Uint8List?> _capture() async {
    final RenderObject? object =
        _captureKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
    if (object is! RenderRepaintBoundary) return null;
    final ui.Image image = await object.toImage(pixelRatio: 2);
    final ByteData? data =
        await image.toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.png);
    image.dispose();
    return data?.buffer.asUint8List();
  }

  Future<void> _share() async {
    if (_busy) return;
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    Haptics.medium();
    try {
      final Uint8List? bytes = await _capture();
      if (bytes == null || !mounted) return;

      final RenderBox? box =
          _buttonKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject() as RenderBox?;
      final Rect? origin =
          box == null ? null : box.localToGlobal(Offset.zero) & box.size;

      await SharePlus.instance.share(
        ShareParams(
          files: <XFile>[
            XFile.fromData(
              bytes,
              mimeType: 'image/png',
              name: 'cul_sec_recap.png',
            ),
          ],
          text: 'Notre soirée Cul Sec 🍻',
          sharePositionOrigin: origin,
        ),
      );
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.maybeOf(context)?.showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Le partage a échoué.')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final double maxHeight = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * 0.62;

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: colors.surfaceTop,
        borderRadius: AppRadii.sheet,
        border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: colors.border)),
      ),
      padding: AppSpacing.screen.copyWith(
        top: AppSpacing.sm + 2,
        bottom: AppSpacing.lg + MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom,
      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: <Widget>[
          Container(
            width: 38,
            height: 4,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: colors.border,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadii.pill),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
          Text('APERÇU', style: context.text.labelMedium),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.md),
          ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: maxHeight),
            child: FittedBox(
              child: RepaintBoundary(
                key: _captureKey,
                child: RecapCard(
                  mode: widget.mode,
                  session: widget.session,
                  badges: widget.badges,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: AppSpacing.lg),
          AppButton(
            key: _buttonKey,
            label: _busy ? 'Préparation…' : 'Partager l’image',
            icon: Icons.ios_share_rounded,
            color: widget.mode.color,
            onPressed: _busy ? null : _share,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class RecapCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const RecapCard({
    super.key,
    required this.mode,
    required this.session,
    required this.badges,
  });

  final GameMode mode;
  final GameSession session;
  final List<EveningBadge> badges;

  static const double width = 360;

  String get _date {
    final DateTime d = session.startedAt;
    String two(int v) => v.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '${two(d.day)}/${two(d.month)}/${d.year}';
  }

  String get _duration {
    final Duration e = session.elapsed;
    if (e.inHours > 0) return '${e.inHours} h ${two(e.inMinutes % 60)}';
    return '${math.max(1, e.inMinutes)} min';
  }

  static String two(int v) => v.toString().padLeft(2, '0');

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.culColors;
    final List<Player> ranked = List<Player>.from(session.players)
      ..sort((Player a, Player b) =>
          session.sipsOf(b).compareTo(session.sipsOf(a)),);
    final List<Player> podium = ranked.take(3).toList();
    final List<EveningBadge> shownBadges = badges.take(6).toList();

    return Material(
      type: MaterialType.transparency,
      child: Container(
        width: width,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 22, 22, 18),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: <Color>[
              Color.lerp(colors.ink, mode.color, 0.35)!,
              colors.ink,
              Color.lerp(colors.ink, mode.colorAlt, 0.25)!,
            ],
          ),
          border: Border.all(color: mode.color.withValues(alpha: 0.6)),
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(
              children: <Widget>[
                Image.asset(
                  'assets/images/logo_cul_sec.png',
                  height: 34,
                  filterQuality: FilterQuality.medium,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Text(
                        'Cul Sec !',
                        style: context.text.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
                          fontSize: 22,
                          color: colors.textPrimary,
                        ),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        '${mode.title} · $_date',
                        style: context.text.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                          color: colors.textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Row(
              children: <Widget>[
                _MiniStat(value: '${session.turn}', label: 'tours'),
                _MiniStat(value: _duration, label: 'de soirée'),
                _MiniStat(
                  value: '${session.totalSips}',
                  label: 'gorgées',
                  color: AppColors.warning,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (podium.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 18),
              _Label('PODIUM DES ASSOIFFÉS', color: mode.color),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              for (int i = 0; i < podium.length; i++)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                  child: Row(
                    children: <Widget>[
                      SizedBox(
                        width: 26,
                        child: Text(
                          const <String>['🥇', '🥈', '🥉'][i],
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18),
                        ),
                      ),
                      AvatarView.fromPlayer(
                        podium[i],
                        size: 28,
                        showRing: false,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          podium[i].name,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                            fontSize: 15,
                            color: colors.textPrimary,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        '${session.sipsOf(podium[i])} 🍺',
                        style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                          fontSize: 14,
                          color: podium[i].color,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
            ],
            if (shownBadges.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _Label('BADGES DE LA SOIRÉE', color: mode.color),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Wrap(
                spacing: 8,
                runSpacing: 8,
                children: <Widget>[
                  for (final EveningBadge b in shownBadges)
                    Container(
                      width: (width - 44 - 8) / 2,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 10,
                        vertical: 8,
                      ),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: b.color.withValues(alpha: 0.14),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                        border: Border.all(
                          color: b.color.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text(b.emoji, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22)),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: <Widget>[
                                Text(
                                  b.title,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: context.text.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                                    fontSize: 10.5,
                                    letterSpacing: 0.3,
                                    color: b.color,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                Text(
                                  b.player.name,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: context.text.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                                    fontSize: 13.5,
                                    color: colors.textPrimary,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Center(
              child: Text(
                'Jeux de soirée · à consommer avec modération',
                style: context.text.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                  fontSize: 10.5,
                  color: colors.textMuted,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import Cocoa
import FlutterMacOS

class MainFlutterWindow: NSWindow {
  override func awakeFromNib() {
    let flutterViewController = FlutterViewController()
    let windowFrame = self.frame
    self.contentViewController = flutterViewController
    self.setFrame(windowFrame, display: true)

    RegisterGeneratedPlugins(registry: flutterViewController)

    super.awakeFromNib()
  }
}
